entries.label: thm:main
entries.title: thm:main
entries.chapter: Introduction
entries.body:
Let $n\ge 4$ and let $r_1,\dots,r_n>0$ be a cyclic sequence with at least two
distinct plateau maxima and two distinct plateau minima. Then there is a
simple, strictly convex, coherent polygon $x_1,\dots,x_n$, listed
counterclockwise, whose circle through $x_{i-1},x_i,x_{i+1}$ has radius $r_i$
for every $i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikov_converse_geometric
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikov_converse_geometric [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {r : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hext : IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin r) :
    ∃ v : ZMod n → ℂ, IsCoherentConvexPolygon v ∧
      ∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i :=
  (tabachnikov_converse hn hr hext).imp fun _ h ↦ ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩

lemma IsCoherentConvexPolygon.signedMengerR2_eq_inv_of_radii
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {r : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : IsCoherentConvexPolygon v)
    (hrad : ∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i) (i : ZMod n) :
    signedMengerR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)) = 1 / r i := by
  simpa only [one_div_one_div, SignedMengerProfile_apply] using
    congrArg (fun x : ℝ ↦ 1 / x) ((h.vertexCircumradius_eq_inv i).symm.trans (hrad i))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsCoherentConvexPolygon.not_concyclic4_of_radius_ne
lean.code:
lemma IsCoherentConvexPolygon.not_concyclic4_of_radius_ne
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {r : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : IsCoherentConvexPolygon v)
    (hrad : ∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i) (i : ZMod n)
    (hne : r i ≠ r (i + 1)) :
    ¬ Concyclic4 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v (i + 2)) :=
  fun hcon ↦ hne ((hrad i).symm.trans
    ((vertexCircumradius_eq_of_concyclic i (h.2.2 i).1 (h.2.2 (i + 1)).1 hcon).trans
      (hrad (i + 1))))

entries.label: cor:iff
entries.title: cor:iff
entries.chapter: Introduction
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$ and let $r_1,\dots,r_n>0$ be nonconstant. Then $r$ is the radius
sequence of a coherent convex polygon if and only if $r$ has two distinct
plateau maxima and two distinct plateau minima.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikov_radius_characterization
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikov_radius_characterization [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {r : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hnc : ¬ ∃ c, ∀ i, r i = c) :
    (∃ v : ZMod n → ℂ, IsCoherentConvexPolygon v ∧
      ∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i) ↔ IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin r := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hrad⟩
    have hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v := by
      intro hcircle
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_constant_signedMengerProfile_of_concyclic_positiveOrientation
        hv.1 hcircle hv.positivePolygonOrientation
      apply hnc
      refine ⟨1 / c, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [← hrad i, hv.vertexCircumradius_eq_inv i, hc i]
    have hfv := dahlberg_discrete_four_vertex_E2 hn v hv.1 hv.2.2.dahlbergRegular hnoncircle
    have hpos : ∀ i, 0 < SignedMengerProfile v i := fun i ↦
      signedMengerR2_pos_iff_crossR2_pos.mpr (hv.positivePolygonOrientation i)
    have hinv := dahlbergFourVertex_inv_of_pos hpos hfv
    have heq : ∀ i, r i = (SignedMengerProfile v i)⁻¹ := by
      intro i
      rw [← hrad i, hv.vertexCircumradius_eq_inv i, one_div]
    exact (dahlbergFourVertex_congr heq hinv).hasTwoPlateauMaxRuns_and_min
  · exact tabachnikov_converse_geometric hn hr

entries.label: rem:wording
entries.title: The wording of the problem
entries.chapter: Introduction
entries.body:
Read with strict extrema, $r_{i-1}<r_i>r_{i+1}$, Tabachnikov's hypothesis
is a special case of \ref{thm:main}. Read with weak extrema,
$r_{i-1}\le r_i\ge r_{i+1}$, the statement is false: $r=(2,1,1,1)$ has the
weak local maxima $r_1,r_3$ and minima $r_2,r_4$ but one plateau maximum, so
by \ref{cor:iff} it is not a radius sequence. The constant
sequence, covered by neither reading, is realized by the regular $n$-gon.
Tabachnikov's non-concyclicity hypothesis holds for our polygon exactly when
$r_i\ne r_{i+1}$ for all $i$: one implication was just noted, and if
$r_i=r_{i+1}$ in a coherent convex polygon, the circles at $x_i$ and $x_{i+1}$ share the chord
$x_ix_{i+1}$, the radius and the side of their centers, so they coincide.

noncomputable def closureGap (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℂ :=

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle
lean.code:
noncomputable def turningAngle (K : ℝ) (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)) + Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ i / 2))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningSum
lean.code:
noncomputable def turningSum [NeZero n] (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : ZMod n, turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i

entries.label: lem:tangent-chord
entries.title: Tangent--chord
entries.chapter: Development
entries.body:
Let $\kappa>0$ and let $h$ be moderate. Then
$M(P_k,P_{k+1},P_{k+2})=\kappa_{k+1}$ for every $k\in\mathbb N$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_development
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerR2_development {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (k : ℕ) :
    signedMengerR2 (vertexR2 κ ℓ k) (vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1))
        (vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1)) = κ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
  -- the two edge vectors of the middle triple
  have hu : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ k
      = (ℓ (k : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  have hw : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1)
      = (ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  set i : ZMod n := ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) with hi
  set a : ℝ := ℓ (k : ZMod n) with ha
  set b : ℝ := ℓ i with hb
  set α : ℝ := heading κ ℓ k with hαd
  set β : ℝ := heading κ ℓ (k + 1) with hβd
  set θ : ℝ := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i with hθd
  rw [signedMengerR2_of_diffs hu hw]
  -- turning-angle relation β - α = θ
  have hθ : β - α = θ := by
    rw [hβd, heading_succ, ← hi, ← hθd, ← hαd]; ring
  -- edge components and norms
  rw [edge_re, edge_im, edge_re, edge_im]
  have hapos : 0 < a := h.length_pos (k : ZMod n)
  have hbpos : 0 < b := h.length_pos i
  -- the third side is the vertex chord
  have hnorm : ‖(a : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      + (b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((β : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = vertexChord κ ℓ i := by
    rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq, vertexChord]
    congr 1
    have hi1 : i - 1 = (k : ZMod n) := by rw [hi]; push_cast; ring
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, edge_re, edge_im]
    rw [hi1, ← ha, ← hb, ← hθd, ← hθ, Real.cos_sub]
    linear_combination a ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq α
      + b ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq β
  rw [edge_norm, edge_norm, abs_of_pos hapos, abs_of_pos hbpos, hnorm]
  -- final algebra through the Menger chord identity
  have hmenger : κ i * vertexChord κ ℓ i = 2 * Real.sin θ := by
    have := menger_chord_identity h i
    rwa [← hθd] at this
  have hvc := vertexChord_pos h i
  have hnum : a * Real.cos α * (b * Real.sin β) - a * Real.sin α * (b * Real.cos β)
      = a * b * Real.sin θ := by
    rw [← hθ, Real.sin_sub]; ring
  rw [hnum, show 2 * (a * b * Real.sin θ) = a * b * (2 * Real.sin θ) from by ring,
    ← hmenger]
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hapos
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hbpos
  have hvc0 : vertexChord κ ℓ i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hvc
  field_simp

entries.label: def:realization
entries.title: def:realization
entries.chapter: Development
entries.body:
Let $\kappa\in\R^n$ be positive. Half-lengths $h$ \emph{realize} $\kappa$ if
$h$ is moderate, $\Gap(\kappa,h)=0$ and $\Turn(\kappa,h)=2\pi$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RealizesR2
lean.code:
def RealizesR2 [NeZero n] (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ, ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ ∧ closureGap κ ℓ = 0 ∧
    turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi ∧ IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ ℓ)

/-! ## The constant profile closes -/

entries.label: prop:convex
entries.title: prop:convex
entries.chapter: Development
entries.body:
If $h$ realizes $\kappa$, then $[P_a,P_{a+1},P_c]>0$ whenever
$c\notin\{a,a+1\}$. In particular the polygon $(P_i)_{i\in\Zn}$ is simple and
strictly convex.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi)
    (a c : ZMod n) (hca : c ≠ a) (hca1 : c ≠ a + 1) :
    0 < crossR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ a) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (a + 1))
      (polygonR2 κ ℓ c) := by
  have hleft := support_pos_cyclic h hκ hE hT a c hca hca1
  rw [polygonR2_edgeVector hE hT, crossR2_edgeVector]
  exact mul_pos (h.length_pos a) hleft

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive
lean.code:
theorem isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) :
    IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ ℓ) :=
  ⟨fun i => polygonR2_edge_ne h hE hT i,
   fun i => polygonR2_consecutive_inter h hκ hE hT hn i,
   fun i j hij hij1 hji1 => polygonR2_nonadjacent_disjoint h hκ hE hT i j hij hij1 hji1⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.coherent_development_moderate
lean.code:
theorem coherent_development_moderate [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) :
    CoherentR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ) := by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨ψ, ψ', hd, hem, hep⟩ := polygon_edges hE hT i
  have hl1 := h.length_pos (i - 1)
  have hl2 := h.length_pos i
  have hκi := hκ i
  have hθpos : 0 < turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i := turningAngle_pos h hκi
  have hθlt : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i < Real.pi := by
    have := abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h i
    rw [abs_lt] at this
    exact this.2
  have hsinθ : 0 < Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθpos hθlt
  have hprod := conj_edge_mul_edge hE hT i
  have hre_eq : ((starRingEnd ℂ) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).re
      = -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.cos (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
    rw [hprod, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re]
  have him_eq : ((starRingEnd ℂ) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im
      = -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
    rw [hprod, Complex.im_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
  have hcross : crossR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1))
      (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [crossR2_eq_im_conj_mul, him_eq]
    have : -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) < 0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hl1 hl2) hsinθ]
    exact ne_of_lt this
  refine ⟨hcross, ?_⟩
  set A := Real.arcsin (κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)) with hA
  set B := Real.arcsin (κ i * (ℓ i / 2)) with hB
  have hθAB : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i = A + B := by
    rw [turningAngle, hA, hB, tK_zero, tK_zero]
  have hargl : κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) < 1 := by
    have := h.wall_left i
    rwa [tK_zero, abs_of_pos hκi] at this
  have hargr : κ i * (ℓ i / 2) < 1 := by
    have := h.wall_right i
    rwa [tK_zero, abs_of_pos hκi] at this
  have hargl0 : 0 < κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) := mul_pos hκi (half_pos hl1)
  have hargr0 : 0 < κ i * (ℓ i / 2) := mul_pos hκi (half_pos hl2)
  have hsinA : Real.sin A = κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) := by
    rw [hA]; exact Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hargl.le
  have hsinB : Real.sin B = κ i * (ℓ i / 2) := by
    rw [hB]; exact Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hargr.le
  have hcosA : 0 < Real.cos A := by
    rw [hA, Real.cos_arcsin]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith)
  have hcosB : 0 < Real.cos B := by
    rw [hB, Real.cos_arcsin]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith)
  have htrig := neg_sin_mul_cos_add_lt (hsinA ▸ hargl0) (hsinB ▸ hargr0)
    hcosA hcosB (by rw [← hθAB]; exact hsinθ)
  rw [hsinA, hsinB, lt_min_iff] at htrig
  have hnu : normSq (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i) = ℓ (i - 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hem, Complex.normSq_neg, normSq_scaled_exp]
  have hnw : normSq (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i) = ℓ i ^ 2 := by
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: lem:paper-constant
entries.title: Constant profile
entries.chapter: Development
entries.body:
If $\kappa\equiv c>0$, then $h_i=\sin(\pi/n)/c$ realizes $\kappa$: every
$\theta_i=2\pi/n$, and the polygon is the regular $n$-gon.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_const
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_const [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    RealizesR2 (fun _ : ZMod n => c) := by
  obtain ⟨hMA, _, hsum, hclose⟩ := regularGon_closes hn hc
  exact ⟨fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n), hMA, hclose, hsum,
    isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive hn hMA (fun _ => hc) hclose hsum⟩

entries.label: def:dfv
entries.title: def:dfv
entries.chapter: Development
entries.body:
A profile $\kappa\in\R^n$ has a \emph{strict four-vertex window} at level
$c\in\R$, written $\DFV(\kappa,c)$, if there are integers
$i_1<i_2<i_3<i_4<i_1+n$ satisfying~\eqref{eq:dfv}, indices read mod $n$. A
\emph{plateau maximum run} of $\kappa$ is a cyclic interval
$I=\{a,\dots,a+k\}$ with $k<n-1$ on which $\kappa$ is constant, such that
$\kappa_{a-1}<\kappa_a>\kappa_{a+k+1}$; plateau minimum runs are defined
with the inequalities reversed.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV
lean.code:
def DFV (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ i₁ i₂ i₃ i₄ : ℕ, i₁ < i₂ ∧ i₂ < i₃ ∧ i₃ < i₄ ∧ i₄ < i₁ + n ∧
    c < κ ((i₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ κ ((i₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c ∧
    c < κ ((i₃ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ κ ((i₄ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.controller
lean.code:
noncomputable def controller (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℂ × ℝ :=
  let θ := F.turns κ L
  ((L 0 : ℂ) + (L 1 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1) +
    (L 2 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2) +
    (L 3 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3),
    θ 0 + θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3 - 2 * Real.pi)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame
lean.code:
structure Frame (n : ℕ) where
  edge : Fin 4 → ℕ
  strictMono : StrictMono edge
  lt_n : ∀ j, edge j < n

namespace Frame

variable {n : ℕ} (F : Frame n)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.closureGap_eq_controller
lean.code:
theorem closureGap_eq_controller (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    closureGap κ (F.lengths L) =
      2 * unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths L) (F.edge 0)) * (F.controller κ L).1 := by
  have hsum : closureGap κ (F.lengths L) =
      ∑ j : Fin 4, ((2 * L j : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths L) (F.edge j)) := by
    unfold closureGap vertexR2
    rw [F.sum_range_selected]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      change (F.lengths L (F.residue j) : ℂ) * _ = _
      rw [F.lengths_selected]
      rfl
    · intro k hk hne
      rw [F.lengths_unselected L (F.residue_ne_of_nat_ne hk hne)]
      simp
  rw [hsum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin 4, ((2 * L j : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths L) (F.edge 0)) *
          unitPhase (F.relativeHeading κ L j)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [F.heading_selected κ L j, unitPhase_add]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
      have hzero : unitPhase 0 = 1 := by simp [unitPhase]
      simp only [F.relativeHeading_zero, F.relativeHeading_one, F.relativeHeading_two,
        F.relativeHeading_three, hzero, mul_one, controller,
        Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
      ring

entries.label: thm:anchor-realizes
entries.title: thm:anchor-realizes
entries.chapter: Four active edges
entries.body:
Let $\kappa^0>0$ admit a regular anchor $(e,\bar L)$. There are an open
neighbourhood $V\subset(0,\infty)^n$ of $\kappa^0$ and a $C^1$ map
$h\colon V\to\R^n$ such that $h(\kappa)$ realizes $\kappa$ for every
$\kappa\in V$. In particular $\kappa^0$ has a realization.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily
lean.code:
theorem RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily
    {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} (A : RegularFourAnchor κ₀) (hκ₀ : ∀ i, 0 < κ₀ i) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  have hb := A.frame.lengths_nonneg_lt_edgeCap κ₀ A.halfLengths hκ₀
    A.positive A.start_lt A.finish_lt
  have hzero : closureMapR3 (κ₀, A.frame.lengths A.halfLengths) = 0 := by
    unfold closureMapR3
    rw [A.frame.closureGap_eq_controller, A.frame.turningSum_eq_controller, A.zero]
    simp
  have h01 := A.frame.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 1 by decide)
  have h12 := A.frame.strictMono (show (1 : Fin 4) < 2 by decide)
  have h23 := A.frame.strictMono (show (2 : Fin 4) < 3 by decide)
  have h3n := A.frame.lt_n 3
  exact nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily_of_active_surjective (by omega)
    hκ₀ hb hzero (A.frame.active_surj_of_controller_regular hκ₀ A.positive hb A.zero A.regular)

entries.chapter: Four active edges
entries.body:
Let $\kappa\in\R^{m+1}$, $m\ge1$, with $\kappa_a=\kappa_{a+1}$ for some
$0\le a\le m$, and let $\mu\in\R^m$ be obtained by deleting the entry $a$:
$\mu_i=\kappa_{\tau(i)}$ with $\tau(i)=i$ for $i<a$ and $\tau(i)=i+1$ for
$i\ge a$.
(i) If $\DFV(\kappa,c)$, then $\DFV(\mu,c)$.
(ii) If $(e,L)$ is a regular anchor for $\mu$, then $(\tau(e),L)$ is
a regular anchor for $\kappa$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ConstantRun.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_adjacent_unequal_producer
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_adjacent_unequal_producer
    (hbase : ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : ZMod m → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      4 ≤ m → (∀ i, 0 < μ i) → DFV μ c →
      (∀ i, μ i ≠ μ (i + 1)) → Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor μ))
    {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hdfv : DFV κ c) : Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  classical
  suffices hall : ∀ (k : ℕ) (w : ZMod k → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 < w i) → DFV w c → Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor w) by
    exact hall n κ c hκ hdfv
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro w c hw hd
    by_cases hne : ∀ i, w i ≠ w (i + 1)
    · exact hbase k w c hd.four_le_period hw hd hne
    · push Not at hne
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
      have hk := hd.four_le_period
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
        have hm : 0 < m := by omega
        let : NeZero m := ⟨by omega⟩
        let a : Fin (m + 1) := ⟨i.val, ZMod.val_lt i⟩
        have hdup : w (a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) = w ((a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) + 1) := by
          simpa only [a, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hi
        have hd' := eraseWord_dfv a hdup hd
        obtain ⟨A⟩ := ih m (by omega) (eraseWord w a) c (eraseWord_positive hw a) hd'
        exact ⟨restoreAnchor a hdup A⟩

entries.label: lem:peak
entries.title: lem:peak
entries.chapter: Four active edges
entries.body:
Let $\kappa$ be adjacent-unequal, let $0$ be a highest secondary peak relative
to $H$, and let $\kappa_0<\kappa_H$. Represent $H$ in $\{0,\dots,n-1\}$.
\begin{enumerate}
\item $H$ is the unique global maximum: $\kappa_i<\kappa_H$ for $i\ne H$.
\item $2\le H\le n-2$, and there is $a$ with $2\le a\le H$,
  $\kappa_{a-1}\le\kappa_0<\kappa_a$, and $\kappa$ strictly increasing on
  $\{a,\dots,H\}$.
\end{enumerate}

entries.label: prop:split
entries.title: prop:split
entries.chapter: Four active edges
entries.body:
Every positive adjacent-unequal word with a strict four-vertex window admits a
regular anchor, provided the following hold for all positive adjacent-unequal
words $\mu$ with $\mu_0=1$.
\begin{description}
\item[(R)] If $\mu\le1$ and $\mu_J=1$ for some $J\ne0$, then $\mu$ admits a
  regular anchor.
\item[(F)] If $0$ is a highest secondary peak relative to $H$, $\mu_H>1$ and
  $\varphi^+\ge0$, then $\mu$ admits a regular anchor.
\item[(N)] If $0$ is a highest secondary peak relative to $H$, $\mu_H>1$,
  $\varphi^+<0$ and $\varphi^-<0$, then $\mu$ admits a regular anchor.
\end{description}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_adjacent_unequal_dfv
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_adjacent_unequal_dfv
    {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hdfv : DFV κ c)
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) : Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  classical
  let : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨H, _, hmax⟩ := Finset.univ.exists_max_image κ
    (by simp : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod n)).Nonempty)
  have hmax' : ∀ i, κ i ≤ κ H := fun i => hmax i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  by_cases hrepeat : ∃ J, J ≠ H ∧ κ J = κ H
  · obtain ⟨J, hJH, hJ⟩ := hrepeat
    exact nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_global_maximum hκ hne hmax' hJ hJH
  · have hglobal : ∀ i, i ≠ H → κ i < κ H := by
      intro i hi
      apply lt_of_le_of_ne (hmax' i)
      intro he
      exact hrepeat ⟨i, hi, he⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_highestSecondaryPeak hdfv hne H
    exact hq.nonempty_regularFourAnchor hκ hne hglobal

entries.label: lem:identity
entries.title: Closure identity
entries.chapter: The four-length system
entries.body:
Let $q\ne0$ and let $\alpha_0,\alpha_3,\gamma_1,\gamma_2,\beta_1,\beta_3$ be
arbitrary real numbers. Define $S,T,\chi,\varepsilon_1,\varepsilon_3$ by the
formulas above, $\tau=\varepsilon_1+\varepsilon_3$, and
$E=\sin\alpha_0+\frac{\sin\gamma_1}qe^{\ii\beta_1}+\frac{\sin\gamma_2}qe^{\ii(\beta_1+T)}
+\sin\alpha_3\,e^{\ii(\beta_1+T+\beta_3)}$. Then
\begin{equation}\label{eq:identity}
  E=e^{-\ii\alpha_3}\Bigl(\sin S-\frac{\sin T}{q}\,e^{\ii\varepsilon_1}\Bigr)
  +\sin\alpha_3\,e^{-\ii S}\bigl(e^{\ii\tau}-1\bigr).
\end{equation}
If $L\in\Omega$ and the six numbers are its split angles and mixed turns, then
$\Ctrl(L)=(E,\tau)$, and $\Ctrl(L)=0$ if and only if
$\chi=\varepsilon_1=\varepsilon_3=0$.

entries.label: lem:rank
entries.title: lem:rank
entries.chapter: The four-length system
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $q\ge1$, $0<t<q$ and $h>0$, and let $L\in\Omega$ with
$\Ctrl(L)=0$. Then $A,B,C\in(0,1)$, $S+T>\pi$ and $\cos S<0$. If $D\Ctrl(L)$
is not onto, then
\begin{equation}\label{eq:minors}
  AD=BC\qquad\text{and}\qquad
  \cos S\,(A+B-AD)+\tfrac{\cos T}{q}\,(A+B-AB)=0 .
\end{equation}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_nonacute_incident
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_nonacute_incident
    {p t q h l : ℝ} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hphys : NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l L)
    (hzero : nativeLengthController p t q h l L = 0)
    (hT : Real.pi / 2 ≤ Real.arcsin (q * L 1) + Real.arcsin (q * L 2)) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l) L) := by
  let α := Real.arcsin (L 0)
  let β := Real.arcsin (L 3)
  let γ := Real.arcsin (q * L 1)
  let δ := Real.arcsin (q * L 2)
  let x : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![α + β, α, γ + δ]
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hacute {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (hz1 : z < 1) :
      Real.arcsin z ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) :=
    ⟨Real.arcsin_pos.mpr hz, Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.mpr hz1⟩
  rcases hphys with ⟨hpos, h0, hp0, ht1, hq1, hq2, hh2, hl3, h3⟩
  have ha : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) γ (x 2 - γ) := by
    dsimp [x]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]
    refine ⟨hacute (hpos 0) h0, hacute (hpos 3) h3,
      hacute (mul_pos hq0 (hpos 1)) hq1, hacute (mul_pos hq0 (hpos 2)) hq2, ?_⟩
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [Real.sin_arcsin (by nlinarith [hpos 2]) hq2.le]
    convert hh2 using 1
    field_simp
  have hL : incidentHalfLengths q γ x = L := by
    have hs {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (hz1 : z < 1) :
        Real.sin (Real.arcsin z) = z := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hz1.le
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [incidentHalfLengths, splitHalfLengths, x]
    · exact hs (hpos 0) h0
    · dsimp [γ]
      rw [hs (mul_pos hq0 (hpos 1)) hq1, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ne_of_gt hq0)]
    · rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
      dsimp [δ]
      rw [hs (mul_pos hq0 (hpos 2)) hq2, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ne_of_gt hq0)]
    · rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact hs (hpos 3) h3
  have hz : incidentNativeController p t q h l γ x = 0 := by
    have he := nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths (p := p) (t := t) (h := h) (l := l)
      (x := ![x 0, x 1, γ])
      (ne_of_gt hq0) ha.1 ha.2.1 ha.2.2.1 ha.2.2.2.1
    change nativeLengthController p t q h l (incidentHalfLengths q γ x) =
      incidentNativeController p t q h l γ x at he
    rw [← he, hL, hzero]
  rw [← hL]
  exact fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_incident_angles
    hp hp1 ht htq hl hl1 hh hhq hq hT ha hz

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_physical
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_physical
    {p t q h l : ℝ} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hphysical : NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l L)
    (hzero : nativeLengthController p t q h l L = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l) L) := by
  obtain ⟨T, x, ha, hL⟩ := exists_splitHalfLengths_of_physical (zero_lt_one.trans hq) hphysical
  have hsplit : nativeSplitController p t q h l T x = 0 := by
    rw [← nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths
      (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hq)) ha.1 ha.2.1 ha.2.2.1 ha.2.2.2.1, hL]
    exact hzero
  rw [← hL]
  exact fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq hqh ha hsplit

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_equal_pure
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_equal_pure
    {p t h l : ℝ} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1)
    (hphys : NativeLengthPhysical p t 1 h l L)
    (hzero : nativeLengthController p t 1 h l L = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t 1 h l) L) := by
  obtain ⟨T, x, ha, hL⟩ := exists_splitHalfLengths_of_physical zero_lt_one hphys
  have hz : nativeSplitController p t 1 h l T x = 0 := by
    rw [← nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths one_ne_zero
      ha.1 ha.2.1 ha.2.2.1 ha.2.2.2.1, hL, hzero]
  have hroots := (native_zero_iff_of_strictAngles (l := l) hp.le ht.le zero_lt_one ha).mp
    ⟨congrArg Prod.fst hz, congrArg Prod.snd hz⟩
  have hsum := angle_sums_gt_pi_of_seamLow_zero hp hp1 ht ht1 zero_lt_one
    ha.1 ha.2.2.1 hroots.2.1
  have heq : Real.sin (x 0) = Real.sin T := by
    simpa [chord] using sub_eq_zero.mp hroots.1
  have hT : Real.pi / 2 ≤ T := by
    by_contra hn
    have hs := Real.sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two
      (show -(Real.pi / 2) ≤ Real.pi - x 0 by linarith [ha.1.2, ha.2.1.2, Real.pi_pos])
      (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hn)) (show Real.pi - x 0 < T by linarith)
    rw [Real.sin_pi_sub, heq] at hs
    exact (lt_irrefl _ hs)
  have hi : incidentNativeController p t 1 h l (x 2) ![x 0, x 1, T] = 0 := hz
  have hia : StrictAngles 1 h (![x 0, x 1, T] 1)
      (![x 0, x 1, T] 0 - ![x 0, x 1, T] 1) (x 2)
      (![x 0, x 1, T] 2 - x 2) := ha
  have hr := fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_incident_angles
    hp hp1 ht ht1 hl hl1 hh hh1 le_rfl hT hia hi
  have hLi : incidentHalfLengths 1 (x 2) ![x 0, x 1, T] = L := hL
  rwa [hLi] at hr

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_acute_orthogonal
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_acute_orthogonal
    {p t q h l u v : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)
    (hu : u ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hv : v ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hphys : NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v))
    (hzero : nativeLengthController p t q h l (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v) = 0)
    (hT : Real.arcsin (q * orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v 1) +
      Real.arcsin (q * orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v 2) < Real.pi / 2) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
      (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v)) := by
  let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
  let α := Real.arcsin (L 0)
  let β := Real.arcsin (L 3)
  let γ := Real.arcsin (q * L 1)
  let δ := Real.arcsin (q * L 2)
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hα, hβ, hγ, hδ⟩ := coreHalfLengths_angles_acute hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  obtain ⟨a0, a3, a1, a2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_angle_data hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  have hs0 : Real.sin α = L 0 := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [a0.1.1]) a0.1.2.le
  have hs3 : Real.sin β = L 3 := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [a3.1.1]) a3.1.2.le
  have hs1 : Real.sin γ = q * L 1 := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [a1.1.1]) a1.1.2.le
  have hs2 : Real.sin δ = q * L 2 := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [a2.1.1]) a2.1.2.le
  have ha : StrictAngles q h α β γ δ := by
    refine ⟨hα, hβ, hγ, hδ, ?_⟩
    rw [hs2]
    have hh2 := hphys.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    convert hh2 using 1
    field_simp
    rfl
  have hL : ![Real.sin α, Real.sin γ / q, Real.sin δ / q, Real.sin β] = L := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hs0, hs3, hs1, hs2, ne_of_gt hq0]
  have hx : StrictAngles q h (![α + β, α, γ] 1)
      (![α + β, α, γ] 0 - ![α + β, α, γ] 1)
      (![α + β, α, γ] 2) ((γ + δ) - ![α + β, α, γ] 2) := by simpa using ha
  have hnative := nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths
    (p := p) (t := t) (h := h) (l := l) (x := ![α + β, α, γ]) (T := γ + δ)
    (ne_of_gt hq0) hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2.1
  have hz : (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ,
      turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) = 0 := by
    have he : nativeLengthController p t q h l
        ![Real.sin α, Real.sin γ / q, Real.sin δ / q, Real.sin β] =
        (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ, turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) := by
      simpa [splitHalfLengths, nativeSplitController] using hnative
    rw [← he, hL]
    exact hzero
  obtain ⟨htan1, htan2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_tan_products hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  have htaneq : Real.tan α * Real.tan δ = Real.tan β * Real.tan γ := htan1.trans htan2.symm
  have htan_gt : 1 < Real.tan α * Real.tan δ :=
    coreHalfLengths_tan_product_gt_one hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  have hcos := coreHalfLengths_normalized_cos hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  by_contra hn
  have hn' : ¬Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
      ![Real.sin α, Real.sin γ / q, Real.sin δ / q, Real.sin β]) := by rwa [hL]
  obtain ⟨z⟩ := incidentProjectiveRankLoss_of_angles hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq hh hhq
    ha hT htaneq htan_gt hcos hz hn'
  exact z.false

entries.label: lem:core
entries.title: Orthogonal core
entries.chapter: The four-length system
entries.body:
Let $q\ge1$ and write $\hat L=\hat L(u,v)$.
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\hat L_0^2+(v\hat L_2)^2=\hat L_3^2+(u\hat L_1)^2=(q\hat L_1)^2+(v\hat L_3)^2
  =(q\hat L_2)^2+(u\hat L_0)^2=1$.
\item Let $0<u,v<1$. The points $z_0=2\hat L_0\hat L_3$,
  $z_1=2\ii u\hat L_0\hat L_1$, $z_2=-2q\hat L_1\hat L_2$,
  $z_3=-2\ii v\hat L_2\hat L_3$ form a convex quadrilateral with perpendicular
  diagonals and sides $|z_{j+1}-z_j|=2\hat L_j$, the circle through
  $z_{j-1},z_j,z_{j+1}$ has curvature $k_j$, where $(k_0,\dots,k_3)=(1,u,q,v)$,
  and the exterior angle at $z_j$ is
  $\arcsin(k_j\hat L_{j-1})+\arcsin(k_j\hat L_j)$. The controller with readings
  $(1,u,q,v)$, $(u,q,v,1)$ vanishes at $\hat L$.
\item If $0<u,v<1$, $\hat L\in\Omega$ and $\rho_1(u,v)=\rho_3(u,v)=0$, then
  $\Ctrl(\hat L)=0$.
\item $\hat L(v,u)$ is $\hat L(u,v)$ in reverse order, so $\rho_3(u,v)$ equals
  $\rho_1(v,u)$ computed with $(p,t)$ replaced by $(l,h)$.
\item Let $q>1$ and $0<p,l<1$. Where defined,
  $\rho_1(0,v)=\arcsin(p\hat L_0)+\arcsin(t\hat L_1)$ with $\hat L_0>0$; on the
  face $v=1$, $\hat L_1=0$, $\hat L_0>0$, and $\rho_1(u,1)$ has the sign of
  $p-u$; and at the corner $(1,l)$, $\hat L_0=1$, $\hat L_1=\sigma(q,l)$ and
  $\rho_1(1,l)=\varphi(p,t,q,l)$ if $t\le q$. By (iv),
  $\rho_3(u,0)=\arcsin(h\hat L_2)+\arcsin(l\hat L_3)$ with $\hat L_3>0$,
  $\rho_3(1,v)$ has the sign of $l-v$, $\rho_3(1,1)=\arcsin l-\pi/2$, and
  $\rho_3(p,1)=\arcsin l+\arcsin(h\sigma(q,p))-\arcsin\sigma(q,p)-\pi/2$, which
  is $\varphi(l,h,q,p)$ if $h\le q$.
\end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_normalized_maximum
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_normalized_maximum
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H : ZMod n}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hle : ∀ i, κ i ≤ 1)
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (hzero : κ 0 = 1) (hH : κ H = 1) (hH0 : H ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := repeated_maximum_index_separation hne hzero hH hH0
  let F := firstPairFrame hlo hhi
  have hp1 : κ 1 < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle 1) (by
    intro he
    exact hne 0 (by simpa [hzero] using he.symm))
  have ht1 : κ (H - 1) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle (H - 1)) (by
    intro he
    exact hne (H - 1) (by simpa [hH] using he))
  have hh1 : κ (H + 1) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle (H + 1)) (by
    intro he
    exact hne H (by rw [hH, he]))
  have hl1 : κ (-1) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle (-1)) (by
    intro he
    exact hne (-1) (by simpa [hzero] using he))
  have hpred : ((H.val - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = H - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ H.val), ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, Nat.cast_one]
  have hlast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = -1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n), ZMod.natCast_self]
    simp
  have hnext : ((H.val + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = H + 1 := by simp
  have hstart : F.start κ = ![1, κ (H - 1), 1, κ (-1)] := by
    simpa [F, hpred, hlast, hH] using firstPairFrame_start hlo hhi κ hzero
  have hfinish : F.finish κ = ![κ 1, 1, κ (H + 1), 1] := by
    simpa [F, hnext, hH] using firstPairFrame_finish hlo hhi κ hzero
  exact F.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_maximum hstart hfinish
    (hκ 1) hp1 (hκ (H - 1)) ht1 (hκ (H + 1)) hh1 (hκ (-1)) hl1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_negative_terminals
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_negative_terminals
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H : ZMod n}
    (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H 0)
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (hzero : κ 0 = 1) (hH : 1 < κ H)
    (hglobal : ∀ i, i ≠ H → κ i < κ H)
    (hforward : firstPairFlag (κ 1) (κ (H - 1)) (κ H) (κ (-1)) < 0)
    (hbackward : firstPairFlag (κ (-1)) (κ (H + 1)) (κ H) (κ 1) < 0) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hak, hkb, hbn, _, _, _⟩ :=
    hq.exists_mountain hne (by simpa only [hzero] using hH)
  simp only [sub_zero] at hak hkb
  have hlo : 2 ≤ H.val := by omega
  have hhi : H.val + 2 ≤ n := by omega
  let : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let F := firstPairFrame hlo hhi
  have hp : κ 1 < 1 := by simpa [hzero] using hq.is_peak.2
  have hl : κ (-1) < 1 := by simpa [hzero] using hq.is_peak.1
  have ht : κ (H - 1) < κ H := hglobal _ (by simp)
  have hh : κ (H + 1) < κ H := hglobal _ (by simp)
  have hpred := natPred_val_residue hq.ne_global.symm
  have hlast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = -1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n), ZMod.natCast_self]
    simp
  have hstart : F.start κ = ![1, κ (H - 1), κ H, κ (-1)] := by
    simpa [F, hpred, hlast] using firstPairFrame_start hlo hhi κ hzero
  have hfinish : F.finish κ = ![κ 1, κ H, κ (H + 1), 1] := by
    simpa [F] using firstPairFrame_finish hlo hhi κ hzero
  exact F.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_negative_corners hstart hfinish
    (hκ 1) hp (hκ (-1)) hl (hκ (H - 1)) ht (hκ (H + 1)) hh hH hforward hbackward

entries.title: Local C1 choice of realizing polygons
entries.chapter: Continuity
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$ and let $\kappa^0\in\R^n$ be positive with a strict four-vertex
window~\eqref{eq:dfv}. There are an open neighbourhood $V$ of $\kappa^0$ and
$C^1$ maps $h\colon V\to\R^n$ and $P\colon V\to\C^n$ such that for every
$\kappa\in V$ the half-lengths $h(\kappa)$ realize $\kappa$ and $P(\kappa)$ is
the polygon developed from them by~\eqref{eq:vertices}, normalized by
$P_0=0$. In particular $P(\kappa)$ is simple, strictly convex and coherent,
with curvature $\kappa_i$ at every vertex.

entries.label: def:side-tangent-circle
entries.title: def:side-tangent-circle
entries.chapter: Circles tangent to consecutive sides
entries.body:
Let $P_i$ be the vertices of a counterclockwise strictly convex polygon,
with outward unit normal $N_i$ on edge $[P_i,P_{i+1}]$.
The \emph{inward three-line circle at edge $i$} has center $C_i$ and radius
$r_i>0$ satisfying
\begin{equation}\label{eq:side-tangent-distances}
 \langle N_{i-1},P_i-C_i\rangle
 =\langle N_i,P_i-C_i\rangle
 =\langle N_{i+1},P_{i+1}-C_i\rangle=r_i.
\end{equation}
Its central contact is required to lie in the open edge $(P_i,P_{i+1})$.
The contacts on the two neighbouring supporting lines may lie on their
extensions. The circle need not be contained in the entire polygon.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.ThreeLineCircle
Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization
lean.code:
structure IsSideTangentRealization [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (P N C : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop where
  radius_pos : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i
  simple : IsSimplePolygon P
  strict_convex : StrictConvexEdgeSupport P
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖N i‖ = 1
  oriented_edge : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ P (i + 1) - P i = ℓ • (Complex.I * N i)
  supporting : ∀ i j, ⟪N i, P j - P i⟫_ℝ ≤ 0
  circles : ∀ i, ThreeLineCircle P N i (C i) (ρ i)
  unique_circle : ∀ i D r, ThreeLineCircle P N i D r → D = C i ∧ r = ρ i
  central_contact : ∀ i, C i + ρ i • N i ∈ openSegment ℝ (P i) (P (i + 1))

entries.label: thm:side-tangent-converse
entries.title: thm:side-tangent-converse
entries.chapter: Circles tangent to consecutive sides
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$ and let $r_i>0$ be a cyclic sequence. Suppose that $r$ is
constant or that $c_i=r_{i-1}-r_i$ has four cyclic sign changes. Then a
simple strictly convex polygon realizes $r_i$ as the radii of its inward
three-line circles. Each center and radius are uniquely determined by the
three equations~\eqref{eq:side-tangent-distances}, and every central contact
lies in its open edge.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.tangent_sphere
lean.code:
theorem IsSideTangentRealization.tangent_sphere [NeZero n]
    {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C)
    (i k : ZMod n) (hk : k = i - 1 ∨ k = i ∨ k = i + 1) :
    Metric.sphere (C i) (ρ i) ∩ supportingLine P N k = {C i + ρ i • N k} :=
  sphere_inter_normalLine (h.unit_normal k) (h.radius_pos i).le (h.circle_line_distance i k hk)

theorem sideTangentConverse [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)

  obtain ⟨hρ, hconst | hdfv⟩ := h
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hconst
    exact sideTangentConverse_of_const hn ρ hρ hr
  · exact sideTangentConverse_of_dfv ρ hρ hdfv

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.isCyclicStrictTangentialFan_of_finite
lean.code:
theorem isCyclicStrictTangentialFan_of_finite [NeZero n] (s : ZMod n)
    {U Y : Fin n → ℂ} (h : IsStrictTangentialFan U Y) :
    IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan (fun i ↦ U ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i))
      (fun i ↦ Y ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)) := by
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ h.unit_normal _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.normal_cross_pos ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.vertex_eq ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i j hji hjs
    apply h.strict_support
    · exact fun he ↦ hji ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm.injective he)
    · intro he
      apply hjs
      apply (cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm.injective
      simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using he
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.contact_interior ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.edge_pos ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.edge_ne ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i j hji hjs
    simp only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ]
    apply h.cross_support
    · exact fun he ↦ hji ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm.injective he)
    · intro he
      apply hjs
      apply (cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm.injective
      simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using he

theorem exists_balanced_strictTangentialFan {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n)
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < c ⟨0, by omega⟩) (h₁ : c ⟨p, by omega⟩ < 0)
    (h₂ : 0 < c ⟨q, by omega⟩) (h₃ : c ⟨r, hr⟩ < 0) :
    ∃ U Y : Fin n → ℂ, IsStrictTangentialFan U Y ∧ ∑ i, c i • Y i = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hη₁, a, σ, ha, hσ, hsq, hd, hb⟩ :=
    exists_balanced_squareFan hn hp hpq hqr hr c hsum h₀ h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact ⟨fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)),
    fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i),
    projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁.le ha hσ hsq hd, hb⟩

entries.label: lem:side-tangent-scaling
entries.title: lem:side-tangent-scaling
entries.chapter: Circles tangent to consecutive sides
entries.body:
Let $Y_i$ be a counterclockwise strictly convex polygon circumscribed about the unit circle,
with its contacts in its open edges. If $r_i>0$ and
$\sum_i(r_{i-1}-r_i)Y_i=0$, the cyclic edge equations
\begin{equation}\label{eq:side-tangent-scaling}
 P_{i+1}-P_i=r_i(Y_{i+1}-Y_i)
\end{equation}
define a closed simple strictly convex polygon. Its inward three-line
circle at edge $i$ has center $C_i=P_i-r_iY_i$ and radius $r_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sum_scaled_edges
lean.code:
lemma sum_scaled_edges [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (Y : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ∑ i, ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i) = ∑ i, (ρ (i - 1) - ρ i) • Y i := by
  have he := Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight (1 : ZMod n))
    (fun i ↦ ρ i • Y (i + 1)) (fun j ↦ ρ (j - 1) • Y j) (fun i ↦ by simp)
  simpa only [smul_sub, sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] using
    congrArg (fun z : ℂ ↦ z - ∑ i, ρ i • Y i) he

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.strictSupport_of_positive_edge_scaling
lean.code:
theorem strictSupport_of_positive_edge_scaling [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {P Y : ZMod n → ℂ} (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hedge : ∀ i, P (i + 1) - P i = ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i)) :
    StrictConvexEdgeSupport P := by
  have hs := isSimplePolygon_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport hn hY
  have ho := positiveOrientation_of_strictSupport hn hY
  have ht := hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_of_simple_positiveOrientation hs ho
  refine strictSupport_of_polar P (cyclicEdgeHeading Y)
    (fun k ↦ ρ (k : ZMod n) * cyclicEdgeLength Y k)
    (fun k ↦ mul_pos (hρ _) (cyclicEdgeLength_pos hs k))
    (cyclicEdgeHeading_strictMono hs ho) (cyclicEdgeHeading_succ_lt_add_pi hs ho)
    (cyclicEdgeHeading_add_n ht) ?_
  intro k
  have he : cyclicEdge P k = ρ (k : ZMod n) • cyclicEdge Y k := by
    simpa [cyclicEdge, cyclicVertex, Nat.cast_add] using hedge (k : ZMod n)
  rw [he, ← cyclicEdge_length_mul_exp_heading hs k]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.real_smul, mul_assoc]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan
lean.code:
theorem realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) {U Y P : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hf : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y)
    (hedge : ∀ i, P (i + 1) - P i = ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i))
    (hs : StrictConvexEdgeSupport P) (hp : IsSimplePolygon P) : RealizesSideTangent ρ := by
  let N : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ U (i + 1)
  let C : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ P i - ρ i • Y i
  have he : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ P (i + 1) - P i = ℓ • (Complex.I * N i) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := hf.edge_pos i
    exact ⟨ρ i * ℓ, mul_pos (hρ i) hℓ, by rw [hedge i, heq, smul_smul]⟩
  refine ⟨P, N, C, hρ, hp, hs, fun i ↦ hf.unit_normal (i + 1), he,
    normal_support_of_strictSupport hs he, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [ThreeLineCircle, N, C, sub_add_cancel] using
      threeLineCircle_equations (hf.inner_left i) (hf.inner_right i) (hf.inner_right (i + 1))
        (hedge i)
  · intro i D r hD
    have heq : ⟪U i, P i - D⟫_ℝ = r ∧ ⟪U (i + 1), P i - D⟫_ℝ = r ∧
        ⟪U (i + 1 + 1), P (i + 1) - D⟫_ℝ = r := by
      simpa only [ThreeLineCircle, N, sub_add_cancel] using hD
    exact threeLineCircle_unique (hf.normal_cross_pos i).ne'
      (hf.inner_left i) (hf.inner_right i) (hf.inner_right (i + 1)) (hf.next_strict hn i)
      (hedge i) heq.1 heq.2.1 heq.2.2
  · intro i
    have hc := prescribedContact_mem_openSegment (ρ i) (hedge i) (hf.contact_interior i)
    simpa only [C, N, smul_sub, sub_add_eq_add_sub, add_sub_assoc] using hc

entries.title: lem:side-tangent-signs
entries.chapter: Circles tangent to consecutive sides
entries.body:
Let $Y_i$ be the cyclic vertices of a counterclockwise strictly convex polygon. If
$\sum_i c_i=0$ and $\sum_i c_iY_i=0$, then either every $c_i=0$ or the cyclic
coefficient sequence has at least four sign changes.

theorem sideTangentForward [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) :
    SideTangentAdmissible ρ := by
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hb⟩ := exists_strict_balanced_polygon_of_realization hn h
  refine ⟨h.radius_pos, ?_⟩
  rcases zero_or_dfv_of_strict_affine_balance hn hY (sum_radiusDifference ρ) hb with hz | hd
  · exact Or.inl (constant_of_radiusDifference_eq_zero hz)
  · exact Or.inr hd

entries.label: cor:side-tangent-iff
entries.title: cor:side-tangent-iff
entries.chapter: Circles tangent to consecutive sides
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$ and $r_i>0$. The sequence $r$ is realized by the inward
three-line circles of a simple strictly convex polygon, with their central
contacts in the open edges, if and only if $r$ is constant or its cyclic
differences $r_{i-1}-r_i$ have at least four sign changes.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible
lean.code:
theorem realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    RealizesSideTangent ρ ↔ SideTangentAdmissible ρ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, N, C, h⟩
    exact sideTangentForward (by omega) h
  · exact sideTangentConverse hn ρ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_iff_dfv

theorem realizesSideTangent_iff_dfv [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hnc : ¬ ∃ r, ∀ i, ρ i = r) :
    RealizesSideTangent ρ ↔ DFV (radiusDifference ρ) 0 := by
  rw [realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible hn]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.2.resolve_left hnc, fun h ↦ ⟨hρ, Or.inr h⟩⟩

entries.label: ex:turning-angle
entries.title: ex:turning-angle
entries.chapter: Turning-angle curvature and the mixed-sign problem
entries.body:
Take the quadrilateral with counterclockwise vertices
\[
 A=(0,0),\qquad B=(3,0),\qquad C=(4,1),\qquad D=(0,2).
\]
It is strictly convex. Its exterior turns, in the same order, are
\[
 \theta_A=\frac{\pi}{2},\qquad
 \theta_B=\frac{\pi}{4},\qquad
 \theta_C=\frac{\pi}{2}+\arctan\frac35,\qquad
 \theta_D=\frac{\pi}{2}+\arctan\frac14.
\]
Thus $\theta_B<\theta_A<\theta_D<\theta_C$. Around the cycle
$A,B,C,D$, only $B$ is a local minimum and only $C$ is a local maximum.
All four readings are distinct, so plateau conventions do not affect the
example.

entries.label: ex:mixed-sign
entries.title: ex:mixed-sign
entries.chapter: Turning-angle curvature and the mixed-sign problem
entries.body:
For any $M,\varepsilon>0$, consider the cyclic profile
\begin{equation}\label{eq:mixed-counterexample}
 \kappa=(M,-\varepsilon,M,-\varepsilon).
\end{equation}
It has two strict maxima and two strict minima, and satisfies
$\DFV(\kappa,0)$: the two negative readings lie below zero and the two
positive readings above it. Nevertheless, no oriented simple quadrilateral
has this signed Menger profile.

entries.chapter: The acute orthogonal case
entries.body:
There are no reals $x,y,m,a,b,\tau$ with $1<y<x$, $m>0$,
$a>0$, $0<b<\tfrac12$, $2a<\tau$ and $2b<\tau$ satisfying
\eqref{eq:affine}, \eqref{eq:E1} and~\eqref{eq:E2}.

entries.label: def:four_active_frame
entries.title: four actual edges
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
A \emph{frame} of size $n$ is a strictly increasing choice of natural
  numbers $0\le e_0<e_1<e_2<e_3<n$; write $r_j=e_j\bmod n\in\ZMod n$ for the
  corresponding original edges (they are pairwise distinct).  For
  half-lengths $L\in\RR^4$ the \emph{ambient lengths} are
  \[
    \ell(L)_i=\begin{cases}2L_j,& i=r_j,\\ 0,& i\notin\{r_0,r_1,r_2,r_3\},
    \end{cases}
  \]
  a linear map $\RR^4\to\RR^{\ZMod n}$.  For a word $\kappa$ the
  \emph{literal endpoint readings} of the selected edges are
  \[
    s_j=\operatorname{start}_j=\kappa(r_j),\qquad
    t_j=\operatorname{finish}_j=\kappa(r_j+1).
  \]
  These are actual readings of the original word at actual indices; no
  reading is replaced or merged.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.finish
lean.code: def finish (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (j : Fin 4) : ℝ := κ (F.residue j + 1)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.start
lean.code: def start (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (j : Fin 4) : ℝ := κ (F.residue j)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.lengths
lean.code:
noncomputable def lengths (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, if i = F.residue j then 2 * L j else 0

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame
lean.code:
structure Frame (n : ℕ) where
  edge : Fin 4 → ℕ
  strictMono : StrictMono edge
  lt_n : ∀ j, edge j < n

namespace Frame

variable {n : ℕ} (F : Frame n)

entries.label: def:four_active_controller
entries.title: the four-edge controller
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Put $\alpha_j=\arcsin(s_jL_j)$ and $\beta_j=\arcsin(t_jL_j)$, and define
  the grouped turns (subscripts of $\beta$ modulo four)
  \[
    \Theta_0=\beta_3+\alpha_0,\quad \Theta_1=\beta_0+\alpha_1,\quad
    \Theta_2=\beta_1+\alpha_2,\quad \Theta_3=\beta_2+\alpha_3 .
  \]
  With $u(x)=e^{ix}$ the controller is $C(L)=(C_1(L),C_2(L))\in\CC\times\RR$,
  \[
    C_1(L)=L_0+L_1u(\Theta_1)+L_2u(\Theta_1+\Theta_2)+
      L_3u(\Theta_1+\Theta_2+\Theta_3),\qquad
    C_2(L)=\Theta_0+\Theta_1+\Theta_2+\Theta_3-2\pi .
  \]
  Thus $C_1$ is the half-length closure of the four selected edges written in
  the heading gauge of edge $r_0$, and $C_2$ is the real turn defect.  The
  target $\CC\times\RR$ is three-dimensional, while there are four length
  variables: $C=0$ is three real equations in four unknowns.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.controller
lean.code:
noncomputable def controller (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℂ × ℝ :=
  let θ := F.turns κ L
  ((L 0 : ℂ) + (L 1 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1) +
    (L 2 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2) +
    (L 3 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3),
    θ 0 + θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3 - 2 * Real.pi)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.turns
lean.code:
noncomputable def turns (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ :=
  ![F.finishArc κ L 3 + F.startArc κ L 0,
    F.finishArc κ L 0 + F.startArc κ L 1,
    F.finishArc κ L 1 + F.startArc κ L 2,
    F.finishArc κ L 2 + F.startArc κ L 3]

entries.label: lem:four_active_embedding
entries.title: exact ambient embedding
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
For every word $\kappa$ (with $n\neq0$ for the turn) and \emph{every}
  $L\in\RR^4$,
  \[
    T(\kappa,\ell(L))-2\pi=C_2(L),\qquad
    E(\kappa,\ell(L))=2\,u\bigl(\psi_{e_0}(\kappa,\ell(L))\bigr)\,C_1(L).
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.closureGap_eq_controller
lean.code:
theorem closureGap_eq_controller (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    closureGap κ (F.lengths L) =
      2 * unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths L) (F.edge 0)) * (F.controller κ L).1 := by
  have hsum : closureGap κ (F.lengths L) =
      ∑ j : Fin 4, ((2 * L j : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths L) (F.edge j)) := by
    unfold closureGap vertexR2
    rw [F.sum_range_selected]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      change (F.lengths L (F.residue j) : ℂ) * _ = _
      rw [F.lengths_selected]
      rfl
    · intro k hk hne
      rw [F.lengths_unselected L (F.residue_ne_of_nat_ne hk hne)]
      simp
  rw [hsum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin 4, ((2 * L j : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths L) (F.edge 0)) *
          unitPhase (F.relativeHeading κ L j)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [F.heading_selected κ L j, unitPhase_add]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
      have hzero : unitPhase 0 = 1 := by simp [unitPhase]
      simp only [F.relativeHeading_zero, F.relativeHeading_one, F.relativeHeading_two,
        F.relativeHeading_three, hzero, mul_one, controller,
        Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
      ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.turningSum_eq_controller
lean.code:
theorem turningSum_eq_controller [NeZero n] (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    turningSum κ (F.lengths L) - 2 * Real.pi = (F.controller κ L).2 := by
  rw [F.turningSum_lengths, Fin.sum_univ_four]
  simp only [controller, turns, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val, Fin.isValue]
  ring

entries.label: lem:four_active_native_rank
entries.title: native derivative surjectivity on the active edges
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Let $\kappa>0$, $L_j>0$, $s_jL_j<1$ and $t_jL_j<1$ for all $j$, and
  $C(L)=0$.  Then $0\le\ell(L)_i<\operatorname{edgeCap}(\kappa)_i$ for
  every $i$, and for all $v\in\RR^4$
  \[
    DG(\ell(L))\,\ell(v)=\bigl(2u(\psi_{e_0})\,DC_1(L)v,\;DC_2(L)v\bigr),
  \]
  where $G(\ell)=(E(\kappa,\ell),T(\kappa,\ell)-2\pi)$ is the ambient
  length-only closure map.  Consequently, if $DC(L)\colon\RR^4\to\CC\times\RR$
  is surjective, then every $y\in\CC\times\RR$ is $DG(\ell(L))\,b$ for some
  $b$ with $b_i=0$ at every $i$ where $\ell(L)_i=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.active_surj_of_controller_regular
lean.code:
theorem active_surj_of_controller_regular [NeZero n]
    {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hL : ∀ j, 0 < L j)
    (hbounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ F.lengths L i ∧ F.lengths L i < edgeCap κ i)
    (hzero : F.controller κ L = 0)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (F.controller κ) L)) :
    ∀ y : ℂ × ℝ, ∃ b : ZMod n → ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ (fun ell => closureMapR3 (κ, ell)) (F.lengths L) b = y ∧
        ∀ i, F.lengths L i = 0 → b i = 0 := by
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F.controller κ) L := by
    by_contra hn
    rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hn] at hsurj
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj (0, 1)
    have := congrArg Prod.snd hv
    norm_num at this
  let g : ℂ := 2 * unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths L) (F.edge 0))
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  intro y
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj (y.1 / g, y.2)
  refine ⟨F.lengths v, ?_, F.lengths_direction_supported L v hL⟩
  rw [F.fderiv_lengths_at_controller_zero hκ hbounds hd hzero, hv]
  change (g * (y.1 / g), y.2) = y
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hg]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.lengths_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
lean.code:
theorem lengths_nonneg_lt_edgeCap (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hL : ∀ j, 0 < L j)
    (hstart : ∀ j, F.start κ j * L j < 1)
    (hfinish : ∀ j, F.finish κ j * L j < 1) :
    ∀ i, 0 ≤ F.lengths L i ∧ F.lengths L i < edgeCap κ i := by
  intro i
  by_cases hi : ∃ j, i = F.residue j
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hi
    rw [F.lengths_selected]
    refine ⟨(mul_pos (by norm_num) (hL j)).le, ?_⟩
    have hm : 0 < max (κ (F.residue j)) (κ (F.residue j + 1)) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hκ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    rw [edgeCap, lt_div_iff₀ hm]
    have hs := hstart j
    have hf := hfinish j
    change κ (F.residue j) * L j < 1 at hs
    change κ (F.residue j + 1) * L j < 1 at hf
    rcases le_total (κ (F.residue j)) (κ (F.residue j + 1)) with hh | hh
    · rw [max_eq_right hh]
      nlinarith
    · rw [max_eq_left hh]
      nlinarith
  · have hoff : ∀ j, i ≠ F.residue j := fun j he => hi ⟨j, he⟩
    rw [F.lengths_unselected L hoff]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, (edgeCap_pos (hκ _) (hκ _)).1⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.fderiv_lengths_at_controller_zero
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_lengths_at_controller_zero [NeZero n]
    {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i)
    (hbounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ F.lengths L i ∧ F.lengths L i < edgeCap κ i)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F.controller κ) L)
    (hzero : F.controller κ L = 0) (v : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun ell => closureMapR3 (κ, ell)) (F.lengths L) (F.lengths v) =
      (2 * unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths L) (F.edge 0)) *
        (fderiv ℝ (F.controller κ) L v).1,
        (fderiv ℝ (F.controller κ) L v).2) := by
  let g : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℂ := fun X =>
    2 * unitPhase (heading κ (F.lengths X) (F.edge 0))
  have hw := strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap hκ hbounds
  have hheading := contDiffAt_heading_lengths (F.edge 0)
    (fun j _ => hw (j : ZMod n))
  have hheading' : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun X : Fin 4 → ℝ => heading κ (F.lengths X) (F.edge 0)) L := by
    exact (hheading.differentiableAt one_ne_zero).comp L F.lengthsCLM.differentiableAt
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g L := by
    dsimp [g, unitPhase]
    fun_prop
  have hprod := (hg.hasFDerivAt.mul hd.hasFDerivAt.fst).prodMk hd.hasFDerivAt.snd
  have hfun : (fun X : Fin 4 → ℝ => (g X * (F.controller κ X).1,
      (F.controller κ X).2)) = (fun X => closureMapR3 (κ, F.lengths X)) := by
    funext X
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact (F.closureGap_eq_controller κ X).symm
    · exact (F.turningSum_eq_controller κ X).symm
  change HasFDerivAt (fun X : Fin 4 → ℝ =>
    (g X * (F.controller κ X).1, (F.controller κ X).2)) _ L at hprod
  rw [hfun] at hprod
  have hamb := (lengthClosureMap_hasStrictFDerivAt_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap hκ hbounds).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp := hamb.comp L F.lengthsCLM.hasFDerivAt
  have heq := hcomp.unique hprod
  have hv := congrArg (fun A : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℂ × ℝ) => A v) heq
  simpa [g, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hzero, smul_eq_mul] using hv

entries.label: lem:regular_four_reembed
entries.title: endpoint-preserving reembedding
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Let $F$ be a frame of size $m$ for a word $\mu$ and $G$ a frame of size
  $n$ for a word $\kappa$, with the same literal readings:
  $\operatorname{start}^G_\kappa=\operatorname{start}^F_\mu$ and
  $\operatorname{finish}^G_\kappa=\operatorname{finish}^F_\mu$.  Then
  $C^G_\kappa=C^F_\mu$ as functions on $\RR^4$.  Hence a regular anchor
  $(F,L)$ for $\mu$ yields the regular anchor $(G,L)$ for $\kappa$, with the
  same half-lengths.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.reembed
lean.code:
noncomputable def reembed {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (A : RegularFourAnchor μ) (G : FourActiveSlots.Frame n)
    (hstart : G.start κ = A.frame.start μ) (hfinish : G.finish κ = A.frame.finish μ) :
    RegularFourAnchor κ where
  frame := G
  halfLengths := A.halfLengths
  positive := A.positive
  start_lt := by simpa only [hstart] using A.start_lt
  finish_lt := by simpa only [hfinish] using A.finish_lt
  zero := by rw [controller_eq_of_endpoints hstart hfinish]; exact A.zero
  regular := by rw [controller_eq_of_endpoints hstart hfinish]; exact A.regular

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.controller_eq_of_endpoints
lean.code:
theorem controller_eq_of_endpoints {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {F : FourActiveSlots.Frame m} {G : FourActiveSlots.Frame n}
    (hstart : G.start κ = F.start μ) (hfinish : G.finish κ = F.finish μ) :
    G.controller κ = F.controller μ := by
  funext L
  simp only [FourActiveSlots.Frame.controller, FourActiveSlots.Frame.turns,
    FourActiveSlots.Frame.startArc, FourActiveSlots.Frame.finishArc, hstart, hfinish]

entries.label: thm:regular_four_anchor_realizes
entries.title: a regular anchor realizes the whole word
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Let $n\neq0$, let $\kappa\colon\ZMod n\to\RR$ be positive, and let
  $\kappa$ have a regular four-edge anchor.  Then
  $\operatorname{RealizesR2}(\kappa)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.realizesR2
Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.realizesR2_of_controller_regular
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_of_controller_regular [NeZero n]
    {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hL : ∀ j, 0 < L j)
    (hstart : ∀ j, F.start κ j * L j < 1)
    (hfinish : ∀ j, F.finish κ j * L j < 1)
    (hzero : F.controller κ L = 0)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (F.controller κ) L)) :
    RealizesR2 κ := by
  have hbounds := F.lengths_nonneg_lt_edgeCap κ L hκ hL hstart hfinish
  have h01 := F.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 1 by decide)
  have h12 := F.strictMono (show (1 : Fin 4) < 2 by decide)
  have h23 := F.strictMono (show (2 : Fin 4) < 3 by decide)
  have h3n := F.lt_n 3
  have hn : 3 ≤ n := by omega
  have hambzero : closureMapR3 (κ, F.lengths L) = 0 := by
    unfold closureMapR3
    rw [F.closureGap_eq_controller, F.turningSum_eq_controller, hzero]
    simp
  exact realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor_of_active_surj hn hκ hbounds hambzero
    (F.active_surj_of_controller_regular hκ hL hbounds hzero hsurj)

entries.label: lem:four_active_dfv_collapse
entries.title: DFV survives a monotone periodic collapse
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Let $r\colon\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ be monotone with $r(i+n)=r(i)+m$ and
  $\mu(r(i))=\kappa(i)$ for all $i$.  If $\operatorname{DFV}(\kappa;c)$
  then $\operatorname{DFV}(\mu;c)$.  Moreover any DFV word has length at
  least $4$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV.four_le_period
lean.code:
theorem DFV.four_le_period {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hdfv : DFV κ c) : 4 ≤ n := by
  obtain ⟨i₁, i₂, i₃, i₄, h12, h23, h34, h41, _⟩ := hdfv
  omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV.of_monotone_periodic_collapse
lean.code:
theorem DFV.of_monotone_periodic_collapse
    {n m : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    {r : ℕ → ℕ} (hr : Monotone r)
    (hperiod : ∀ i, r (i + n) = r i + m)
    (hreading : ∀ i, μ (r i : ZMod m) = κ (i : ZMod n))
    (hdfv : DFV κ c) : DFV μ c := by
  obtain ⟨i₁, i₂, i₃, i₄, h12, h23, h34, h41, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hdfv
  have hm1 : c < μ (r i₁ : ZMod m) := by rwa [hreading]
  have hm2 : μ (r i₂ : ZMod m) < c := by rwa [hreading]
  have hm3 : c < μ (r i₃ : ZMod m) := by rwa [hreading]
  have hm4 : μ (r i₄ : ZMod m) < c := by rwa [hreading]
  have hr12 : r i₁ < r i₂ := by
    have hle := hr h12.le
    by_contra hnot
    have he : r i₁ = r i₂ := by omega
    rw [he] at hm1
    linarith
  have hr23 : r i₂ < r i₃ := by
    have hle := hr h23.le
    by_contra hnot
    have he : r i₂ = r i₃ := by omega
    rw [he] at hm2
    linarith
  have hr34 : r i₃ < r i₄ := by
    have hle := hr h34.le
    by_contra hnot
    have he : r i₃ = r i₄ := by omega
    rw [he] at hm3
    linarith
  have hr41 : r i₄ < r i₁ + m := by
    have hle : r i₄ ≤ r i₁ + m := by
      simpa [hperiod] using hr h41.le
    by_contra hnot
    have he : r i₄ = r i₁ + m := by omega
    rw [he] at hm4
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero] at hm4
    linarith
  exact ⟨r i₁, r i₂, r i₃, r i₄, hr12, hr23, hr34, hr41, hm1, hm2, hm3, hm4⟩

entries.label: lem:four_active_erase_restore
entries.title: erase a repeated reading and restore the frame
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Let $w\colon\ZMod(m+1)\to\RR$ with $m\ne0$ and $w_a=w_{a+1}$ for some
  $0\le a\le m$.  Let $\operatorname{skip}_a(j)=j$ for $j<a$ and $j+1$
  otherwise, and let $w'\colon\ZMod m\to\RR$, $w'_j=w_{\operatorname{skip}_a(j)}$
  (delete entry $a$).  Then $w'$ is positive when $w$ is, and
  $\operatorname{DFV}(w;c)\Rightarrow\operatorname{DFV}(w';c)$.  Every
  frame $e_0<\dots<e_3<m$ of $w'$ gives the frame
  $\operatorname{skip}_a(e_0)<\dots<\operatorname{skip}_a(e_3)<m+1$ of $w$
  with identical start and finish functions; hence every regular anchor of
  $w'$ reembeds as a regular anchor of $w$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ConstantRun.restoreFrame
lean.code:
def restoreFrame {m : ℕ} (F : FourActiveSlots.Frame m) (a : Fin (m + 1)) :
    FourActiveSlots.Frame (m + 1) where
  edge := fun j => skip a.val (F.edge j)
  strictMono := (skip_strictMono a.val).comp F.strictMono
  lt_n := fun j => skip_lt (F.lt_n j)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ConstantRun.eraseWord_dfv
lean.code:
theorem eraseWord_dfv {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {κ : ZMod (m + 1) → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (a : Fin (m + 1))
    (hdup : κ (a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) = κ ((a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) + 1))
    (hdfv : DFV κ c) : DFV (eraseWord κ a) c :=
  hdfv.of_monotone_periodic_collapse (collapse_mono m a.val)
    (collapse_add_period m a.val) (eraseWord_collapse a hdup)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ConstantRun.restoreFrame_finish
lean.code:
theorem restoreFrame_finish {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (F : FourActiveSlots.Frame m)
    {κ : ZMod (m + 1) → ℝ} (a : Fin (m + 1))
    (hdup : κ (a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) = κ ((a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) + 1)) :
    (restoreFrame F a).finish κ = F.finish (eraseWord κ a) := by
  funext j
  exact (eraseWord_finish a hdup (F.lt_n j)).symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ConstantRun.restoreAnchor
lean.code:
noncomputable def restoreAnchor {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {κ : ZMod (m + 1) → ℝ}
    (a : Fin (m + 1))
    (hdup : κ (a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) = κ ((a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) + 1))
    (A : RegularFourAnchor (eraseWord κ a)) : RegularFourAnchor κ :=
  A.reembed (restoreFrame A.frame a) (restoreFrame_start A.frame κ a)
    (restoreFrame_finish A.frame a hdup)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ConstantRun.eraseWord
lean.code:
def eraseWord {m : ℕ} (κ : ZMod (m + 1) → ℝ) (a : Fin (m + 1)) :
    ZMod m → ℝ := fun i => κ (skip a.val i.val : ZMod (m + 1))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ConstantRun.restoreFrame_start
lean.code:
theorem restoreFrame_start {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (F : FourActiveSlots.Frame m)
    (κ : ZMod (m + 1) → ℝ) (a : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (restoreFrame F a).start κ = F.start (eraseWord κ a) := by
  funext j
  simp [FourActiveSlots.Frame.start, FourActiveSlots.Frame.residue,
    restoreFrame, eraseWord, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (F.lt_n j)]

entries.label: thm:four_active_restore_runs
entries.title: finite restoration of constant runs
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Assume the \emph{producer statement}: for every $m$ and every
  $\mu\colon\ZMod m\to\RR$ with $4\le m$, $\mu>0$, $\operatorname{DFV}(\mu;c)$
  and $\mu_i\ne\mu_{i+1}$ for all $i$, $\mu$ has a regular four-edge anchor.
  Then every positive word $\kappa$ with $\operatorname{DFV}(\kappa;c)$ has a
  regular four-edge anchor.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ConstantRun.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_adjacent_unequal_producer
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_adjacent_unequal_producer
    (hbase : ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : ZMod m → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      4 ≤ m → (∀ i, 0 < μ i) → DFV μ c →
      (∀ i, μ i ≠ μ (i + 1)) → Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor μ))
    {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hdfv : DFV κ c) : Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  classical
  suffices hall : ∀ (k : ℕ) (w : ZMod k → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 < w i) → DFV w c → Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor w) by
    exact hall n κ c hκ hdfv
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro w c hw hd
    by_cases hne : ∀ i, w i ≠ w (i + 1)
    · exact hbase k w c hd.four_le_period hw hd hne
    · push Not at hne
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
      have hk := hd.four_le_period
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
        have hm : 0 < m := by omega
        let : NeZero m := ⟨by omega⟩
        let a : Fin (m + 1) := ⟨i.val, ZMod.val_lt i⟩
        have hdup : w (a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) = w ((a.val : ZMod (m + 1)) + 1) := by
          simpa only [a, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hi
        have hd' := eraseWord_dfv a hdup hd
        obtain ⟨A⟩ := ih m (by omega) (eraseWord w a) c (eraseWord_positive hw a) hd'
        exact ⟨restoreAnchor a hdup A⟩

entries.label: lem:four_active_transport
entries.title: anchors transport under scaling, rotation and reflection
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Let $\kappa>0$.  A regular anchor of $\operatorname{normalizedAt}(\kappa,q)$
  gives one of $\kappa$; and $\kappa\circ(-)$ has a regular anchor iff
  $\kappa$ has.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_comp_neg_iff
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_comp_neg_iff (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (-i))) ↔ Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A⟩
    exact ⟨of_comp_neg hκ A⟩
  · rintro ⟨A⟩
    exact ⟨A.comp_neg hκ⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_normalizedAt
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_normalizedAt
    {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {q : ZMod n}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i)
    (hA : Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor (normalizedAt κ q))) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := hA
  have B := A.scale (hκ q)
  have B' : RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (i + q)) := by
    convert B using 1
    funext i
    dsimp only [Gluck.Discrete.normalizedAt]
    field_simp [(hκ q).ne']
  exact ⟨RegularFourAnchor.of_comp_add q hκ B'⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.scale
lean.code:
noncomputable def scale (A : RegularFourAnchor κ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    RegularFourAnchor (fun i => s * κ i) where
  frame := A.frame
  halfLengths := s⁻¹ • A.halfLengths
  positive j := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs) (A.positive j)
  start_lt := by
    intro j
    have hproduct : A.frame.start (fun i => s * κ i) j * (s⁻¹ • A.halfLengths) j =
        A.frame.start κ j * A.halfLengths j := by
      simp [Frame.start, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs.ne', mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
    rw [hproduct]
    exact A.start_lt j
  finish_lt := by
    intro j
    have hproduct : A.frame.finish (fun i => s * κ i) j * (s⁻¹ • A.halfLengths) j =
        A.frame.finish κ j * A.halfLengths j := by
      simp [Frame.finish, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs.ne', mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
    rw [hproduct]
    exact A.finish_lt j
  zero := by
    rw [A.frame.controller_scale κ hs.ne']
    simp [hs.ne', A.zero]
  regular := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := A.regular ((s : ℂ) * y.1, y.2)
    refine ⟨s⁻¹ • v, ?_⟩
    rw [A.frame.fderiv_controller_scale hs.ne' A.differentiableAt_controller]
    simp [hs.ne', hv]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.of_comp_add
lean.code:
noncomputable def of_comp_add (a : ZMod n) (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i)
    (A : RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (i + a))) : RegularFourAnchor κ := by
  have B := A.comp_add (fun i => hκ _) (-a)
  simpa only [neg_add_cancel_right] using B

entries.label: def:four_active_secondary_peak
entries.title: highest secondary peak
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Given a marked index $H$ of a word $\kappa$, an index $q$ is a
  \emph{highest secondary peak} if $q\ne H$, $q$ is a strict local maximum
  ($\kappa_{q-1}<\kappa_q>\kappa_{q+1}$), and $\kappa_i\le\kappa_q$ for every
  strict local maximum $i\ne H$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak
lean.code:
structure HighestSecondaryPeak (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (H q : ZMod n) : Prop where
  ne_global : q ≠ H
  is_peak : IsStrictLocalMax κ q
  maximal : ∀ i, i ≠ H → IsStrictLocalMax κ i → κ i ≤ κ q

entries.label: lem:four_active_mountain
entries.title: selection and the single mountain
entries.chapter: The coherent discrete converse for every \texorpdfstring{$n\ge4$}{n >= 4}: regular four-edge anchors
entries.body:
Let $\kappa$ be adjacent-unequal with $\operatorname{DFV}(\kappa;c)$.  For
  every $H$ a highest secondary peak $q$ exists.  If moreover
  $\kappa_q<\kappa_H$ then there are $2\le a\le(H-q)\le b\le n-2$ (natural
  offsets from $q$) such that, for $j<n$, $\kappa_{q+j}>\kappa_q$ iff
  $a\le j\le b$, and $j\mapsto\kappa_{q+j}$ is strictly increasing on
  $[a,H-q]$ and strictly decreasing on $[H-q,b]$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_highestSecondaryPeak
lean.code:
theorem exists_highestSecondaryPeak {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hdfv : DFV κ c) (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) (H : ZMod n) :
    ∃ q, HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hi, hj⟩ := hdfv.exists_two_strictLocalMax hne
  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ZMod n => i ≠ H ∧ IsStrictLocalMax κ i)
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    by_cases hiH : i = H
    · exact ⟨j, by simp [s, hj, show j ≠ H by intro e; exact hij (hiH.trans e.symm)]⟩
    · exact ⟨i, by simp [s, hiH, hi]⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hmax⟩ := s.exists_max_image κ hs
  have hqm : q ≠ H ∧ IsStrictLocalMax κ q := by simpa [s] using hq
  exact ⟨q, hqm.1, hqm.2, fun i hiH hi => hmax i (by simp [s, hiH, hi])⟩

omit [NeZero n] in

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.exists_mountain
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.exists_mountain {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) (hH : κ q < κ H) :
    ∃ a b : ℕ, 2 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ (H - q).val ∧ (H - q).val ≤ b ∧ b + 2 ≤ n ∧
      (∀ j < n, κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) ↔ a ≤ j ∧ j ≤ b) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun j : ℕ => κ (q + (j : ZMod n))) (Icc a (H - q).val) ∧
      StrictAntiOn (fun j : ℕ => κ (q + (j : ZMod n))) (Icc (H - q).val b) := by
  classical
  let s := (Finset.range n).filter (fun j : ℕ => κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)))
  have hmem : ∀ j, j ∈ s ↔ j < n ∧ κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) := by
    intro j; simp [s]
  have hHmem : (H - q).val ∈ s := by
    rw [hmem]
    refine ⟨ZMod.val_lt _, ?_⟩
    simpa [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hH
  have hs : s.Nonempty := ⟨_, hHmem⟩
  let a := s.min' hs
  let b := s.max' hs
  have ha := (hmem a).mp (s.min'_mem hs)
  have hb := (hmem b).mp (s.max'_mem hs)
  have haH : a ≤ (H - q).val := s.min'_le _ hHmem
  have hHb : (H - q).val ≤ b := s.le_max' _ hHmem
  have ha2 : 2 ≤ a := by
    by_contra h
    have ha01 : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
    rcases ha01 with ha0 | ha1
    · simpa [ha0] using ha.2
    · have hh : κ q < κ (q + 1) := by simpa [ha1] using ha.2
      exact (not_lt_of_gt hq.is_peak.2) hh
  have hb2 : b + 2 ≤ n := by
    by_contra h
    have hbn : b = n - 1 := by omega
    have hidx : q + (b : ZMod n) = q - 1 := by
      rw [hbn, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n), ZMod.natCast_self]
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hh : κ q < κ (q - 1) := by simpa [hidx] using hb.2
    exact (not_lt_of_gt hq.is_peak.1) hh
  have hinterval : ∀ j < n, κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) ↔ a ≤ j ∧ j ≤ b := by
    intro j hj
    constructor
    · intro hh
      have hjmem := (hmem j).mpr ⟨hj, hh⟩
      exact ⟨s.min'_le _ hjmem, s.le_max' _ hjmem⟩
    · rintro ⟨haj, hjb⟩
      exact hq.high_interval hne ha.1 hb.1 ha.2 hb.2 haj hjb
  refine ⟨a, b, ha2, haH, hHb, hb2, hinterval, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    rcases hi with ⟨hia, hiH⟩
    rcases hj with ⟨hja, hjH⟩
    apply hq.rising_lt hne hij hjH
    exact (hinterval i (by omega)).mpr ⟨hia, by omega⟩
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    rcases hi with ⟨hiH, hib⟩
    rcases hj with ⟨hjH, hjb⟩
    apply hq.falling_lt hne hiH hij (by omega)
    exact (hinterval j (by omega)).mpr ⟨by omega, hjb⟩
