entries.label: lem:nfp_compact_boundary_ivt
entries.title: compact-strip IVT with a boundary derivative
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Let $P\subseteq\RR^2$ be open, $F$ continuous on $P$, $a_{\min}<a$ and
  $\mathrm{lo}<\mathrm{hi}$.  Assume $(a,y)\in P$ for every
  $y\in[\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi}]$, $F(a,\mathrm{lo})\le0<F(a,\mathrm{hi})$,
  and, if $F(a,\mathrm{lo})=0$, that $x\mapsto F(x,\mathrm{lo})$ has a
  positive derivative at $a$.  Then there are $x\in(a_{\min},a)$ and
  $y\in(\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi})$ with $(x,y)\in P$ and $F(x,y)=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.CompactBoundaryIVT.eventually_lt_left_of_hasDerivAt_pos
lean.code:
theorem eventually_lt_left_of_hasDerivAt_pos {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a d : ℝ}
    (hd : HasDerivAt f d a) (hdpos : 0 < d) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[<] a, f x < f a := by
  have hfilter : 𝓝[<] a ≤ 𝓝[≠] a :=
    nhdsWithin_mono a (fun x hx ↦ ne_of_lt hx)
  have hslope : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[<] a, 0 < slope f a x :=
    ((hd.tendsto_slope.mono_left hfilter).eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hdpos))
  filter_upwards [hslope, eventually_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hs hx
  have hxa : x < a := hx
  rw [slope_def_field] at hs
  have hm := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hs (sub_neg.mpr hxa)
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_lt hxa))] at hm
  exact sub_neg.mp hm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.CompactBoundaryIVT.exists_inward_zero_of_boundary_derivative
lean.code:
theorem exists_inward_zero_of_boundary_derivative
    {F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {P : ℝ → ℝ → Prop} {a amin lo hi : ℝ}
    (hamin : amin < a) (hlohi : lo < hi)
    (hopen : IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ | P z.1 z.2})
    (hphysical : ∀ y ∈ Icc lo hi, P a y)
    (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) {z : ℝ × ℝ | P z.1 z.2})
    (hleft : F a lo ≤ 0) (hright : 0 < F a hi)
    (hderiv : F a lo = 0 → ∃ d > 0, HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ F x lo) d a) :
    ∃ x ∈ Ioo amin a, ∃ y ∈ Ioo lo hi, P x y ∧ F x y = 0 := by
  apply exists_inward_zero hamin hlohi hopen hphysical hcontinuous ?_ hright
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hleft with hneg | heq
  · have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x ↦ F x lo) a :=
      (hcontinuous.continuousAt (hopen.mem_nhds
        (hphysical lo (left_mem_Icc.mpr hlohi.le)))).comp
          (continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const)
    exact (hc.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hneg)).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  · obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hd⟩ := hderiv heq
    simpa only [heq] using eventually_lt_left_of_hasDerivAt_pos hd hdpos

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.CompactBoundaryIVT.exists_inward_zero
lean.code:
theorem exists_inward_zero
    {F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {P : ℝ → ℝ → Prop} {a amin lo hi : ℝ}
    (hamin : amin < a) (hlohi : lo < hi)
    (hopen : IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ | P z.1 z.2})
    (hphysical : ∀ y ∈ Icc lo hi, P a y)
    (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) {z : ℝ × ℝ | P z.1 z.2})
    (hleft : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[<] a, F x lo < 0)
    (hright : 0 < F a hi) :
    ∃ x ∈ Ioo amin a, ∃ y ∈ Ioo lo hi, P x y ∧ F x y = 0 := by
  have hstrip : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, ∀ y ∈ Icc lo hi, P x y :=
    isCompact_Icc.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
      (fun y hy ↦ hopen.mem_nhds (hphysical y hy))
  have hcontRight : ContinuousAt (fun x ↦ F x hi) a :=
    (hcontinuous.continuousAt (hopen.mem_nhds (hphysical hi (right_mem_Icc.mpr hlohi.le)))).comp
      (continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const)
  have hpositive : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, 0 < F x hi :=
    hcontRight.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hright)
  have hamin' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, amin < x := eventually_gt_nhds hamin
  let : NeBot (𝓝[<] a) := nhdsWithin_Iio_neBot (le_refl a)
  have hchoose : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[<] a,
      amin < x ∧ x < a ∧ F x lo < 0 ∧ 0 < F x hi ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Icc lo hi, P x y := by
    filter_upwards [hamin'.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      eventually_mem_nhdsWithin, hleft,
      hpositive.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      hstrip.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with x hx0 hx1 hxlo hxhi hxP
    exact ⟨hx0, hx1, hxlo, hxhi, hxP⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx1, hxlo, hxhi, hxP⟩ := hchoose.exists
  have hcontSlice : ContinuousOn (F x) (Icc lo hi) :=
    hcontinuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
      (fun y hy ↦ hxP y hy)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyzero⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hlohi.le hcontSlice ⟨hxlo.le, hxhi.le⟩
  have hlo : lo < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hy.1 (by
    intro heq
    subst y
    linarith)
  have hhi : y < hi := lt_of_le_of_ne hy.2 (by
    intro heq
    subst y
    linarith)
  exact ⟨x, ⟨hx0, hx1⟩, y, ⟨hlo, hhi⟩, hxP y hy, hyzero⟩

entries.label: def:nfp_interior_chart
entries.title: the arctangent chart
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
For $(\alpha,\gamma)$ put $\varphi=\Lambda(\alpha,\gamma)-\alpha$ and
  \[
    \mathsf D=q\cos\varphi-\cos\gamma,\qquad
    \mathsf N=\sin\gamma-q\sin\varphi,\qquad
    \delta=\arctan(\mathsf N/\mathsf D),\qquad
    \beta=\pi-\delta-\Lambda(\alpha,\gamma),
  \]
  and $\mathcal K(\alpha,\gamma)=K(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)$, the high seam
  along the chart.  The point is \emph{interior-physical} if
  \[
    \mathsf D>0,\qquad \mathsf N>0,\qquad \beta\in(0,\pi/2),\qquad
    (h/q)\sin\delta<1 .
  \]
  The two free angles $\alpha,\gamma$ are not constrained by this
  predicate: they may lie on the construction boundary $\alpha=\pi/2$ or
  $\gamma=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorBeta
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorBeta (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi - interiorDelta p t q α γ - lowTurn p t q α γ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorD
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorD (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  q * Real.cos (lowTurn p t q α γ - α) - Real.cos γ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorDelta
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorDelta (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.arctan (interiorN p t q α γ / interiorD p t q α γ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.InteriorPhysical
lean.code:
def InteriorPhysical (p t q h α γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < interiorD p t q α γ ∧ 0 < interiorN p t q α γ ∧
    interiorBeta p t q α γ ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) ∧
    (h / q) * Real.sin (interiorDelta p t q α γ) < 1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorHigh
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorHigh (p t q h l α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  seamHigh q h l α (interiorBeta p t q α γ) γ (interiorDelta p t q α γ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorN
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorN (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sin γ - q * Real.sin (lowTurn p t q α γ - α)

entries.label: lem:nfp_interior_equations
entries.title: the chart solves the low seam and the chord
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Along the chart $H=0$ identically, and $M=0$ wherever $\mathsf D\ne0$.
  If $\alpha,\gamma\in(0,\pi/2)$ and the point is interior-physical, the
  four angles $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)$ are strict.  The
  interior-physical set is open and $\mathcal K$ is continuous on it.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.isOpen_interiorPhysical
lean.code:
theorem isOpen_interiorPhysical (p t q h : ℝ) :
    IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ | InteriorPhysical p t q h z.1 z.2} := by
  rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  intro z hz
  have hD := (continuous_interiorD p t q).continuousAt.eventually
    (eventually_gt_nhds hz.1)
  have hN := (continuous_interiorN p t q).continuousAt.eventually
    (eventually_gt_nhds hz.2.1)
  have hβ := continuousAt_interiorBeta (ne_of_gt hz.1)
  have hβ0 := hβ.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hz.2.2.1.1)
  have hβ1 := hβ.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hz.2.2.1.2)
  have hwallcont : ContinuousAt
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ ↦ (h / q) * Real.sin (interiorDelta p t q w.1 w.2)) z :=
    continuousAt_const.mul (Real.continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp
      (continuousAt_interiorDelta (ne_of_gt hz.1)))
  have hwall := hwallcont.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hz.2.2.2)
  filter_upwards [hD, hN, hβ0, hβ1, hwall] with w hwD hwN hwβ0 hwβ1 hwwall
  exact ⟨hwD, hwN, ⟨hwβ0, hwβ1⟩, hwwall⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.continuousOn_interiorHigh
lean.code:
theorem continuousOn_interiorHigh (p t q h l : ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (interiorHigh p t q h l))
      {z : ℝ × ℝ | InteriorPhysical p t q h z.1 z.2} :=
  continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt (fun _ hz ↦ continuousAt_interiorHigh (ne_of_gt hz.1))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorDelta_pos
lean.code:
theorem interiorDelta_pos {p t q α γ : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < interiorD p t q α γ) (hN : 0 < interiorN p t q α γ) :
    0 < interiorDelta p t q α γ :=
  Real.arctan_pos.mpr (div_pos hN hD)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interior_seamLow
lean.code:
theorem interior_seamLow (p t q α γ : ℝ) :
    seamLow p t q α (interiorBeta p t q α γ) γ
      (interiorDelta p t q α γ) = 0 := by
  unfold seamLow interiorBeta
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.strictAngles_of_interiorPhysical
lean.code:
theorem strictAngles_of_interiorPhysical {p t q h α γ : ℝ}
    (hα : α ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2)) (hγ : γ ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2))
    (hP : InteriorPhysical p t q h α γ) :
    StrictAngles q h α (interiorBeta p t q α γ) γ (interiorDelta p t q α γ) :=
  ⟨hα, hP.2.2.1, hγ,
    ⟨interiorDelta_pos hP.1 hP.2.1, interiorDelta_lt_pi_div_two ..⟩, hP.2.2.2⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interior_chord
lean.code:
theorem interior_chord {p t q α γ : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hD : interiorD p t q α γ ≠ 0) :
    chord q α (interiorBeta p t q α γ) γ (interiorDelta p t q α γ) = 0 := by
  have hc := chord_eliminated (p := p) (t := t) (α := α) (γ := γ)
    (δ := interiorDelta p t q α γ) hq
  have hzero : interiorD p t q α γ * Real.sin (interiorDelta p t q α γ) -
      interiorN p t q α γ * Real.cos (interiorDelta p t q α γ) = 0 := by
    unfold interiorDelta
    rw [Real.sin_arctan, Real.cos_arctan]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hzero] at hc
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_left hq

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.chord_eliminated
lean.code:
theorem chord_eliminated {p t q α γ δ : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    q * chord q α (Real.pi - δ - lowTurn p t q α γ) γ δ =
      interiorD p t q α γ * Real.sin δ - interiorN p t q α γ * Real.cos δ := by
  unfold chord interiorD interiorN
  rw [show α + (Real.pi - δ - lowTurn p t q α γ) =
      Real.pi - (δ + (lowTurn p t q α γ - α)) by ring,
    Real.sin_pi_sub, Real.sin_add, Real.sin_add]
  field_simp
  ring

entries.label: lem:nfp_wall_chart
entries.title: the chart on the wall
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<t$, $pt<1<pq$ and $\gamma\in[0,\pi/2]$.  On
  $\alpha=\pi/2$ the chart is given explicitly by
  \begin{align*}
    \mathsf N&=\sqrt{1-p^2}\sqrt{q^2-t^2\sin^2\gamma}+(1-pt)\sin\gamma,\\
    \mathsf D&=p\sqrt{q^2-t^2\sin^2\gamma}+t\sqrt{1-p^2}\sin\gamma-\cos\gamma,
  \end{align*}
  and $\mathsf N>0$, $\mathsf D>0$, $\delta\in(0,\pi/2)$,
  $\beta\in(0,\pi/2)$.  Consequently $(\pi/2,\gamma)$ is interior-physical as
  soon as the high wall $(h/q)\sin\delta(\pi/2,\gamma)<1$ holds.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wall_chord
lean.code:
lemma wall_chord {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    chord q (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q γ) γ (wallDelta p t q γ) = 0 := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hD := wallD_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  have hlow : wallBeta p t q γ = Real.pi -
      (wallDelta p t q γ + lowTurn p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ) := by
    simp only [wallBeta, lowTurn, angleAtom, Real.sin_pi_div_two, mul_one]
    ring
  have hzero : wallD p t q γ * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q γ) -
      wallN p t q γ * Real.cos (wallDelta p t q γ) = 0 := by
    unfold wallDelta
    rw [sin_arctan_div_pos hD, cos_arctan_div_pos hD]
    ring
  rw [wallD_eq_trig hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    wallN_eq_trig hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1] at hzero
  unfold chord
  rw [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two]
  simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [hlow, Real.cos_pi_sub, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add]
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hq.ne'
  field_simp
  nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallD_eq_trig
lean.code:
lemma wallD_eq_trig {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    wallD p t q γ = q * Real.sin (lowTurn p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ) - Real.cos γ := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have ha := wall_arcsin_arg_mem hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  unfold lowTurn angleAtom wallD
  rw [Real.sin_pi_div_two, mul_one, Real.sin_add,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hp1.le, Real.cos_arcsin, Real.cos_arcsin,
    Real.sin_arcsin ha.1 ha.2, wall_sqrt_ratio hp hp1 ht hpt hpq]
  field_simp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wall_radicand_pos
lean.code:
lemma wall_radicand_pos {p t q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q) (γ : ℝ) :
    0 < q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2 := by
  have hq := wall_one_lt_q hp hp1 hpq
  have htq : t < q := (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ hp).mp (hpt.trans hpq)
  have hs : Real.sin γ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq γ, sq_nonneg (Real.cos γ)]
  have hm : t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 :=
    mul_le_of_le_one_right (sq_nonneg t) hs
  have hsq : t ^ 2 < q ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallDelta
lean.code:
noncomputable def wallDelta (p t q γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.arctan (wallN p t q γ / wallD p t q γ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallBeta_pos
lean.code:
lemma wallBeta_pos {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : 0 < wallBeta p t q γ := by
  by_contra hb
  have hbn : wallBeta p t q γ ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hb
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (wallBeta p t q) (Set.Icc 0 γ) :=
    (continuousOn_wallBeta hp hp1 ht hpt hpq).mono
      (fun _ hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.trans hγ1⟩)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' hγ0 hcont
    (show 0 ∈ Set.Icc (wallBeta p t q γ) (wallBeta p t q 0) from
      ⟨hbn, (wallBeta_zero_pos (t := t) (q := q) hp1).le⟩)
  exact wallBeta_ne_zero hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hx.1 (hx.2.trans hγ1) he

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorN_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorN_wall {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    interiorN p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ = wallN p t q γ := by
  unfold interiorN
  rw [Real.sin_sub_pi_div_two, wallN_eq_trig hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallBeta_ne_zero
lean.code:
lemma wallBeta_ne_zero {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : wallBeta p t q γ ≠ 0 := by
  intro hb
  have hc := wall_chord hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hq1 := wall_one_lt_q hp hp1 hpq
  unfold chord at hc
  rw [hb, add_zero, Real.sin_pi_div_two] at hc
  have he : Real.sin (γ + wallDelta p t q γ) = q := by
    apply (div_eq_one_iff_eq hq.ne').1
    linarith
  have hs := Real.sin_le_one (γ + wallDelta p t q γ)
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorPhysical_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorPhysical_wall {p t q h γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2)
    (hwall : (h / q) * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q γ) < 1) :
    InteriorPhysical p t q h (Real.pi / 2) γ := by
  unfold InteriorPhysical
  rw [interiorD_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorN_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorDelta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorBeta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1]
  exact ⟨wallD_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    wallN_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    ⟨wallBeta_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
      wallBeta_lt_pi_div_two hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1⟩, hwall⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallD
lean.code:
noncomputable def wallD (p t q γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  p * Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2) +
    t * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) * Real.sin γ - Real.cos γ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallBeta_lt_pi_div_two
lean.code:
lemma wallBeta_lt_pi_div_two {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : wallBeta p t q γ < Real.pi / 2 := by
  have hδ0 := wallDelta_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  have hδ1 := wallDelta_lt_pi_div_two p t q γ
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hsγ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hγ0
    (hγ1.trans (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
  have hpangle := Real.arcsin_pos.2 hp
  have htangle : 0 ≤ Real.arcsin ((t / q) * Real.sin γ) :=
    Real.arcsin_nonneg.2 (mul_nonneg (div_pos ht hq).le hsγ)
  have hbpi : wallBeta p t q γ < Real.pi := by
    unfold wallBeta
    linarith
  have hs : 0 < Real.sin (γ + wallDelta p t q γ) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hc := wall_chord hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  unfold chord at hc
  rw [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two] at hc
  simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] at hc
  have hcos : 0 < Real.cos (wallBeta p t q γ) := by
    have := div_pos hs hq
    linarith
  by_contra hb
  have := Real.cos_nonpos_of_pi_div_two_le_of_le (le_of_not_gt hb)
    (show wallBeta p t q γ ≤ Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallD_pos
lean.code:
lemma wallD_pos {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : 0 < wallD p t q γ := by
  have hR := wall_radicand_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq γ
  have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sin γ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hγ0
    (hγ1.trans (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
  have hpq2 : 1 < p ^ 2 * q ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p * q - 1)]
  have hpt2 : p ^ 2 * t ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hp ht]
  have hgap : Real.cos γ ^ 2 <
      (p * Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hR.le]
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq γ,
      mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1 - p ^ 2 * t ^ 2 by linarith) (sq_nonneg (Real.sin γ))]
  have hlead : Real.cos γ < p * Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2) := by
    have hh := mul_pos hp (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hR)
    nlinarith
  have hrest : 0 ≤ t * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) * Real.sin γ := by positivity
  unfold wallD
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallN_eq_trig
lean.code:
lemma wallN_eq_trig {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    wallN p t q γ = q * Real.cos (lowTurn p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ) + Real.sin γ := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have ha := wall_arcsin_arg_mem hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  unfold lowTurn angleAtom wallN
  rw [Real.sin_pi_div_two, mul_one, Real.cos_add,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hp1.le, Real.cos_arcsin, Real.cos_arcsin,
    Real.sin_arcsin ha.1 ha.2, wall_sqrt_ratio hp hp1 ht hpt hpq]
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorHigh_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorHigh_wall {p t q h l γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) γ =
      seamHigh q h l (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q γ) γ (wallDelta p t q γ) := by
  unfold interiorHigh
  rw [interiorDelta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorBeta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallBeta
lean.code:
noncomputable def wallBeta (p t q γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi - wallDelta p t q γ - Real.arcsin p -
    Real.arcsin ((t / q) * Real.sin γ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorD_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorD_wall {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    interiorD p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ = wallD p t q γ := by
  unfold interiorD
  rw [Real.cos_sub_pi_div_two]
  exact (wallD_eq_trig hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1).symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallN_pos
lean.code:
lemma wallN_pos {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : 0 < wallN p t q γ := by
  have hU : 0 < 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hR := wall_radicand_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq γ
  have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sin γ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hγ0
    (hγ1.trans (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hU) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hR))
    (mul_nonneg (sub_pos.mpr hpt).le hs)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallN
lean.code:
noncomputable def wallN (p t q γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2) +
    (1 - p * t) * Real.sin γ

entries.label: lem:nfp_wall_initial
entries.title: initial values at \texorpdfstring{$\gamma=0$}{gamma = 0}
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1<pq$, $1<h$, $0<l<1$ and
  $(1-p^2)(h^2-1)\le(1-l^2)(q-p)^2$.  With $Z=\sqrt{q^2-2pq+1}$,
  \[
    \sin\delta(0)=\frac{q\sqrt{1-p^2}}Z,\qquad
    \sin\beta(0)=\frac{q-p}Z,
  \]
  the high wall holds strictly at $\gamma=0$, $(h/q)\sin\delta(0)<1$, and
  the high seam is weakly negative there, $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)\le0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.arcsin_add_arcsin_le_half_pi
lean.code:
lemma arcsin_add_arcsin_le_half_pi {x y : ℝ} (_hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hxy : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    Real.arcsin x + Real.arcsin y ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
  have hxroot : x ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2) :=
    Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by linarith)
  have hmono := Real.monotone_arcsin hxroot
  rw [← Real.arccos_eq_arcsin hy, Real.arccos_eq_pi_div_two_sub_arcsin] at hmono
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.sin_wallBeta_zero
lean.code:
lemma sin_wallBeta_zero {p t q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hpq : 1 < p * q) :
    Real.sin (wallBeta p t q 0) =
      (q - p) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
  have hU : 0 ≤ 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hZ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (wall_initial_norm_pos (q := q) hp hp1)
  have hb : wallBeta p t q 0 = Real.pi - (wallDelta p t q 0 + Real.arcsin p) := by
    simp only [wallBeta, Real.sin_zero, mul_zero, Real.arcsin_zero, sub_zero]
    ring
  rw [hb, Real.sin_pi_sub, Real.sin_add, Real.cos_arcsin,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hp1.le,
    sin_wallDelta_zero hp hp1 hpq, cos_wallDelta_zero hp hp1 hpq]
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← add_div]
  congr 1
  linear_combination q * Real.sq_sqrt hU

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.sin_wallDelta_zero
lean.code:
lemma sin_wallDelta_zero {p t q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hpq : 1 < p * q) :
    Real.sin (wallDelta p t q 0) =
      q * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hU : 0 ≤ 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hnorm : (q * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2)) ^ 2 + (p * q - 1) ^ 2 =
      q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hU]
    ring
  unfold wallDelta
  rw [wallN_zero hq.le, wallD_zero hq.le,
    sin_arctan_div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hpq), hnorm]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wall_initial_high_nonpos
lean.code:
lemma wall_initial_high_nonpos {p t q h l : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hpq : 1 < p * q) (hh : 0 < h) (hl : 0 < l)
    (hflag : (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1) ≤ (1 - l ^ 2) * (q - p) ^ 2) :
    seamHigh q h l (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q 0) 0 (wallDelta p t q 0) ≤ 0 := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hq1 := wall_one_lt_q hp hp1 hpq
  have hqp : 0 < q - p := by linarith
  have hU : 0 ≤ 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hZ := wall_initial_norm_pos (q := q) hp hp1
  have hsZ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hZ
  have hx : 0 ≤ h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) :=
    by positivity
  have hy : 0 ≤ l * (q - p) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by positivity
  have hsq : (h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1)) ^ 2 +
      (l * (q - p) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, Real.sq_sqrt hZ.le]
    apply (div_le_one hZ).2
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hU]
    nlinarith [hflag]
  have hangle := arcsin_add_arcsin_le_half_pi hx hy hsq
  have hxEq : h / q * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q 0) =
      h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
    rw [sin_wallDelta_zero hp hp1 hpq]
    field_simp
  have hyEq : l * Real.sin (wallBeta p t q 0) =
      l * (q - p) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
    rw [sin_wallBeta_zero hp hp1 hpq, mul_div_assoc]
  unfold seamHigh highTurn angleAtom
  rw [hxEq, hyEq]
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wall_initial_hwall
lean.code:
lemma wall_initial_hwall {p t q h l : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hpq : 1 < p * q) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hflag : (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1) ≤ (1 - l ^ 2) * (q - p) ^ 2) :
    (h / q) * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q 0) < 1 := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hU : 0 < 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hL : 0 < 1 - l ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hH : 0 < h ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hmargin : 0 < (1 - l ^ 2) *
      (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1 - h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2)) := by
    calc
      _ = ((1 - l ^ 2) * (q - p) ^ 2 - (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1)) +
          l ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1) := by ring
      _ > 0 := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sub_nonneg.mpr hflag) (by positivity)
  have hgap := pos_of_mul_pos_right hmargin hL.le
  have hZ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (wall_initial_norm_pos (q := q) hp hp1)
  have hlt : h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) < Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
    have hsU := Real.sq_sqrt hU.le
    have hsZ := Real.sq_sqrt (wall_initial_norm_pos (q := q) hp hp1).le
    have hprod : 0 ≤ h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) := by positivity
    nlinarith
  rw [sin_wallDelta_zero hp hp1 hpq]
  have heq : h / q * (q * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) /
      Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1)) =
      h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
    field_simp
  rw [heq]
  exact (div_lt_one hZ).2 hlt

entries.label: lem:nfp_first_wall
entries.title: a positive endpoint before the first high wall
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item Let $b>0$ and $f,g$ continuous on $[0,b]$ with $f(0)<1$, $g(b)>0$
      and $g(x)>0$ whenever $f(x)=1$.  Then some $c\in(0,b)$ has $f<1$ on
      $[0,c]$ and $g(c)>0$.
    \item Let $0<p<1$, $0<t$, $pt<1<pq$, $h,l>0$ and
      $(h/q)\sin\delta(\pi/2,0)<1$.  Then there is
      $\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}\in(0,\pi/2)$ such that the high wall
      $(h/q)\sin\delta(\pi/2,\gamma)<1$ holds for every
      $\gamma\in[0,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}]$ and
      $\mathcal K(\pi/2,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}})>0$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.continuousOn_wall_high
lean.code:
lemma continuousOn_wall_high {p t q h l : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q) :
    ContinuousOn (fun γ => seamHigh q h l (Real.pi / 2)
      (wallBeta p t q γ) γ (wallDelta p t q γ)) (Set.Icc 0 (Real.pi / 2)) := by
  have hδ := continuousOn_wallDelta hp hp1 ht hpt hpq
  have hβ := continuousOn_wallBeta hp hp1 ht hpt hpq
  unfold seamHigh highTurn angleAtom
  fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_positive_before_first_wall
lean.code:
lemma exists_positive_before_first_wall {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc 0 b))
    (hf0 : f 0 < 1) (hgb : 0 < g b)
    (hwall : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 b, f x = 1 → 0 < g x) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b, (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 c, f x < 1) ∧ 0 < g c := by
  have hex : ∃ e, 0 < e ∧ e ≤ b ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Ico 0 e, f x < 1) ∧ 0 < g e := by
    let s := Set.Icc 0 b ∩ f ⁻¹' ({1} : Set ℝ)
    have hsclosed : IsClosed s :=
      hf.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc isClosed_singleton
    have hscompact : IsCompact s :=
      isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset hsclosed Set.inter_subset_left
    by_cases hs : s.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hscompact.exists_isLeast hs
      have heb : e ∈ Set.Icc 0 b := he.1.1
      have hfe : f e = 1 := he.1.2
      have he0 : 0 < e := by
        by_contra hh
        have hez : e = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hh) heb.1
        rw [hez] at hfe
        linarith
      refine ⟨e, he0, heb.2, ?_, hwall e heb hfe⟩
      intro x hx
      by_contra hh
      have hfx : 1 ≤ f x := le_of_not_gt hh
      have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 x) :=
        hf.mono (fun _ hy => ⟨hy.1, hy.2.trans (hx.2.le.trans heb.2)⟩)
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hfz⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hx.1 hcont
        (show 1 ∈ Set.Icc (f 0) (f x) from ⟨hf0.le, hfx⟩)
      have hes : e ≤ z := he.2 ⟨⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans (hx.2.le.trans heb.2)⟩, hfz⟩
      linarith [hz.2, hx.2]
    · refine ⟨b, hb, le_rfl, ?_, hgb⟩
      intro x hx
      by_contra hh
      have hfx : 1 ≤ f x := le_of_not_gt hh
      have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 x) :=
        hf.mono (fun _ hy => ⟨hy.1, hy.2.trans hx.2.le⟩)
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hfz⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hx.1 hcont
        (show 1 ∈ Set.Icc (f 0) (f x) from ⟨hf0.le, hfx⟩)
      exact hs ⟨z, ⟨⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans hx.2.le⟩, hfz⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he0, heb, hpre, hge⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hnear⟩ := Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff.1
    (hg e ⟨he0.le, heb⟩) (g e) hge
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hce⟩ := exists_between
    (show max 0 (e - d) < e from max_lt_iff.2 ⟨he0, by linarith⟩)
  have hcpos : 0 < c := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hc0
  have hcb : c < b := hce.trans_le heb
  have hcd : dist c e < d := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_neg (sub_neg.2 hce)]
    have : e - d < c := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hc0
    linarith
  have hgc := hnear ⟨hcpos.le, hcb.le⟩ hcd
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hgc
  refine ⟨c, ⟨hcpos, hcb⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact hpre x ⟨hx.1, hx.2.trans_lt hce⟩
  · linarith [hgc.1]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.continuousOn_wall_hargument
lean.code:
lemma continuousOn_wall_hargument {p t q h : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q) :
    ContinuousOn (fun γ => (h / q) * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q γ))
      (Set.Icc 0 (Real.pi / 2)) := by
  have hδ := continuousOn_wallDelta hp hp1 ht hpt hpq
  fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wall_high_pos_at_hwall
lean.code:
lemma wall_high_pos_at_hwall {p t q h l γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q) (hl : 0 < l)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2)
    (hwall : (h / q) * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q γ) = 1) :
    0 < seamHigh q h l (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q γ) γ (wallDelta p t q γ) := by
  have hβ0 := wallBeta_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  have hβ1 := wallBeta_lt_pi_div_two hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  have hsβ := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hβ0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hlangle := Real.arcsin_pos.2 (mul_pos hl hsβ)
  unfold seamHigh highTurn angleAtom
  rw [hwall, Real.arcsin_one]
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_wall_positive_endpoint
lean.code:
lemma exists_wall_positive_endpoint {p t q h l : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q) (hh : 0 < h) (hl : 0 < l)
    (hinit : (h / q) * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q 0) < 1) :
    ∃ γhi ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2),
      (∀ γ ∈ Set.Icc 0 γhi, (h / q) * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q γ) < 1) ∧
      0 < seamHigh q h l (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q γhi) γhi
        (wallDelta p t q γhi) := by
  exact exists_positive_before_first_wall (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    (continuousOn_wall_hargument hp hp1 ht hpt hpq)
    (continuousOn_wall_high hp hp1 ht hpt hpq) hinit
    (wall_high_pos_at_right hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hh hl)
    (fun γ hγ => wall_high_pos_at_hwall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hl hγ.1 hγ.2)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wall_high_pos_at_right
lean.code:
lemma wall_high_pos_at_right {p t q h l : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q) (hh : 0 < h) (hl : 0 < l) :
    0 < seamHigh q h l (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q (Real.pi / 2))
      (Real.pi / 2) (wallDelta p t q (Real.pi / 2)) := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hπ : 0 ≤ Real.pi / 2 := (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hβ0 := wallBeta_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hπ le_rfl
  have hβ1 := wallBeta_lt_pi_div_two hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hπ le_rfl
  have hδ0 := wallDelta_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hπ le_rfl
  have hδ1 := wallDelta_lt_pi_div_two p t q (Real.pi / 2)
  have hsβ := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hβ0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsδ := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hδ0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hlangle := Real.arcsin_pos.2 (mul_pos hl hsβ)
  have hhangle := Real.arcsin_pos.2 (mul_pos (div_pos hh hq) hsδ)
  unfold seamHigh highTurn angleAtom
  linarith

entries.label: lem:nfp_wall_strip
entries.title: the physical boundary strip
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Under the standing hypotheses of this section there is
  $\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}\in(0,\pi/2)$ such that $(\pi/2,\gamma)$ is
  interior-physical for every $\gamma\in[0,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}]$,
  $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)\le0$ and $\mathcal K(\pi/2,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}})>0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorBeta_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorBeta_wall {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    interiorBeta p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ = wallBeta p t q γ := by
  unfold interiorBeta
  rw [interiorDelta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1]
  simp only [wallBeta, lowTurn, angleAtom, Real.sin_pi_div_two, mul_one]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorDelta_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorDelta_wall {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    interiorDelta p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ = wallDelta p t q γ := by
  unfold interiorDelta wallDelta
  rw [interiorD_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorN_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_physical_boundary_strip_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one
lean.code:
theorem exists_physical_boundary_strip_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l) :
    ∃ γhi ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2),
      (∀ γ ∈ Icc 0 γhi, InteriorPhysical p t q h (Real.pi / 2) γ) ∧
      interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) 0 ≤ 0 ∧
      0 < interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) γhi := by
  have hpq := firstPairFlag_one_lt_mul hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  have hsq := firstPairFlag_square_bound hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  have hh : 1 < h := hq.trans hqh
  have hinit := wall_initial_hwall (t := t) hp hp1 hpq hh hl hl1 hsq
  obtain ⟨γhi, hhi, hwall, hpos⟩ :=
    exists_wall_positive_endpoint hp hp1 ht hpt hpq (by linarith) hl hinit
  refine ⟨γhi, hhi, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro γ hγ
    exact interiorPhysical_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ.1 (hγ.2.trans hhi.2.le) (hwall γ hγ)
  · rw [interiorHigh_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq (le_refl 0) (by positivity)]
    exact wall_initial_high_nonpos hp hp1 hpq (by linarith) hl hsq
  · rwa [interiorHigh_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hhi.1.le hhi.2.le]

entries.label: lem:nfp_boundary_derivative
entries.title: the inward boundary derivative
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<q<h$, $0<l<1$ and let $(\pi/2,0)$ be interior-physical.
  Then $\alpha\mapsto\mathcal K(\alpha,0)$ has derivative
  \[
    \mathcal K'=1+\bigl(\operatorname{slope}(h/q,\delta)-\operatorname{slope}(l,\beta)\bigr)\,
    \delta'>1
  \]
  at $\alpha=\pi/2$, where $\delta'>0$ is the derivative of
  $\alpha\mapsto\delta(\alpha,0)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_derivative_gt_one_interiorHigh_boundary
lean.code:
theorem exists_derivative_gt_one_interiorHigh_boundary {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hphysical : InteriorPhysical p t q h (Real.pi / 2) 0) :
    ∃ d > 1, HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorHigh p t q h l α 0) d (Real.pi / 2) := by
  obtain ⟨dδ, hdδ, hδD⟩ := exists_pos_derivative_interiorDelta_boundary hp hp1 hq
    hphysical.1 hphysical.2.1
  have hlow := hasDerivAt_lowTurn_boundary (t := t) (q := q) hp hp1
  have hβD : HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorBeta p t q α 0) (-dδ) (Real.pi / 2) := by
    convert (hδD.const_sub Real.pi).sub hlow using 1 <;> simp [interiorBeta]
    rfl
  have hδpos := interiorDelta_pos hphysical.1 hphysical.2.1
  have hδlt := interiorDelta_lt_pi_div_two p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0
  have hβ := hphysical.2.2.1
  have hwall := hphysical.2.2.2
  have hlowwall := endpoint_arg_lt_one hl hl1 hβ.1 hβ.2
  have hhighD := (hasDerivAt_angleAtom (div_pos (lt_trans hq hqh) hq)
    hδpos hδlt hwall).comp (Real.pi / 2) hδD
  have hlowD := (hasDerivAt_angleAtom hl hβ.1 hβ.2 hlowwall).comp (Real.pi / 2) hβD
  have hhighSlope := one_lt_angleSlope ((one_lt_div hq).2 hqh) hδpos hδlt hwall
  have hlowSlope := angleSlope_lt_one hl hl1 hβ.1 hβ.2
  refine ⟨1 + (angleSlope (h / q) (interiorDelta p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0) -
      angleSlope l (interiorBeta p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0)) * dδ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hlowSlope hhighSlope)) hdδ]
  · have hd := (((hasDerivAt_id (Real.pi / 2)).add_const 0).add
      (hhighD.add hlowD)).sub_const Real.pi
    convert hd using 1 <;> simp [interiorHigh, seamHigh, highTurn, Function.comp_def]
    ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.hasDerivAt_lowTurn_boundary
lean.code:
theorem hasDerivAt_lowTurn_boundary {p t q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => lowTurn p t q α 0) 0 (Real.pi / 2) := by
  have hs : HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => p * Real.sin α) 0 (Real.pi / 2) := by
    simpa using (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (Real.pi / 2)).const_mul p
  have ha : HasDerivAt Real.arcsin (1 / √(1 - p ^ 2)) (p * Real.sin (Real.pi / 2)) := by
    simpa using Real.hasDerivAt_arcsin (by linarith : p ≠ -1) (ne_of_lt hp1)
  have hd := ha.comp (Real.pi / 2) hs
  simpa [lowTurn, angleAtom, Function.comp_def] using hd

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_pos_derivative_interiorDelta_boundary
lean.code:
theorem exists_pos_derivative_interiorDelta_boundary {p t q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < interiorD p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0)
    (hN : 0 < interiorN p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0) :
    ∃ d > 0, HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorDelta p t q α 0) d (Real.pi / 2) := by
  have hrad : 0 < 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsqrt : 0 < √(1 - p ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hrad
  let D := interiorD p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0
  let N := interiorN p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0
  let d := (q * p * D - N * (-q * √(1 - p ^ 2))) / D ^ 2
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d, D, N]
    apply div_pos
    · nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hq hp) hD,
        mul_pos hN (mul_pos hq hsqrt)]
    · exact sq_pos_of_pos hD
  have hquot := (hasDerivAt_interiorN_boundary (t := t) (q := q) hp hp1).div
    (hasDerivAt_interiorD_boundary (t := t) (q := q) hp hp1) (ne_of_gt hD)
  have harctan := (Real.hasDerivAt_arctan (N / D)).comp (Real.pi / 2) hquot
  refine ⟨1 / (1 + (N / D) ^ 2) * d, mul_pos (by positivity) hd, ?_⟩
  simpa only [interiorDelta, D, N, d, Function.comp_def, Pi.div_apply] using harctan

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.hasDerivAt_interiorN_boundary
lean.code:
theorem hasDerivAt_interiorN_boundary {p t q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorN p t q α 0)
      (q * p) (Real.pi / 2) := by
  have hφ := (hasDerivAt_lowTurn_boundary (t := t) (q := q) hp hp1).sub
    (hasDerivAt_id (Real.pi / 2))
  have hsin := hφ.sin
  have hd := (hsin.const_mul q).const_sub (Real.sin 0)
  simpa [interiorN, lowTurn, angleAtom, Real.cos_sub_pi_div_two,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith : -1 ≤ p) hp1.le, Function.comp_def, Pi.sub_apply] using hd

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_pos_derivative_interiorHigh_boundary
lean.code:
theorem exists_pos_derivative_interiorHigh_boundary {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hphysical : InteriorPhysical p t q h (Real.pi / 2) 0) :
    ∃ d > 0, HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorHigh p t q h l α 0) d (Real.pi / 2) := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hD⟩ := exists_derivative_gt_one_interiorHigh_boundary
    hp hp1 hq hqh hl hl1 hphysical
  exact ⟨d, lt_trans zero_lt_one hd, hD⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.hasDerivAt_interiorD_boundary
lean.code:
theorem hasDerivAt_interiorD_boundary {p t q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorD p t q α 0)
      (-q * √(1 - p ^ 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := by
  have hφ := (hasDerivAt_lowTurn_boundary (t := t) (q := q) hp hp1).sub
    (hasDerivAt_id (Real.pi / 2))
  have hcos := hφ.cos
  have hd := (hcos.const_mul q).sub_const (Real.cos 0)
  simpa [interiorD, lowTurn, angleAtom, Real.sin_sub_pi_div_two,
    Real.cos_arcsin, Function.comp_def, Pi.sub_apply] using hd

entries.label: thm:nfp_pure_root
entries.title: a strict native root in the pure branch
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<t$, $pt<1$, $0<l<1$, $1<q<h$ and $\Phi(p,q,h,l)\ge0$.
  Then there are strict angles $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)$ with
  $H=K=M=0$, equivalently $E=0$ and $D=0$.  In particular this holds for
  $0<t<p$ and for $t=p$, with a zero flag allowed.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_strict_root_of_interior_strip
lean.code:
theorem exists_strict_root_of_interior_strip {p t q h l γhi : ℝ}
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hhi : γhi ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2))
    (hphysical : ∀ γ ∈ Icc 0 γhi, InteriorPhysical p t q h (Real.pi / 2) γ)
    (hleft : interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) 0 ≤ 0)
    (hright : 0 < interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) γhi)
    (hderiv : interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) 0 = 0 →
      ∃ d > 0, HasDerivAt (fun α ↦ interiorHigh p t q h l α 0) d (Real.pi / 2)) :
    ∃ α β γ δ : ℝ, StrictAngles q h α β γ δ ∧
      seamLow p t q α β γ δ = 0 ∧ seamHigh q h l α β γ δ = 0 ∧
      chord q α β γ δ = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨α, hα, γ, hγ, hP, hzero⟩ :=
    CompactBoundaryIVT.exists_inward_zero_of_boundary_derivative
      (amin := 0) (lo := 0) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi / 2) hhi.1
      (isOpen_interiorPhysical p t q h) hphysical
      (continuousOn_interiorHigh p t q h l) hleft hright hderiv
  refine ⟨α, interiorBeta p t q α γ, γ, interiorDelta p t q α γ,
    strictAngles_of_interiorPhysical hα ⟨hγ.1, hγ.2.trans hhi.2⟩ hP,
    interior_seamLow .., hzero, ?_⟩
  exact interior_chord hq (ne_of_gt hP.1)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_native_zero_of_firstPairFlag_matched
lean.code:
theorem exists_native_zero_of_firstPairFlag_matched {p q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h) (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l) :
    ∃ α β γ δ : ℝ, StrictAngles q h α β γ δ ∧
      nativeHalfClosure p p q h l α β γ δ = 0 ∧
      turnDefect p p q h l α β γ δ = 0 :=
  exists_native_zero_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one hp hp1 hp (by nlinarith)
    hl hl1 hq hqh hflag

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_native_zero_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one
lean.code:
theorem exists_native_zero_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l) :
    ∃ α β γ δ : ℝ, StrictAngles q h α β γ δ ∧
      nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ = 0 ∧
      turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨α, β, γ, δ, ha, hlo, hhi, hc⟩ :=
    exists_strict_root_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one hp hp1 ht hpt hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  exact ⟨α, β, γ, δ, ha,
    (native_zero_iff_of_strictAngles hp.le ht.le (zero_lt_one.trans hq) ha).mpr
      ⟨hc, hlo, hhi⟩⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_strict_root_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one
lean.code:

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_regular_anchor_of_firstPairFlag
lean.code:
theorem exists_regular_anchor_of_firstPairFlag {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l) :
    ∃ L : Fin 4 → ℝ, NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l L ∧
      nativeLengthController p t q h l L = 0 ∧
      Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l) L) := by
  obtain ⟨α, β, γ, δ, ha, hclose, hturn⟩ :=
    exists_native_zero_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one hp hp1 ht hpt hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  have hq0 : 0 < q := zero_lt_one.trans hq
  have hpq := firstPairFlag_one_lt_mul hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  have htq : t < q := (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ hp).mp (hpt.trans hpq)
  let T := γ + δ
  let x : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![α + β, α, γ]
  have ha' : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2) := by
    simpa [x, T] using ha
  have hsplit : nativeSplitController p t q h l T x = 0 := by
    have hz : (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ,
        turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) = (0 : ℂ × ℝ) := Prod.ext hclose hturn
    simpa [nativeSplitController, x, T] using hz
  have hphysical := nativeLengthPhysical_splitHalfLengths hp hp1 ht htq hl hl1 hq0 ha'
  have hzero : nativeLengthController p t q h l (splitHalfLengths q T x) = 0 := by
    rw [nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths (ne_of_gt hq0)
      ha'.1 ha'.2.1 ha'.2.2.1 ha'.2.2.2.1]
    exact hsplit
  exact ⟨splitHalfLengths q T x, hphysical, hzero,
    fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_physical hp hp1 ht htq hl hl1 hq hqh
      hphysical hzero⟩

entries.label: lem:nfp_ordered_core
entries.title: the orthogonal core
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
For $0<u,v<1<q$ let $d=\sqrt{q^2-u^2v^2}$ and let $A,B,C,D$ be the sides
  of the orthogonal quadrilateral with curvatures $(1,u,q,v)$
  (\cref{def:n4c_delta}; $\Delta=q^2-u^2v^2$):
  \[
    \frac A2=\frac{\sqrt{q^2-v^2}}d,\quad
    \frac B2=\frac{\sqrt{1-v^2}}d,\quad
    \frac C2=\frac{\sqrt{1-u^2}}d,\quad
    \frac D2=\frac{\sqrt{q^2-u^2}}d .
  \]
  All four are positive, and the length vector $(A,B,C,D)$ is a strict
  moderate-arc development of the curvature word $(1,u,q,v)$ that closes
  exactly with real total turn $2\pi$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.rCoreSideA

noncomputable def rCoreSideA (k u q v : ℝ) : ℝ :=

@[simp] lemma r_core_side_b_half_at_one (u q v : ℝ) :
    rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2 =
      √(1 - v ^ 2) / √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2) := by
  simp [rCoreSideB, orthogonalDelta]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_core_side_half_diagonal_squares
lean.code:
theorem r_core_side_half_diagonal_squares {k u q v : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hv : 0 < v)
    (huk : u < k) (huq : u < q) (hvk : v < k) (hvq : v < q) :
    rCoreSideA k u q v ^ 2 =
        rCoreHalfDiagonalA k u q v ^ 2 + rCoreHalfDiagonalB k u q v ^ 2 ∧
      rCoreSideB k u q v ^ 2 =
        rCoreHalfDiagonalB k u q v ^ 2 + rCoreHalfDiagonalC k u q v ^ 2 ∧
      rCoreSideC k u q v ^ 2 =
        rCoreHalfDiagonalC k u q v ^ 2 + rCoreHalfDiagonalD k u q v ^ 2 ∧
      rCoreSideD k u q v ^ 2 =
        rCoreHalfDiagonalD k u q v ^ 2 + rCoreHalfDiagonalA k u q v ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hD⟩ :=
    r_core_sides_pos hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hDelta := orthogonal_delta_pos_of_strict_alternation
    hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hqv := square_sub_pos hv hvq
  have hkv := square_sub_pos hv hvk
  have hku := square_sub_pos hu huk
  have hqu := square_sub_pos hu huq
  have hAroot := r_core_side_a_sq hDelta.le hqv.le
  have hBroot := r_core_side_b_sq hDelta.le hkv.le
  have hCroot := r_core_side_c_sq hDelta.le hku.le
  have hDroot := r_core_side_d_sq hDelta.le hqu.le
  have hasq : rCoreHalfDiagonalA k u q v ^ 2 =
      k ^ 2 * rCoreSideA k u q v ^ 2 * rCoreSideD k u q v ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (k * rCoreSideA k u q v * rCoreSideD k u q v / 2) ^ 2 = _
    ring
  have hbsq : rCoreHalfDiagonalB k u q v ^ 2 =
      u ^ 2 * rCoreSideA k u q v ^ 2 * rCoreSideB k u q v ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (u * rCoreSideA k u q v * rCoreSideB k u q v / 2) ^ 2 = _
    ring
  have hcsq : rCoreHalfDiagonalC k u q v ^ 2 =
      q ^ 2 * rCoreSideB k u q v ^ 2 * rCoreSideC k u q v ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (q * rCoreSideB k u q v * rCoreSideC k u q v / 2) ^ 2 = _
    ring
  have hdsq : rCoreHalfDiagonalD k u q v ^ 2 =
      v ^ 2 * rCoreSideC k u q v ^ 2 * rCoreSideD k u q v ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (v * rCoreSideC k u q v * rCoreSideD k u q v / 2) ^ 2 = _
    ring
  constructor
  · rw [hAroot, hasq, hbsq, hAroot, hBroot, hDroot]
    exact orthogonalA2_identity hDelta.ne'
  · constructor
    · rw [hBroot, hbsq, hcsq, hAroot, hBroot, hCroot]
      exact orthogonalB2_identity hDelta.ne'
    · constructor
      · rw [hCroot, hcsq, hdsq, hBroot, hCroot, hDroot]
        exact orthogonalC2_identity hDelta.ne'
      · rw [hDroot, hdsq, hasq, hAroot, hCroot, hDroot]
        exact orthogonalD2_identity hDelta.ne'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_core_sides_pos
lean.code:
lemma r_core_sides_pos {k u q v : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hv : 0 < v)
    (huk : u < k) (huq : u < q) (hvk : v < k) (hvq : v < q) :
    0 < rCoreSideA k u q v ∧ 0 < rCoreSideB k u q v ∧
      0 < rCoreSideC k u q v ∧ 0 < rCoreSideD k u q v := by
  have hDelta := orthogonal_delta_pos_of_strict_alternation
    hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hqv := square_sub_pos hv hvq
  have hkv := square_sub_pos hv hvk
  have hku := square_sub_pos hu huk
  have hqu := square_sub_pos hu huq
  simp only [rCoreSideA, rCoreSideB, rCoreSideC, rCoreSideD]
  exact ⟨div_pos (mul_pos two_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hqv)) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hDelta),
    div_pos (mul_pos two_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hkv)) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hDelta),
    div_pos (mul_pos two_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hku)) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hDelta),
    div_pos (mul_pos two_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hqu)) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hDelta)⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_core_realization_data
lean.code:
theorem r_core_realization_data {k u q v : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hv : 0 < v)
    (huk : u < k) (huq : u < q) (hvk : v < k) (hvq : v < q) :
    ModerateArc 0 (fourProfile k u q v)
        (fourProfile (rCoreSideA k u q v) (rCoreSideB k u q v)
          (rCoreSideC k u q v) (rCoreSideD k u q v)) ∧
      closureGap (fourProfile k u q v)
          (fourProfile (rCoreSideA k u q v) (rCoreSideB k u q v)
            (rCoreSideC k u q v) (rCoreSideD k u q v)) = 0 ∧
      turningSum (fourProfile k u q v)
          (fourProfile (rCoreSideA k u q v) (rCoreSideB k u q v)
            (rCoreSideC k u q v) (rCoreSideD k u q v)) = 2 * Real.pi ∧
      IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 (fourProfile k u q v)
        (fourProfile (rCoreSideA k u q v) (rCoreSideB k u q v)
          (rCoreSideC k u q v) (rCoreSideD k u q v))) := by
  let A := rCoreSideA k u q v
  let B := rCoreSideB k u q v
  let C := rCoreSideC k u q v
  let D := rCoreSideD k u q v
  let a := rCoreHalfDiagonalA k u q v
  let b := rCoreHalfDiagonalB k u q v
  let c := rCoreHalfDiagonalC k u q v
  let d := rCoreHalfDiagonalD k u q v
  have hDelta := orthogonal_delta_pos_of_strict_alternation
    hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hqv := square_sub_pos hv hvq
  have hkv := square_sub_pos hv hvk
  have hku := square_sub_pos hu huk
  have hqu := square_sub_pos hu huq
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hD⟩ : 0 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧ 0 < C ∧ 0 < D := by
    simpa only [A, B, C, D] using
      r_core_sides_pos hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c ∧ 0 < d := by
    simpa only [a, b, c, d] using
      r_core_half_diagonals_pos hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hAroot : A ^ 2 = orthogonalA2 k u q v := by
    simpa only [A] using r_core_side_a_sq hDelta.le hqv.le
  have hBroot : B ^ 2 = orthogonalB2 k u q v := by
    simpa only [B] using r_core_side_b_sq hDelta.le hkv.le
  have hCroot : C ^ 2 = orthogonalC2 k u q v := by
    simpa only [C] using r_core_side_c_sq hDelta.le hku.le
  have hDroot : D ^ 2 = orthogonalD2 k u q v := by
    simpa only [D] using r_core_side_d_sq hDelta.le hqu.le
  have hasq : a ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * A ^ 2 * D ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (k * A * D / 2) ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * A ^ 2 * D ^ 2 / 4
    ring
  have hbsq : b ^ 2 = u ^ 2 * A ^ 2 * B ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (u * A * B / 2) ^ 2 = u ^ 2 * A ^ 2 * B ^ 2 / 4
    ring
  have hcsq : c ^ 2 = q ^ 2 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (q * B * C / 2) ^ 2 = q ^ 2 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 / 4
    ring
  have hdsq : d ^ 2 = v ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * D ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (v * C * D / 2) ^ 2 = v ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * D ^ 2 / 4
    ring
  have hAsq : A ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    rw [hAroot, hasq, hbsq, hAroot, hBroot, hDroot]
    exact orthogonalA2_identity hDelta.ne'
  have hBsq : B ^ 2 = b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by
    rw [hBroot, hbsq, hcsq, hAroot, hBroot, hCroot]
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: def:nfp_ordered_residual
entries.title: the two mixed residuals
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
For real $p,t,q,h,l$ and $(u,v)\in\RR^2$ put $d=\sqrt{q^2-u^2v^2}$ and
  define the four scalar factors
  \[
    \frac A2=\frac{\sqrt{q^2-v^2}}d,\quad
    \frac B2=\frac{\sqrt{1-v^2}}d,\quad
    \frac C2=\frac{\sqrt{1-u^2}}d,\quad
    \frac D2=\frac{\sqrt{q^2-u^2}}d
  \]
  (all functions of $(u,q,v)$).  The two \emph{mixed residuals} are
  \begin{align*}
    R_1(u,v)&=\arcsin\bigl(p\tfrac A2\bigr)+\arcsin\bigl(t\tfrac B2\bigr)
      -\arcsin\bigl(u\tfrac A2\bigr)-\arcsin\bigl(u\tfrac B2\bigr),\\
    R_3(u,v)&=\arcsin\bigl(h\tfrac C2\bigr)+\arcsin\bigl(l\tfrac D2\bigr)
      -\arcsin\bigl(v\tfrac C2\bigr)-\arcsin\bigl(v\tfrac D2\bigr),
  \end{align*}
  and $\mathcal R(u,v)=R_1+iR_3\in\CC$.  The \emph{core half-lengths} are
  $L^{\mathrm{core}}(u,v)=(A/2,B/2,C/2,D/2)$, the cyclic vector of halved
  orthogonal-core side formulas at first curvature $1$ (the same total
  formulas whose geometric properties for $q>1$ are
  \cref{lem:nfp_ordered_core}; no such property is part of this
  definition).  These identifications hold literally:
  $R_1$ and $R_3$ equal the displayed four-arcsine expressions with $A/2$,
  $B/2$, $C/2$, $D/2$ replaced by the halved core sides at $k=1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.orderedCoreHalfLengths
lean.code:
noncomputable def orderedCoreHalfLengths (u q v : ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ :=
  ![rCoreSideA 1 u q v / 2, rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2,
    rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2, rCoreSideD 1 u q v / 2]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.rResidualMap
lean.code:
noncomputable def rResidualMap (p t q h l : ℝ) (z : ℝ × ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (rResidualOne p t q z.1 z.2 : ℂ) +
    (rResidualThree q h l z.1 z.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.rResidualOne
lean.code:
noncomputable def rResidualOne (p t q u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  let a := √(q ^ 2 - v ^ 2) / d
  let b := √(1 - v ^ 2) / d
  Real.arcsin (p * a) + Real.arcsin (t * b) -
    Real.arcsin (u * a) - Real.arcsin (u * b)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.rResidualThree
lean.code:
noncomputable def rResidualThree (q h l u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  let c := √(1 - u ^ 2) / d
  let e := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2) / d
  Real.arcsin (h * c) + Real.arcsin (l * e) -
    Real.arcsin (v * c) - Real.arcsin (v * e)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_three_eq_core_sides
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_three_eq_core_sides (q h l u v : ℝ) :
    rResidualThree q h l u v =
      Real.arcsin (h * (rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2)) +
        Real.arcsin (l * (rCoreSideD 1 u q v / 2)) -
          Real.arcsin (v * (rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2)) -
            Real.arcsin (v * (rCoreSideD 1 u q v / 2)) := by
  simp only [r_core_side_c_half_at_one, r_core_side_d_half_at_one]
  rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_one_eq_core_sides
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_one_eq_core_sides (p t q u v : ℝ) :
    rResidualOne p t q u v =
      Real.arcsin (p * (rCoreSideA 1 u q v / 2)) +
        Real.arcsin (t * (rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2)) -
          Real.arcsin (u * (rCoreSideA 1 u q v / 2)) -
            Real.arcsin (u * (rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2)) := by
  simp only [r_core_side_a_half_at_one, r_core_side_b_half_at_one]
  rfl

entries.label: lem:nfp_ordered_walls
entries.title: core walls on the closed rectangle
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Let $1<q$ and $(u,v)\in[0,1]^2$.  Then $q^2-u^2v^2>0$, so $\mathcal R$ is
  continuous on $[p,1]\times[l,1]$.  If $0<t<q$ then
  $t^2(1-v^2)<q^2-u^2v^2$, and for $v<1$ this is the strict wall
  $t\,B/2<1$.  If $0\le p\le u$, $1<h$ and
  \[
    h^2(1-p^2)+p^2<q^2\qquad\mathrm{(HB)}
  \]
  then $h^2(1-u^2)<q^2-u^2v^2$, and for $u<1$ this is the strict wall
  $h\,C/2<1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_denom_pos_aux
lean.code:
lemma r_denom_pos_aux {q u v : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 < q) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) :
    0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := by
  have huv0 : 0 ≤ u * v := mul_nonneg hu0 hv0
  have huv1 : u * v ≤ 1 := by
    simpa using mul_le_mul hu1 hv1 hv0 zero_le_one
  have huvq : u * v < q := huv1.trans_lt hq
  have hsquare := (sq_lt_sq₀ huv0 (lt_trans zero_lt_one hq).le).2 huvq
  nlinarith [hsquare]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.continuousOn_rResidualMap_of_denom_pos
lean.code:
theorem continuousOn_rResidualMap_of_denom_pos
    {p t q h l : ℝ} {s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hden : ∀ z ∈ s, 0 < q ^ 2 - z.1 ^ 2 * z.2 ^ 2) :
    ContinuousOn (rResidualMap p t q h l) s := by
  have hOne := continuousOn_rResidualOne_of_denom_pos (p := p) (t := t) hden
  have hThree := continuousOn_rResidualThree_of_denom_pos (h := h) (l := l) hden
  exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hOne).add
    ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hThree).mul continuousOn_const)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_actual_h_sideC_wall_lt_one
lean.code:
theorem r_actual_h_sideC_wall_lt_one {p q h u v : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpu : p ≤ u) (hh : 1 < h)
    (hu1 : u < 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1)
    (hbase : h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2) :
    |h * (rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2)| < 1 := by
  let c := √(1 - u ^ 2)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  have hcInside : 0 < 1 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hc, hcsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hcInside
  have hwall := r_h_wall_pos_on_rectangle hp hpu hh hv0 hv1 hbase
  have hh0 : 0 < h := zero_lt_one.trans hh
  have hleft : 0 < h ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) :=
    mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hh0) hcInside
  have hdInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := hleft.trans hwall
  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside
  have hhc : h * c < d := by
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (mul_pos hh0 hc).le hd.le).1
    rw [mul_pow, hcsq, hdsq]
    exact hwall
  have hratio : h * (c / d) < 1 := by
    calc
      h * (c / d) = (h * c) / d := by ring
      _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hd).2 hhc
  rw [r_core_side_c_half_at_one, abs_of_pos]
  · simpa only [c, d] using hratio
  · exact mul_pos hh0 (div_pos hc hd)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_h_wall_pos_on_rectangle
lean.code:
theorem r_h_wall_pos_on_rectangle {p q h u v : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpu : p ≤ u) (hh : 1 < h)
    (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1)
    (hbase : h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2) :
    h ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 :=
  r_h_wall_pos_aux hp hpu hh hv0 hv1 hbase

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.hWall_margin_identity
lean.code:
lemma hWall_margin_identity (q u v h : ℝ) :
    q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 - h ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) =
      q ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + u ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - v ^ 2) := by
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.tWall_margin_identity
lean.code:
lemma tWall_margin_identity (q u v t : ℝ) :
    q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2) =
      q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 + v ^ 2 * (t ^ 2 - u ^ 2) := by
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_t_wall_pos_on_rectangle
lean.code:
theorem r_t_wall_pos_on_rectangle {q t u v : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) :
    t ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2) < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 :=
  r_t_wall_pos_aux ht htq hq hu0 hu1 hv0 hv1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_actual_t_sideB_wall_lt_one
lean.code:
theorem r_actual_t_sideB_wall_lt_one {q t u v : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    |t * (rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2)| < 1 := by
  let b := √(1 - v ^ 2)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  have hbInside : 0 < 1 - v ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hb, hbsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hbInside
  have hwall := r_t_wall_pos_on_rectangle ht htq hq hu0 hu1 hv0 hv1.le
  have hleft : 0 < t ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2) :=
    mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos ht) hbInside
  have hdInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := hleft.trans hwall
  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside
  have htb : t * b < d := by
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (mul_pos ht hb).le hd.le).1
    rw [mul_pow, hbsq, hdsq]
    exact hwall
  have hratio : t * (b / d) < 1 := by
    calc
      t * (b / d) = (t * b) / d := by ring
      _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hd).2 htb
  rw [r_core_side_b_half_at_one, abs_of_pos]
  · simpa only [b, d] using hratio
  · exact mul_pos ht (div_pos hb hd)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_three_bottom_pos
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_three_bottom_pos {q h l u : ℝ}
    (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hlh : l < h) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1)
    (hwall : h ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * l ^ 2) :
    0 < rResidualThree q h l u l := by
  let c := √(1 - u ^ 2)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * l ^ 2)
  have hcInside : 0 < 1 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hc, hcsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hcInside
  have hleft : 0 < h ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) :=
    mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hl.trans_lt hlh)) hcInside
  have hdInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * l ^ 2 := hleft.trans hwall
  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside
  have hhc : h * c < d := by
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (mul_pos (hl.trans_lt hlh) hc).le hd.le).1
    rw [mul_pow, hcsq, hdsq]
    exact hwall
  have hangle := arcsin_scaled_lt_aux hl hlh hc hd hhc.le
  have hangle' : Real.arcsin (l * (c / d)) < Real.arcsin (h * (c / d)) := by
    simpa [c, d, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using hangle
  dsimp only [rResidualThree]
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_three_top_left_eq
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_three_top_left_eq {p q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p < q) :
    rResidualThree q h l p 1 =
      Real.arcsin (h * (√(1 - p ^ 2) / √(q ^ 2 - p ^ 2))) +
        Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin (√(1 - p ^ 2) / √(q ^ 2 - p ^ 2)) -
          Real.pi / 2 := by
  have hden : √(q ^ 2 - p ^ 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 <| by
    nlinarith [sq_lt_sq₀ hp (hp.trans_lt hpq).le |>.2 hpq]).ne'
  simp [rResidualThree, hden, Real.arcsin_one]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_one_top_neg
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_one_top_neg {p t q u : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpu : p < u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) (hq : 1 < q) :
    rResidualOne p t q u 1 < 0 := by
  let a := √(q ^ 2 - 1)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2)
  have haInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨ha, hasq⟩ := square_root_data_aux haInside
  have hdInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside
  have hua : u * a ≤ d := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt hp hpu) ha).le hd.le).1
    rw [mul_pow, hasq, hdsq]
    have huSq : u ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      simpa using (sq_le_sq₀ (lt_of_le_of_lt hp hpu).le zero_le_one).2 hu1
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg q) (sub_nonneg.mpr huSq)]
  have hangle := arcsin_scaled_lt_aux hp hpu ha hd hua
  have hangle' : Real.arcsin (p * (a / d)) < Real.arcsin (u * (a / d)) := by
    simpa [a, d, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using hangle
  dsimp only [rResidualOne]
  simpa using hangle'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.r_corner_eq_firstPairFlag
lean.code:
theorem r_corner_eq_firstPairFlag {p t q l : ℝ}
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hq : 1 < q) :
    rResidualOne p t q 1 l = firstPairFlag p t q l := by
  rw [r_residual_one_bottom_right_eq hl.le (by linarith)]
  rw [firstPairFlag, firstPairSigma, Real.sqrt_div (by nlinarith : 0 ≤ 1 - l ^ 2)]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_three_right_neg
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_three_right_neg {q h l v : ℝ}
    (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hlv : l < v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) (hq : 1 < q) :
    rResidualThree q h l 1 v < 0 := by
  let e := √(q ^ 2 - 1)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - v ^ 2)
  have heInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨he, hesq⟩ := square_root_data_aux heInside
  have hdInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - v ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside
  have hve : v * e ≤ d := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (mul_pos (hl.trans_lt hlv) he).le hd.le).1
    rw [mul_pow, hesq, hdsq]
    have hvSq : v ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      simpa using (sq_le_sq₀ (hl.trans_lt hlv).le zero_le_one).2 hv1
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg q) (sub_nonneg.mpr hvSq)]
  have hangle := arcsin_scaled_lt_aux hl hlv he hd hve
  have hangle' : Real.arcsin (l * (e / d)) < Real.arcsin (v * (e / d)) := by
    simpa [e, d, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using hangle
  dsimp only [rResidualThree]
  simpa using hangle'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_one_bottom_right_eq
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_one_bottom_right_eq {p t q l : ℝ}
    (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hlq : l < q) :
    rResidualOne p t q 1 l =
      Real.arcsin p +
        Real.arcsin (t * (√(1 - l ^ 2) / √(q ^ 2 - l ^ 2))) -
          Real.pi / 2 -
            Real.arcsin (√(1 - l ^ 2) / √(q ^ 2 - l ^ 2)) := by
  have hden : √(q ^ 2 - l ^ 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 <| by
    nlinarith [sq_lt_sq₀ hl (hl.trans_lt hlq).le |>.2 hlq]).ne'
  simp [rResidualOne, hden, Real.arcsin_one]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_one_left_pos
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_one_left_pos {p t q v : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpt : p < t) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v < 1)
    (hwall : t ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2) < q ^ 2 - p ^ 2 * v ^ 2) :
    0 < rResidualOne p t q p v := by
  let b := √(1 - v ^ 2)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - p ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  have hbInside : 0 < 1 - v ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hb, hbsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hbInside
  have hleft : 0 < t ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2) :=
    mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hp.trans hpt)) hbInside
  have hdInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - p ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := hleft.trans hwall
  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside
  have htb : t * b < d := by
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (mul_pos (hp.trans hpt) hb).le hd.le).1
    rw [mul_pow, hbsq, hdsq]
    exact hwall
  have hangle := arcsin_scaled_lt_aux hp.le hpt hb hd htb.le
  have hangle' : Real.arcsin (p * (b / d)) < Real.arcsin (t * (b / d)) := by
    simpa [b, d, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using hangle
  dsimp only [rResidualOne]
  linarith

entries.label: lem:nfp_critical_hwall
entries.title: the current flag in rectangle form
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
If $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $1<q<h$ and $\Phi(p,q,h,l)\ge0$, then
  \[
    p+ra\le q,\qquad h^2r^2+p^2<(p+ra)^2,\qquad
    h^2(1-p^2)+p^2<q^2 .
  \]
  The last inequality $\mathrm{(HB)}$ is strict even when the flag is
  zero.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.one_lt_criticalValue
lean.code:
lemma one_lt_criticalValue {p r a s : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsp : s < p) (hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2)
    (hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1) :
    1 < p + r * a := by
  have hs_sq_lt : s ^ 2 < p ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hs.le hp.le).2 hsp
  have ha1 : 0 < 1 + a ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hp_scale : 1 < p ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) := by
    calc
      1 = s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) := hseq.symm
      _ < p ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs_sq_lt ha1
  have hpa_sq : r ^ 2 < (p * a) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hrsq]
    nlinarith
  have hpa : r < p * a :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hr.le (mul_pos hp ha).le).1 hpa_sq
  have hp1 : p < 1 := by
    have hr_sq : 0 < r ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr
    nlinarith
  have hra : 0 < r * a := mul_pos hr ha
  have hmul : r ^ 2 < r * p * a := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hpa hr
    nlinarith
  have hstep : (1 - p) * (1 + p) < (r * a) * (1 + p) := by
    calc
      (1 - p) * (1 + p) = r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      _ < r * p * a := hmul
      _ < (r * a) * (1 + p) := by
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show p < 1 + p by linarith) hra
        nlinarith
  have hgap : 1 - p < r * a :=
    lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right hstep (show 0 ≤ 1 + p by linarith)
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.critical_hWall_pos
lean.code:
theorem critical_hWall_pos {p h l r a s : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsp : s < p) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2)
    (haeq : a ^ 2 * (1 - l ^ 2) = h ^ 2 - 1)
    (hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1) :
    h ^ 2 * r ^ 2 + p ^ 2 < (p + r * a) ^ 2 := by
  have hl_sq : l ^ 2 < 1 := by
    simpa using (sq_lt_sq₀ hl.le zero_le_one).2 hl1
  have hx : 0 < 1 - l ^ 2 := sub_pos.mpr hl_sq
  have hh_sq : 0 < h ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hbase_product :
      (a ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + 2) * (1 - l ^ 2) =
        (1 - l ^ 2) + l ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - 1) := by
    nlinarith
  have hbase_rhs : 0 < (1 - l ^ 2) + l ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - 1) := by
    positivity
  have hbase_product_pos :
      0 < (a ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + 2) * (1 - l ^ 2) := by
    rw [hbase_product]
    exact hbase_rhs
  have hbase : 0 < a ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + 2 := by
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_left hbase_product_pos hx.le
  have hs_sq_lt : s ^ 2 < p ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hs.le hp.le).2 hsp
  have ha1 : 0 < 1 + a ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hp_scale : 1 < p ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) := by
    calc
      1 = s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) := hseq.symm
      _ < p ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs_sq_lt ha1
  have hpa_sq : r ^ 2 < (p * a) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hrsq]
    nlinarith
  have hpa : r < p * a :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hr.le (mul_pos hp ha).le).1 hpa_sq
  have hcross : 2 * r ^ 2 < 2 * p * r * a := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hpa (show 0 < 2 * r by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hscaled_base : 0 < r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + 2) := by
    positivity
  rw [← sub_pos, critical_hWall_identity]
  nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.critical_hWall_identity
lean.code:
lemma critical_hWall_identity (p h r a : ℝ) :
    (p + r * a) ^ 2 - (h ^ 2 * r ^ 2 + p ^ 2) =
      r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - h ^ 2) + 2 * p * r * a := by
  ring

entries.label: lem:nfp_corner_sign
entries.title: the top-left corner is negative
entries.chapter: The first transition: physical roots and native rank
entries.body:
Under the hypotheses of \cref{lem:nfp_critical_hwall},
  \[
    \arcsin(h\rho)+\arcsin l-\arcsin\rho-\frac\pi2<0 .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_corner_residual_eq_zero_at_threshold
lean.code:
theorem r_corner_residual_eq_zero_at_threshold {h l rho d : ℝ}
    (hh : 1 < h) (hl0 : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hhl : 1 < h * l)
    (hd : d = h ^ 2 + 1 - 2 * h * l) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hrhosq : rho ^ 2 * d = 1 - l ^ 2) :
    Real.arcsin (h * rho) + Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin rho - Real.pi / 2 = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_hdpos, hHinside, _hRhoInside⟩ :=
    r_corner_threshold_bounds_aux hh hl0 hl1 hhl hd hrhosq
  have harg1 : h * rho < 1 :=
    (sq_lt_one_iff₀ (mul_pos (lt_trans zero_lt_one hh) hrho).le).1 (sub_pos.mp hHinside)
  have hcos := r_corner_threshold_cosine_aux hh hl0 hl1 hhl hd hrhosq
  have hdiff := arcsin_mul_sub_arcsin_eq_arccos_aux hh.le hrho.le harg1.le hcos
  rw [Real.arccos_eq_pi_div_two_sub_arcsin] at hdiff
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_corner_threshold_lt_inv
lean.code:
theorem r_corner_threshold_lt_inv {h l rho d : ℝ}
    (hh : 1 < h) (hl0 : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hhl : 1 < h * l)
    (hd : d = h ^ 2 + 1 - 2 * h * l) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hrhosq : rho ^ 2 * d = 1 - l ^ 2) :
    rho < 1 / h := by
  obtain ⟨_hdpos, hinside, _hRhoInside⟩ :=
    r_corner_threshold_bounds_aux hh hl0 hl1 hhl hd hrhosq
  have hh0 : 0 < h := lt_trans zero_lt_one hh
  have harg1 : h * rho < 1 :=
    (sq_lt_one_iff₀ (mul_pos hh0 hrho).le).1 (sub_pos.mp hinside)
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ hh0]
  nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_corner_residual_neg_of_one_lt_mul
lean.code:
theorem r_corner_residual_neg_of_one_lt_mul {h l rho rho0 d : ℝ}
    (hh : 1 < h) (hl0 : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hhl : 1 < h * l)
    (hrho0 : 0 ≤ rho) (hrho : rho < rho0)
    (hd : d = h ^ 2 + 1 - 2 * h * l) (hrho0pos : 0 < rho0)
    (hrho0sq : rho0 ^ 2 * d = 1 - l ^ 2) :
    Real.arcsin (h * rho) + Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin rho - Real.pi / 2 < 0 := by
  have hrho0Upper := r_corner_threshold_lt_inv hh hl0 hl1 hhl hd hrho0pos hrho0sq
  have hzero :=
    r_corner_residual_eq_zero_at_threshold hh hl0 hl1 hhl hd hrho0pos hrho0sq
  have hdiff := strictMonoOn_arcsin_mul_sub_arcsin hh
    ⟨hrho0, (hrho.trans hrho0Upper).le⟩ ⟨hrho0pos.le, hrho0Upper.le⟩ hrho
  dsimp only at hdiff
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_corner_residual_neg_of_failure
lean.code:
theorem r_corner_residual_neg_of_failure {p q h l r a s rho : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s) (hsp : s < p)
    (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2)
    (haeq : a ^ 2 * (1 - l ^ 2) = h ^ 2 - 1)
    (hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1)
    (hqcrit : p + r * a ≤ q) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hrhoSq : rho ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - p ^ 2) = r ^ 2) :
    Real.arcsin (h * rho) + Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin rho - Real.pi / 2 < 0 := by
  have hwall := critical_hWall_pos hp hr ha hs hsp hh hl hl1 hrsq haeq hseq
  by_cases hhl : h * l ≤ 1
  · have hrhoInv := r_corner_rho_lt_inv_aux hp hr ha hh hqcrit hwall hrho hrhoSq
    exact r_corner_residual_neg_of_mul_le_one hh hrho.le hrhoInv hhl
  · have hhl' : 1 < h * l := lt_of_not_ge hhl
    obtain ⟨d, rho0, hd, hrho0, hrho0Sq, hrhoLt⟩ :=
      exists_r_corner_threshold_gt_rho_aux hp hr ha hl hl1 hhl' haeq hqcrit
        hrho hrhoSq
    exact r_corner_residual_neg_of_one_lt_mul hh hl hl1 hhl' hrho.le hrhoLt
      hd hrho0 hrho0Sq

/-! ## The complementary bottom-right corner -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_corner_residual_neg_of_mul_le_one
lean.code:
theorem r_corner_residual_neg_of_mul_le_one {h l rho : ℝ}
    (hh : 1 < h) (hrho0 : 0 ≤ rho) (hrho : rho < 1 / h) (hhl : h * l ≤ 1) :
    Real.arcsin (h * rho) + Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin rho - Real.pi / 2 < 0 := by
  have hh0 : 0 < h := lt_trans zero_lt_one hh
  have hl : l ≤ 1 / h := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]
    simpa [mul_comm] using hhl
  have hinv0 : 0 ≤ 1 / h := one_div_nonneg.mpr hh0.le
  have hdiff := strictMonoOn_arcsin_mul_sub_arcsin hh
    ⟨hrho0, hrho.le⟩ ⟨hinv0, le_rfl⟩ hrho
  dsimp only at hdiff
  rw [show h * (1 / h) = 1 by field_simp, Real.arcsin_one] at hdiff
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : _ < Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin (1 / h))
    (sub_nonpos.mpr (Real.arcsin_le_arcsin hl))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.strictMonoOn_arcsin_mul_sub_arcsin
lean.code:
theorem strictMonoOn_arcsin_mul_sub_arcsin {h : ℝ} (hh : 1 < h) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun x ↦ Real.arcsin (h * x) - Real.arcsin x) (Icc 0 (1 / h)) := by
  apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Icc _ _)
  · fun_prop
  · intro x hx
    rw [interior_Icc] at hx
    have hh0 : 0 < h := lt_trans zero_lt_one hh
    have hhx1 : h * x < 1 := by
      have := (lt_div_iff₀ hh0).1 hx.2
      nlinarith
    have hx1 : x < 1 := hx.2.trans ((div_lt_one hh0).2 hh)
    have hhx0 : 0 < h * x := mul_pos hh0 hx.1
    have hd₁ := (Real.hasDerivAt_arcsin (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)).comp x
      (hasDerivAt_const_mul h)
    have hd₂ := Real.hasDerivAt_arcsin (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith : x ≠ 1)
    have hd := hd₁.sub hd₂
    change 0 < deriv ((Real.arcsin ∘ fun y ↦ h * y) - Real.arcsin) x
    rw [hd.deriv]
    have hA : 0 < √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 <|
      sub_pos.mpr ((sq_lt_one_iff₀ hhx0.le).2 hhx1)
    have hB : 0 < √(1 - x ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 <|
      sub_pos.mpr ((sq_lt_one_iff₀ hx.1.le).2 hx1)
    have hxlt : x < h * x := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hh) hx.1]
    have hsq : x ^ 2 < (h * x) ^ 2 := (sq_lt_sq₀ hx.1.le hhx0.le).2 hxlt
    have hAB : √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) < √(1 - x ^ 2) :=
      Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
    have hinv : 1 / √(1 - x ^ 2) < 1 / √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) :=
      one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt hA hAB
    have hscale :
        1 / √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) < 1 / √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) * h := by
      simpa using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hh (one_div_pos.mpr hA)
    exact sub_pos.mpr (hinv.trans hscale)
