entries.label: def:discrete_import_winding_at
entries.title: Winding about an avoided point
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For $w\in\mathbb C$, $\gamma\in C(I,\mathbb C)$, and a proof that
$\gamma(t)\ne w$ for every $t$, radially normalize $\gamma-w$ to the unit
circle.  Lift that path along $\operatorname{Circle.exp}$ to a continuous
real angle $\phi$, using the chosen initial preimage.  Define
$W_w(\gamma)=(\phi(1)-\phi(0))/(2\pi)$.
The definition allows open paths; it does not assume $\gamma(0)=\gamma(1)$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt
lean.code:
noncomputable def windingNumberAt (w : ℂ) (γ : C(I, ℂ)) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ w) : ℝ :=
  windingNumber (normLoopAt w γ hγ)

entries.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_congr
entries.title: Pointwise congruence
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
Pointwise equal continuous paths avoiding the same $w$ have equal $W_w$,
regardless of the proofs of avoidance used in the definition.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_congr
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_congr {w : ℂ} {γ γ' : C(I, ℂ)} {hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ w}
    {hγ' : ∀ t, γ' t ≠ w} (he : ∀ t, γ t = γ' t) :
    windingNumberAt w γ hγ = windingNumberAt w γ' hγ' := by
  obtain rfl : γ = γ' := ContinuousMap.ext he
  rfl

entries.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_lift
entries.title: Evaluation from a polar lift
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
If $\phi\in C(I,\mathbb R)$ and
$\gamma(t)-w=\|\gamma(t)-w\|e^{i\phi(t)}$ for every $t$, with
$\gamma(t)\ne w$, then $W_w(\gamma)=(\phi(1)-\phi(0))/(2\pi)$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift {w : ℂ} {γ : C(I, ℂ)} (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ w) (φ : C(I, ℝ))
    (hφ : ∀ t, γ t - w = ‖γ t - w‖ * exp (φ t * Complex.I)) :
    windingNumberAt w γ hγ = (φ 1 - φ 0) / (2 * π) := by
  refine windingNumber_eq_div_of_lift _ φ fun t ↦ ?_
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Circle.coe_exp]
  change exp ((φ t : ℂ) * Complex.I) = (γ t - w) / (‖γ t - w‖ : ℂ)
  rw [eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast norm_ne_zero_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 (hγ t)))]
  linear_combination -hφ t

/-- A constant curve has winding number `0` about any point it avoids. -/
@[simp]

entries.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_const
entries.title: Constant paths
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body: For $z\ne w$, the constant path with value $z$ has $W_w=0$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_const
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_const (w z : ℂ) (h : ∀ t : I, (ContinuousMap.const I z) t ≠ w) :
    windingNumberAt w (ContinuousMap.const I z) h = 0 := by
  have hnl : normLoopAt w (ContinuousMap.const I z) h
      = ContinuousMap.const I (circleProjAt w z (h 0)) :=
    ContinuousMap.ext fun t ↦ circleProjAt_congr (h t) (h 0) rfl
  rw [windingNumberAt, hnl, windingNumber_const]

entries.label: thm:discrete_import_winding_homotopy
entries.title: Free homotopy through avoiding loops
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
Let $\gamma_0,\gamma_1\in C(I,\mathbb C)$ avoid $w$.  Let
$H\in C(I\times I,\mathbb C)$ avoid $w$ everywhere, with
$H(0,t)=\gamma_0(t)$, $H(1,t)=\gamma_1(t)$, and
$H(s,0)=H(s,1)$ for all $s$.  Then $W_w(\gamma_0)=W_w(\gamma_1)$.
No common fixed base point of the loops is required.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy (w : ℂ) (γ₀ γ₁ : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ₀ : ∀ t, γ₀ t ≠ w) (hγ₁ : ∀ t, γ₁ t ≠ w)
    (H : C(I × I, ℂ)) (hH : ∀ st, H st ≠ w)
    (h0 : ∀ t, H (0, t) = γ₀ t) (h1 : ∀ t, H (1, t) = γ₁ t)
    (hloop : ∀ s, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)) :
    windingNumberAt w γ₀ hγ₀ = windingNumberAt w γ₁ hγ₁ := by
  set Hn : C(I × I, Circle) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ circleProjAt w (H st) (hH st),
      continuous_circleProjAt H.continuous hH⟩ with hHndef
  have h0' : ∀ t : I, Hn (0, t) = normLoopAt w γ₀ hγ₀ t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (H (0, t)) (hH (0, t)) =
      circleProjAt w (γ₀ t) (hγ₀ t)
    exact circleProjAt_congr _ _ (h0 t)
  have h1' : ∀ t : I, Hn (1, t) = normLoopAt w γ₁ hγ₁ t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (H (1, t)) (hH (1, t)) =
      circleProjAt w (γ₁ t) (hγ₁ t)
    exact circleProjAt_congr _ _ (h1 t)
  have hloop' : ∀ s : I, Hn (s, 0) = Hn (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    change circleProjAt w (H (s, 0)) (hH (s, 0)) =
      circleProjAt w (H (s, 1)) (hH (s, 1))
    exact circleProjAt_congr _ _ (hloop s)
  exact windingNumber_eq_of_homotopy Hn h0' h1' hloop'

entries.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_mul
entries.title: Product of nonvanishing paths
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For paths $\gamma,\gamma'$ avoiding zero,
$W_0(\gamma\gamma')=W_0(\gamma)+W_0(\gamma')$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_mul
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_mul (γ γ' : C(I, ℂ)) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) (hγ' : ∀ t, γ' t ≠ 0) :
    windingNumberAt 0 (γ * γ') (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero (hγ t) (hγ' t))
      = windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ + windingNumberAt 0 γ' hγ' := by
  have hnl : normLoopAt 0 (γ * γ') (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero (hγ t) (hγ' t))
      = normLoopAt 0 γ hγ * normLoopAt 0 γ' hγ' :=
    ContinuousMap.ext fun t ↦ circleProjAt_zero_mul (hγ t) (hγ' t)
  rw [windingNumberAt, hnl, windingNumber_mul, windingNumberAt, windingNumberAt]

entries.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_const_mul
entries.title: Constant complex scaling
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body: For $c\ne0$ and a path $\gamma$ avoiding zero, $W_0(c\gamma)=W_0(\gamma)$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_const_mul
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_const_mul (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (γ : C(I, ℂ)) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) :
    windingNumberAt 0 (ContinuousMap.const I c * γ) (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero hc (hγ t))
      = windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ := by
  have h := windingNumberAt_mul (ContinuousMap.const I c) γ (fun _ ↦ hc) hγ
  rw [windingNumberAt_const 0 c fun _ ↦ hc, zero_add] at h
  exact h

/-! ### The continuous Rouché theorem ("dog-on-a-leash") -/

entries.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_exp_int
entries.title: Integer exponential loop
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For every integer $k$, the path $t\mapsto e^{2\pi i k t}$ avoids zero
and has $W_0=k$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_exp_int_mul
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_exp_int_mul (n : ℤ) :
    windingNumberAt 0
      ⟨fun t : I ↦ exp ((2 * π * n * t : ℝ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩
      (fun _ ↦ exp_ne_zero _) = n := by
  rw [windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift (fun _ ↦ exp_ne_zero _)
    ⟨fun t : I ↦ 2 * π * n * t, by fun_prop⟩ fun t ↦ by
      change exp ((2 * π * n * t : ℝ) * Complex.I) - 0
        = (‖exp (((2 * π * n * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 0‖ : ℂ)
          * exp (((2 * π * n * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      rw [sub_zero, norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, ofReal_one, one_mul]]
  have h2pi : (2 * π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  change (2 * π * n * ((1 : I) : ℝ) - 2 * π * n * ((0 : I) : ℝ)) / (2 * π) = n
  rw [Set.Icc.coe_one, Set.Icc.coe_zero, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h2pi]

/-! ### The planar degree existence principle -/

entries.label: thm:discrete_import_winding_perturb
entries.title: Symmetric perturbation criterion
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For closed continuous paths $\gamma,\gamma'$ and $w\in\mathbb C$, assume
$\|\gamma'(t)-\gamma(t)\|<\|\gamma(t)-w\|+\|\gamma'(t)-w\|$
at every $t$.  Both paths avoid $w$, and $W_w(\gamma)=W_w(\gamma')$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_norm_sub_lt
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_of_norm_sub_lt (w : ℂ) (γ γ' : C(I, ℂ))
    (hloopγ : γ 0 = γ 1) (hloopγ' : γ' 0 = γ' 1)
    (hpert : ∀ t, ‖γ' t - γ t‖ < ‖γ t - w‖ + ‖γ' t - w‖) :
    windingNumberAt w γ (ne_of_norm_sub_lt_left hpert) =
      windingNumberAt w γ' (ne_of_norm_sub_lt_right hpert) := by
  have hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ w := ne_of_norm_sub_lt_left hpert
  have hγ' : ∀ t, γ' t ≠ w := ne_of_norm_sub_lt_right hpert
  set Hc : I × I → ℂ := fun st ↦ γ st.2 + (st.1 : ℝ) • (γ' st.2 - γ st.2) with hHcdef
  have hHccont : Continuous Hc := by
    rw [hHcdef]
    exact (γ.continuous.comp continuous_snd).add
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).smul
        ((γ'.continuous.comp continuous_snd).sub (γ.continuous.comp continuous_snd)))
  have hHcne : ∀ st : I × I, Hc st ≠ w := by
    intro st
    have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (st.1 : ℝ) := st.1.2.1
    have hs1 : (st.1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := st.1.2.2
    have hkey : Hc st - w =
        (γ st.2 - w) + (st.1 : ℝ) • ((γ' st.2 - w) - (γ st.2 - w)) := by
      simp only [hHcdef]
      rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
      abel
    have hpert' : ‖(γ st.2 - w) - (γ' st.2 - w)‖ < ‖γ st.2 - w‖ + ‖γ' st.2 - w‖ := by
      have he : (γ st.2 - w) - (γ' st.2 - w) = γ st.2 - γ' st.2 := by ring
      rw [he, norm_sub_rev]
      exact hpert st.2
    intro hcon
    apply segment_ne_zero hpert' hs0 hs1
    rw [← hkey, hcon, sub_self]
  set H : C(I × I, Circle) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ circleProjAt w (Hc st) (hHcne st), continuous_circleProjAt hHccont hHcne⟩
  have h0 : ∀ t : I, H (0, t) = normLoopAt w γ hγ t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (Hc (0, t)) (hHcne (0, t)) = circleProjAt w (γ t) (hγ t)
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    change γ t + ((0 : I) : ℝ) • (γ' t - γ t) = γ t
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have h1 : ∀ t : I, H (1, t) = normLoopAt w γ' hγ' t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (Hc (1, t)) (hHcne (1, t)) = circleProjAt w (γ' t) (hγ' t)
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    change γ t + ((1 : I) : ℝ) • (γ' t - γ t) = γ' t
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_one, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
  have hloop : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    change circleProjAt w (Hc (s, 0)) (hHcne (s, 0)) = circleProjAt w (Hc (s, 1)) (hHcne (s, 1))
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    change γ (0 : I) + (s : ℝ) • (γ' (0 : I) - γ (0 : I))
      = γ (1 : I) + (s : ℝ) • (γ' (1 : I) - γ (1 : I))
    rw [hloopγ, hloopγ']
  have hinv := windingNumber_eq_of_homotopy H h0 h1 hloop
  rw [windingNumberAt, windingNumberAt, hinv]

/-! ### The boundary loop of a circle -/

entries.label: def:discrete_import_circle_loop
entries.title: Circle boundary path
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For $c\in\mathbb C$, $R\in\mathbb R$, and $F$ continuous on
the sphere of center $c$ and radius $|R|$, define the bundled path
$t\mapsto F(c+R e^{2\pi it})$ on $I$.

lean.name: Complex.circleLoop
lean.code:
noncomputable def circleLoop (F : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (sphere c |R|)) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ F (circleMap c R (2 * π * t)), by
    apply hF.comp_continuous
    · exact (continuous_circleMap c R).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_subtype_val)
    · exact fun t ↦ circleMap_mem_sphere' c R _⟩

/-- Evaluation of the boundary loop: `circleLoop F c R hF t = F (circleMap c R (2 * π * t))`. -/
@[simp]

entries.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_circle
entries.title: The positively oriented circle
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For $R>0$, the circle boundary path of the identity with center $c$ and
radius $R$ avoids $c$ and has winding $1$ about $c$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_circleLoop_id
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_circleLoop_id (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    windingNumberAt c (circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn)
      (circleLoop_id_ne c hR.ne') = 1 := by
  have hlift : ∀ t : I,
      Circle.exp ((⟨fun t : I ↦ 2 * π * (t : ℝ), by fun_prop⟩ : C(I, ℝ)) t) =
        normLoopAt c (circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn)
          (circleLoop_id_ne c hR.ne') t := by
    intro t
    have hsub : circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn t - c =
        (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((2 * π * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
      change circleMap c R (2 * π * (t : ℝ)) - c = _
      rw [circleMap, add_sub_cancel_left]
    have hnorm : ‖circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn t - c‖ = R := by
      rw [hsub, norm_mul, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR,
        norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Circle.coe_exp]
    change Complex.exp (((2 * π * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        (circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn t - c) /
          (‖circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn t - c‖ : ℂ)
    rw [hnorm, hsub, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ofReal_ne_zero.2 hR.ne')]
  rw [windingNumberAt, windingNumber_eq_div_of_lift _ _ hlift]
  have h2pi : (2 * π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  change (2 * π * ((1 : I) : ℝ) - 2 * π * ((0 : I) : ℝ)) / (2 * π) = 1
  rw [Set.Icc.coe_one, Set.Icc.coe_zero, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero, div_self h2pi]

entries.label: thm:discrete_import_degree
entries.title: Nonzero boundary winding attains the avoided value
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
Let $R>0$, let $F:\mathbb C\to\mathbb C$ be continuous on the closed
ball of center $c$ and radius $R$, and suppose $F(z)\ne w$ on its sphere.
If the circle boundary path of $F$ has nonzero winding about $w$, then
there exists $z$ in the open ball with $F(z)=w$.

lean.name: Complex.exists_eq_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero
lean.code:
theorem exists_eq_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero (F : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (w : ℂ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (closedBall c R)) (hbd : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, F z ≠ w)
    (hw : windingNumberAt w
      (circleLoop F c R (hF.mono (sphere_subset_closedBall.trans
        (closedBall_subset_closedBall (abs_of_pos hR).le))))
      (circleLoop_ne F c R w _
        fun z hz ↦ hbd z (mem_sphere.2 ((mem_sphere.1 hz).trans (abs_of_pos hR)))) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z ∈ ball c R, F z = w := by
  by_contra hcon
  simp only [not_exists, not_and] at hcon
  have hFs : ContinuousOn F (sphere c |R|) :=
    hF.mono (sphere_subset_closedBall.trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (abs_of_pos hR).le))
  have hbd' : ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, F z ≠ w :=
    fun z hz ↦ hbd z (mem_sphere.2 ((mem_sphere.1 hz).trans (abs_of_pos hR)))
  have hne : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, F z ≠ w := by
    intro z hz
    rcases (mem_closedBall.1 hz).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact hcon z (mem_ball.2 h)
    · exact hbd z (mem_sphere.2 h)
  have hFc : F c ≠ w := hne c (mem_closedBall_self hR.le)
  set pt : I × I → ℂ := fun st ↦ c + ((st.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * circleMap 0 R (2 * π * st.2)
    with hptdef
  have hptcont : Continuous pt := by
    rw [hptdef]
    exact continuous_const.add ((continuous_ofReal.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).mul ((continuous_circleMap 0 R).comp
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))))
  have hptmem : ∀ st : I × I, pt st ∈ closedBall c R := by
    intro st
    have hnorm : ‖pt st - c‖ = (st.1 : ℝ) * R := by
      rw [hptdef]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_nonneg st.1.2.1, abs_of_pos hR]
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hnorm]
    nlinarith [st.1.2.2, hR.le]
  have hFptcont : Continuous fun st ↦ F (pt st) := hF.comp_continuous hptcont hptmem
  have hFptne : ∀ st, F (pt st) ≠ w := fun st ↦ hne _ (hptmem st)
  set Hmap : C(I × I, Circle) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ circleProjAt w (F (pt st)) (hFptne st), continuous_circleProjAt hFptcont hFptne⟩
  have h0 : ∀ t, Hmap (0, t) = (ContinuousMap.const I (circleProjAt w (F c) hFc)) t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (F (pt (0, t))) (hFptne (0, t)) = circleProjAt w (F c) hFc
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    have hpt0 : pt (0, t) = c := by simp [hptdef]
    rw [hpt0]
  have h1 : ∀ t, Hmap (1, t) =
      normLoopAt w (circleLoop F c R hFs) (circleLoop_ne F c R w hFs hbd') t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (F (pt (1, t))) (hFptne (1, t)) =
      circleProjAt w (circleLoop F c R hFs t) (circleLoop_ne F c R w hFs hbd' t)
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    change F (pt (1, t)) = F (circleMap c R (2 * π * t))
    congr 1
    simp [hptdef, circleMap]
  have hloop : ∀ s, Hmap (s, 0) = Hmap (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    change circleProjAt w (F (pt (s, 0))) (hFptne (s, 0)) =
      circleProjAt w (F (pt (s, 1))) (hFptne (s, 1))
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    have hpt : pt (s, 0) = pt (s, 1) := by
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: def:discrete_winding_number_c
entries.title: Origin-centered winding
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For $\gamma\in C(I,\mathbb C)$ avoiding zero, normalize by
$\gamma(t)/\|\gamma(t)\|$, take the chosen circle-covering angle lift,
and divide its endpoint increment by $2\pi$.  Write this as $W_C(\gamma)$.
The private bridge in \texttt{Gluck/Winding.lean} identifies it with
$W_0(\gamma)$ by the polar-lift evaluation rule.  Closedness is not a
hypothesis of this definition.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC
lean.code:
noncomputable def windingNumberC (γ : C(I, ℂ)) (h : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) : ℝ :=
  windingNumber (normLoop γ h)

entries.label: thm:discrete_winding_number_c_homotopy
entries.title: Gluck free-homotopy interface
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For two nowhere-zero paths and a nowhere-zero $H\in C(I\times I,\mathbb C)$
with those paths as its $s=0,1$ endpoints and $H(s,0)=H(s,1)$ for every
$s$, their $W_C$ values agree.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_eq_of_homotopy
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_eq_of_homotopy (γ₀ γ₁ : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ₀ : ∀ t, γ₀ t ≠ 0) (hγ₁ : ∀ t, γ₁ t ≠ 0)
    (H : C(I × I, ℂ)) (hH : ∀ st, H st ≠ 0)
    (h0 : ∀ t, H (0, t) = γ₀ t) (h1 : ∀ t, H (1, t) = γ₁ t)
    (hloop : ∀ s, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)) :
    windingNumberC γ₀ hγ₀ = windingNumberC γ₁ hγ₁ := by
  rw [windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt, windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt]
  exact Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy 0 γ₀ γ₁ hγ₀ hγ₁ H hH h0 h1 hloop

/-! ## The boundary loop of a map on the closed unit disk -/

entries.label: lem:discrete_winding_number_c_perturb
entries.title: One-sided perturbation interface
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
Let $\gamma,\gamma'$ be nowhere-zero continuous paths, both closed, and
suppose $\|\gamma'(t)-\gamma(t)\|<\|\gamma(t)\|$ for all $t$.
Then $W_C(\gamma)=W_C(\gamma')$.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_eq_of_perturb
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_eq_of_perturb (γ γ' : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) (hγ' : ∀ t, γ' t ≠ 0)
    (hloopγ : γ 0 = γ 1) (hloopγ' : γ' 0 = γ' 1)
    (hpert : ∀ t, ‖γ' t - γ t‖ < ‖γ t‖) :
    windingNumberC γ hγ = windingNumberC γ' hγ' := by
  rw [windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt, windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt]
  have hpert' : ∀ t, ‖γ' t - γ t‖ < ‖γ t - 0‖ + ‖γ' t - 0‖ := fun t => by
    rw [sub_zero, sub_zero]
    exact (hpert t).trans_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _))
  exact Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_norm_sub_lt 0 γ γ' hloopγ hloopγ' hpert'

lean.name: Gluck.expLoop

@[simp]

lean.code:

entries.label: lem:discrete_winding_number_c_exp_loop
entries.title: Forward model winding
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body: For $c\ne0$, $E_c$ is nowhere zero and $W_C(E_c)=1$.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_expLoop
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_expLoop (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    windingNumberC (expLoop c) (expLoop_ne_zero c hc) = 1 := by
  rw [windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt]
  let γ : C(I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun t ↦ Complex.exp ((2 * π * (1 : ℤ) * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩
  have hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0 := fun _ ↦ Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  calc
    Complex.windingNumberAt 0 (expLoop c) (expLoop_ne_zero c hc) =
        Complex.windingNumberAt 0
          ⟨fun t ↦ c * γ t, continuous_const.mul γ.continuous⟩
          (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero hc (hγ t)) :=
      Complex.windingNumberAt_congr fun t ↦ by simp [γ, expLoop]
    _ = Complex.windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ :=
      Complex.windingNumberAt_const_mul c hc γ hγ
    _ = 1 := by simpa [γ] using Complex.windingNumberAt_exp_int_mul 1

entries.label: lem:discrete_winding_number_c_exp_loop_rev
entries.title: Reverse model winding
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body: For $c\ne0$, $E^-_c$ is nowhere zero and $W_C(E^-_c)=-1$.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_expLoopRev
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_expLoopRev (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    windingNumberC (expLoopRev c) (expLoopRev_ne_zero c hc) = -1 := by
  rw [windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt]
  let γ : C(I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun t ↦ Complex.exp ((2 * π * (-1 : ℤ) * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩
  have hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0 := fun _ ↦ Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  calc
    Complex.windingNumberAt 0 (expLoopRev c) (expLoopRev_ne_zero c hc) =
        Complex.windingNumberAt 0
          ⟨fun t ↦ c * γ t, continuous_const.mul γ.continuous⟩
          (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero hc (hγ t)) :=
      Complex.windingNumberAt_congr fun t ↦ by simp [γ, expLoopRev]
    _ = Complex.windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ :=
      Complex.windingNumberAt_const_mul c hc γ hγ
    _ = -1 := by simpa [γ] using Complex.windingNumberAt_exp_int_mul (-1)

entries.label: def:discrete_linear_loop
entries.title: Real-linear boundary model
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For $a,b\in\mathbb C$, put $L_{a,b}(t)=E_a(t)+E^-_b(t)$.
This is the boundary path of $z\mapsto az+b\overline z$.

lean.name: Gluck.linearLoop
lean.code:
noncomputable def linearLoop (a b : ℂ) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ expLoop a t + expLoopRev b t,
    (expLoop a).continuous.add (expLoopRev b).continuous⟩

@[simp]

entries.label: lem:discrete_winding_number_c_linear_loop
entries.title: Real-linear model winding
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
For $\|a\|\ne\|b\|$, the path $L_{a,b}$ avoids zero and
$W_C(L_{a,b})=1$ if $\|b\|<\|a\|$, and $-1$ otherwise.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_linearLoop
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_linearLoop (a b : ℂ) (hab : ‖a‖ ≠ ‖b‖) :
    windingNumberC (linearLoop a b) (linearLoop_ne_zero a b hab) =
      if ‖b‖ < ‖a‖ then 1 else -1 := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hlt | hgt
  · rw [if_neg (asymm hlt)]
    have hb : b ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg a) hlt)
    have hpert : ∀ t : I, ‖linearLoop a b t - expLoopRev b t‖ < ‖expLoopRev b t‖ := by
      intro t
      have he : linearLoop a b t - expLoopRev b t = expLoop a t := by
        change expLoop a t + expLoopRev b t - expLoopRev b t = expLoop a t
        ring
      rw [he, expLoop_norm, expLoopRev_norm]
      exact hlt
    have h := windingNumberC_eq_of_perturb (expLoopRev b) (linearLoop a b)
      (expLoopRev_ne_zero b hb) (linearLoop_ne_zero a b hab)
      (expLoopRev_loop b) (linearLoop_loop a b) hpert
    rw [← h, windingNumberC_expLoopRev b hb]
  · rw [if_pos hgt]
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg b) hgt)
    have hpert : ∀ t : I, ‖linearLoop a b t - expLoop a t‖ < ‖expLoop a t‖ := by
      intro t
      have he : linearLoop a b t - expLoop a t = expLoopRev b t := by
        change expLoop a t + expLoopRev b t - expLoop a t = expLoopRev b t
        ring
      rw [he, expLoopRev_norm, expLoop_norm]
      exact hgt
    have h := windingNumberC_eq_of_perturb (expLoop a) (linearLoop a b)
      (expLoop_ne_zero a ha) (linearLoop_ne_zero a b hab)
      (expLoop_loop a) (linearLoop_loop a b) hpert
    rw [← h, windingNumberC_expLoop a ha]

entries.label: thm:discrete_poincare_miranda_rect
entries.title: Poincare--Miranda with weak face inequalities
entries.chapter: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book
entries.body:
Let $a_1\le a_2$, $b_1\le b_2$, and let
$G:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^2$ be continuous on
$K=[a_1,a_2]\times[b_1,b_2]$.  Assume $G_1(a_1,y)\le0$ and
$G_1(a_2,y)\ge0$ for every $y\in[b_1,b_2]$, and $G_2(x,b_1)\le0$ and
$G_2(x,b_2)\ge0$ for every $x\in[a_1,a_2]$.
Then there is $p\in K$ with $G(p)=0$.  Degenerate rectangles and boundary
zeros are allowed.

lean.name: poincare_miranda
lean.code:
theorem poincare_miranda {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ} (ha : a₁ ≤ a₂) (hb : b₁ ≤ b₂)
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hG : ContinuousOn G (Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc b₁ b₂))
    (hleft : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc b₁ b₂, (G (a₁, y)).1 ≤ 0)
    (hright : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc b₁ b₂, 0 ≤ (G (a₂, y)).1)
    (hbot : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂, (G (x, b₁)).2 ≤ 0)
    (htop : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂, 0 ≤ (G (x, b₂)).2) :
    ∃ p ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc b₁ b₂, G p = 0 := by
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with hae | halt
  · have hxmem : a₁ ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂ := ⟨le_rfl, ha⟩
    have hg1 : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc b₁ b₂, (G (a₁, y)).1 = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 := hleft y hy
      have h2 := hright y hy
      rw [← hae] at h2
      linarith
    have hfcont : ContinuousOn (fun y ↦ G (a₁, y)) (Set.Icc b₁ b₂) :=
      hG.comp ((continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn)
        (fun y hy ↦ Set.mk_mem_prod hxmem hy)
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y ↦ (G (a₁, y)).2) (Set.Icc b₁ b₂) :=
      continuous_snd.comp_continuousOn hfcont
    have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈
        Set.Icc ((fun y ↦ (G (a₁, y)).2) b₁) ((fun y ↦ (G (a₁, y)).2) b₂) :=
      ⟨hbot a₁ hxmem, htop a₁ hxmem⟩
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀mem, hy₀⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hb hcont hmem
    exact ⟨(a₁, y₀), Set.mk_mem_prod hxmem hy₀mem, Prod.ext (hg1 y₀ hy₀mem) hy₀⟩
  rcases hb.eq_or_lt with hbe | hblt
  · have hymem : b₁ ∈ Set.Icc b₁ b₂ := ⟨le_rfl, hb⟩
    have hg2 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂, (G (x, b₁)).2 = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 := hbot x hx
      have h2 := htop x hx
      rw [← hbe] at h2
      linarith
    have hfcont : ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ G (x, b₁)) (Set.Icc a₁ a₂) :=
      hG.comp ((continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn)
        (fun x hx ↦ Set.mk_mem_prod hx hymem)
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ (G (x, b₁)).1) (Set.Icc a₁ a₂) :=
      continuous_fst.comp_continuousOn hfcont
    have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈
        Set.Icc ((fun x ↦ (G (x, b₁)).1) a₁) ((fun x ↦ (G (x, b₁)).1) a₂) :=
      ⟨hleft b₁ hymem, hright b₁ hymem⟩
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀mem, hx₀⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc ha hcont hmem
    exact ⟨(x₀, b₁), Set.mk_mem_prod hx₀mem hymem, Prod.ext hx₀ (hg2 x₀ hx₀mem)⟩
  set K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc b₁ b₂
  have hKcomp : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  set cx : ℝ := (a₁ + a₂) / 2 with hcx
  set cy : ℝ := (b₁ + b₂) / 2 with hcy
  set w : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun p ↦ (p.1 - cx, p.2 - cy) with hw
  have hwcont : Continuous w := by fun_prop
  set Gn : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun n p ↦ G p + (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) • w p with hGn
  have hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := fun n ↦ by positivity
  have hzero : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ p ∈ K, Gn n p = 0 := by
    intro n
    apply poincare_miranda_of_lt halt hblt (Gn n)
    · exact hG.add (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop))
    · intro y hy
      have hGl := hleft y hy
      have he : (Gn n (a₁, y)).1 = (G (a₁, y)).1 + (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * (a₁ - cx) := by
        simp [hGn, hw]
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: def:discrete_trig
entries.title: generalized sine, cosine, tangent
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
For $K, x \in \mathbb{R}$ set
  \[
    s_K(x) = \begin{cases} \sin x & K = 1\\ \sinh x & K = -1\\ x &
    \text{otherwise,}\end{cases}
    \qquad
    c_K(x) = \begin{cases} \cos x & K = 1\\ \cosh x & K = -1\\ 1 &
    \text{otherwise,}\end{cases}
    \qquad
    t_K(x) = \frac{s_K(x)}{c_K(x)}.
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cK
lean.code:
noncomputable def cK (K x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if K = 1 then Real.cos x else if K = -1 then Real.cosh x else 1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sK
lean.code:
noncomputable def sK (K x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if K = 1 then Real.sin x else if K = -1 then Real.sinh x else x

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tK
lean.code:
noncomputable def tK (K x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sK K x / cK K x

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ModerateArc.wall_right
lean.code:
lemma wall_right (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ) (i : ZMod n) :
    |κ i| * tK K (ℓ i / 2) < 1 := (h i).2.2.2.2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ModerateArc.length_pos
lean.code: lemma length_pos (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ) (i : ZMod n) : 0 < ℓ i := (h i).1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ModerateArc.tK_pos
lean.code:
lemma tK_pos (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ) (i : ZMod n) : 0 < tK K (ℓ i / 2) :=
  div_pos (h i).2.1 (h i).2.2.1

lean.code:
lemma wall_left (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ) (i : ZMod n) :
    |κ i| * tK K (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) < 1 := (h i).2.2.2.1

entries.label: lem:moderate_arc_zero
entries.title: moderate arc at $K=0$
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
$\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$ holds if and only if for every $i$:
  $0<\ell_i$, $|\kappa_i|\,\ell_{i-1}/2 < 1$ and $|\kappa_i|\,\ell_i/2 < 1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.moderateArc_zero_iff
lean.code:
lemma moderateArc_zero_iff {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} :
    ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ ↔ ∀ i : ZMod n,
      0 < ℓ i ∧ |κ i| * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) < 1 ∧ |κ i| * (ℓ i / 2) < 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨h1, _, _, h4, h5⟩ := h i
    rw [tK_zero] at h4 h5
    exact ⟨h1, h4, h5⟩
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h i
    exact ⟨h1, by simpa using half_pos h1, by simp, by simpa using h2, by simpa using h3⟩

entries.label: def:turning_angle
entries.title: turning angle, (TA)
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
The turning angle at vertex $i$ of the data $(K,\kappa,\ell)$ is
  \[
    \theta_i \;=\; \arcsin\bigl(\kappa_i\, t_K(\ell_{i-1}/2)\bigr)
             \;+\; \arcsin\bigl(\kappa_i\, t_K(\ell_i/2)\bigr).
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle
lean.code:
noncomputable def turningAngle (K : ℝ) (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)) + Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ i / 2))

entries.label: lem:turning_angle_neg
entries.title: oddness in $\kappa$
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body: $\theta_i(K, -\kappa, \ell) = -\,\theta_i(K, \kappa, \ell)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle_neg
lean.code:
lemma turningAngle_neg (K : ℝ) (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) :
    turningAngle K (-κ) ℓ i = -turningAngle K κ ℓ i := by
  simp [turningAngle, neg_mul, Real.arcsin_neg]
  ring

entries.label: lem:turning_angle_sign
entries.title: sign of the turning angle
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
Under $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,K\,\kappa\,\ell$: if $\kappa_i > 0$ then
  $\theta_i > 0$; if $\kappa_i < 0$ then $\theta_i < 0$; if $\kappa_i = 0$
  then $\theta_i = 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle_pos
lean.code:
lemma turningAngle_pos {K : ℝ} {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ)
    {i : ZMod n} (hκ : 0 < κ i) : 0 < turningAngle K κ ℓ i :=
  add_pos (Real.arcsin_pos.2 (mul_pos hκ (h.tK_pos (i - 1))))
    (Real.arcsin_pos.2 (mul_pos hκ (h.tK_pos i)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle_neg_of_neg
lean.code:
lemma turningAngle_neg_of_neg {K : ℝ} {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ)
    {i : ZMod n} (hκ : κ i < 0) : turningAngle K κ ℓ i < 0 :=
  add_neg (Real.arcsin_lt_zero.2 (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hκ (h.tK_pos (i - 1))))
    (Real.arcsin_lt_zero.2 (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hκ (h.tK_pos i)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle_eq_zero

entries.label: lem:turning_angle_lt_pi
entries.title: turning angles are strictly moderate
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
Under $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,K\,\kappa\,\ell$, $|\theta_i| < \pi$ for every
  $i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.abs_turningAngle_lt_pi
lean.code:
lemma abs_turningAngle_lt_pi {K : ℝ} {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ)
    (i : ZMod n) : |turningAngle K κ ℓ i| < Real.pi := by
  have key : ∀ j : ZMod n, |κ i| * tK K (ℓ j / 2) < 1 →
      |Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ j / 2))| < Real.pi / 2 := by
    intro j hj
    have habs : |κ i * tK K (ℓ j / 2)| < 1 := by
      rwa [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (h.tK_pos j)]
    rw [abs_lt] at habs ⊢
    exact ⟨Real.neg_pi_div_two_lt_arcsin.2 habs.1, Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.2 habs.2⟩
  have h1 := key (i - 1) (h.wall_left i)
  have h2 := key i (h.wall_right i)
  calc |turningAngle K κ ℓ i|
      ≤ |Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ (i - 1) / 2))| +
        |Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ i / 2))| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ < Real.pi := by linarith

/-! ## Euclidean development and closure -/

entries.label: def:discrete_development
entries.title: headings, vertices, closure error
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
For $j, k \in \mathbb{N}$:
  \[
    \psi_j = \sum_{m=0}^{j} \theta_{(m : \mathbb{Z}/n)}, \qquad
    v_k = \sum_{j=0}^{k-1} \ell_{(j:\mathbb{Z}/n)}\,
          e^{i \psi_j} \in \mathbb{C},
  \]
  with $\theta$ the $K=0$ turning angles of \cref{def:turning_angle}. The
  \emph{closure gap} is $E(\kappa,\ell) = v_n \in \mathbb{C}$ and the
  \emph{turning sum} is
  $T(\kappa,\ell) = \sum_{i \in \mathbb{Z}/n} \theta_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.closureGap
lean.code:
noncomputable def closureGap (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℂ :=
  vertexR2 κ ℓ n

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningSum
lean.code:
noncomputable def turningSum [NeZero n] (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : ZMod n, turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexR2
lean.code:
noncomputable def vertexR2 (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
    (ℓ (j : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ j : ℂ) * Complex.I)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading
lean.code:
noncomputable def heading (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), turningAngle 0 κ ℓ (m : ZMod n)

entries.label: lem:development_recurrences
entries.title: development recurrences
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
The vertex map satisfies the one-step recurrence
  $v_{k+1} = v_k + \ell_{(k:\mathbb{Z}/n)}\,e^{i\psi_k}$; the heading over a
  full period shifts by the turning sum,
  $\psi_{j+n} = \psi_j + T(\kappa,\ell)$; and for any additive monoid $M$ and
  $g\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to M$,
  $\sum_{m=0}^{a+n-1} g_{(m:\mathbb{Z}/n)}
    = \sum_{m=0}^{a-1} g_{(m:\mathbb{Z}/n)} + \sum_{i\in\mathbb{Z}/n} g_i$
  (a period block of a lifted cyclic sum equals the full cyclic sum).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading_add_n
lean.code:
lemma heading_add_n [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (j : ℕ) :
    heading κ ℓ (j + n) = heading κ ℓ j + 2 * Real.pi := by
  unfold heading
  rw [show j + n + 1 = (j + 1) + n from by ring,
    Finset.sum_range_add (fun m => turningAngle 0 κ ℓ (m : ZMod n)) (j + 1) n,
    sum_range_natCast_add (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ) (j + 1)]
  rw [show (∑ i : ZMod n, turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) = turningSum κ ℓ from rfl, hT]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexR2_succ
lean.code:
lemma vertexR2_succ (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1) = vertexR2 κ ℓ k
      + (ℓ (k : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
  Finset.sum_range_succ _ _

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sum_range_natCast_add
lean.code:
lemma sum_range_natCast_add {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [NeZero n]
    (f : ZMod n → M) (a : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, f ((a + m : ℕ) : ZMod n) = ∑ i : ZMod n, f i := by
  have base : ∀ g : ZMod n → M,
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, g (m : ZMod n) = ∑ i : ZMod n, g i := by
    intro g
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun m => g (m : ZMod n)) n]
    exact Fintype.sum_bijective (fun i : Fin n => ((i : ℕ) : ZMod n))
      ⟨fun a b hab => Fin.ext (by
          simpa [ZMod.val_cast_of_lt a.isLt, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt b.isLt] using
            congrArg ZMod.val hab),
        fun z => ⟨⟨z.val, z.val_lt⟩, ZMod.natCast_rightInverse z⟩⟩
      _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
  calc ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, f ((a + m : ℕ) : ZMod n)
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, (fun i => f ((a : ZMod n) + i)) (m : ZMod n) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
        push_cast
        rfl
    _ = ∑ i : ZMod n, (fun i => f ((a : ZMod n) + i)) i :=
        base (fun i => f ((a : ZMod n) + i))
    _ = ∑ i : ZMod n, f i :=
        Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addLeft ((a : ℕ) : ZMod n)) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)

entries.label: lem:development_periodic
entries.title: periodicity of the closed development
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
If $E(\kappa,\ell) = 0$ and $T(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$, then
  $\psi_{j+n} = \psi_j + 2\pi$ and $v_{k+n} = v_k$ for all $j,k$; in
  particular the vertex map descends to a well-defined polygon
  $\mathbb{Z}/n \to \mathbb{C}$, $i \mapsto v_{i.\mathrm{val}}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexR2_add_n
lean.code:
lemma vertexR2_add_n [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (k : ℕ) :
    vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + n) = vertexR2 κ ℓ k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa [closureGap, vertexR2] using hE
  | succ k ih =>
    have hedge : (ℓ ((k + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ (k + n) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        = (ℓ (k : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      have h1 : ((k + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) = (k : ZMod n) := by
        push_cast [ZMod.natCast_self]
        ring
      have h2 : ((heading κ ℓ k + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
          = (heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h1, heading_add_n hT, h2, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    rw [show k + 1 + n = (k + n) + 1 from by ring, vertexR2_succ, vertexR2_succ, ih, hedge]

entries.label: def:discrete_polygon
entries.title: polygon of a closed development
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
$P(\kappa,\ell)\colon \mathbb{Z}/n \to \mathbb{C}$,
  $P_i = v_{i.\mathrm{val}}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.polygonR2
lean.code:
noncomputable def polygonR2 (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ZMod n → ℂ :=
  fun i => vertexR2 κ ℓ i.val

/-! ## Simple polygons and realizability -/

entries.label: def:simple_polygon
entries.title: simple polygon
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon
lean.code:
def IsSimplePolygon (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : ZMod n, v i ≠ v (i + 1)) ∧
    (∀ i : ZMod n,
      segment ℝ (v i) (v (i + 1)) ∩ segment ℝ (v (i + 1)) (v (i + 1 + 1))
        = {v (i + 1)}) ∧
    (∀ i j : ZMod n, i ≠ j → i + 1 ≠ j → j + 1 ≠ i →
      segment ℝ (v i) (v (i + 1)) ∩ segment ℝ (v j) (v (j + 1)) = ∅)

entries.label: def:discrete_realizes
entries.title: Euclidean discrete realizability
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
$\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,\kappa$ holds when there exist edge lengths
  $\ell\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to\mathbb{R}$ with
  \[
    \mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell, \qquad
    E(\kappa,\ell) = 0, \qquad
    T(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi, \qquad
    \mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}\,\bigl(P(\kappa,\ell)\bigr).
  \]
  \emph{Non-degeneracy (standing definitional directive, user @085): every
  realization must have strictly positive edge lengths, $\ell_j > 0$ ---
  a zero-length edge collapses two vertices, making the object an
  $(n{-}1)$-gon. This clause is ALREADY carried by the first conjunct of
  \cref{def:moderate_arc} (\texttt{ModerateArc.length\_pos}), so the
  definition as stated satisfies the directive; no change was needed.}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RealizesR2
lean.code:
def RealizesR2 [NeZero n] (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ, ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ ∧ closureGap κ ℓ = 0 ∧
    turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi ∧ IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ ℓ)

/-! ## The constant profile closes -/

entries.label: lem:regular_gon_closes
entries.title: regular polygon closes the constant profile
entries.chapter: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability
entries.body:
Let $3 \le n$, $c > 0$, and set $\ell_i = (2/c)\sin(\pi/n)$ for all $i$.
  Then for the constant profile $\kappa \equiv c$:
  $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$, every turning angle equals
  $2\pi/n$, $T = 2\pi$, and $E(\kappa,\ell) = 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.regularGon_closes
lean.code:
theorem regularGon_closes {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ModerateArc 0 (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
        (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) ∧
      (∀ i : ZMod n,
        turningAngle 0 (fun _ => c) (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) i
          = 2 * Real.pi / n) ∧
      turningSum (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
        (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) = 2 * Real.pi ∧
      closureGap (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
        (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) = 0 := by
  have hn3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
  have hπn_pos : 0 < Real.pi / n := div_pos Real.pi_pos hnpos
  have hπn_le : Real.pi / n ≤ Real.pi / 3 := by gcongr
  have hπn_lt_half : Real.pi / n < Real.pi / 2 := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hsin_pos : 0 < Real.sin (Real.pi / n) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hπn_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin_lt : Real.sin (Real.pi / n) < 1 := by
    rw [← Real.sin_pi_div_two]
    exact Real.sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two (by linarith) le_rfl hπn_lt_half
  have hl_pos : 0 < 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n) :=
    mul_pos (div_pos two_pos hc) hsin_pos
  have hkey : c * (2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n) / 2) = Real.sin (Real.pi / n) := by
    field_simp
  have harc : Real.arcsin (Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) = Real.pi / n :=
    Real.arcsin_sin (by linarith) (by linarith)
  -- moderate arc
  have hMA : ModerateArc 0 (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
      (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) := by
    rw [moderateArc_zero_iff]
    intro i
    refine ⟨hl_pos, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simpa [abs_of_pos hc, hkey] using hsin_lt
  -- turning angles
  have hturn : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      turningAngle 0 (fun _ => c) (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) i
        = 2 * Real.pi / n := by
    intro i
    simp only [turningAngle, tK_zero]
    rw [hkey, harc]
    ring
  -- total turning
  have hsum : turningSum (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
      (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    unfold turningSum
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hturn i, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hnpos)]
  -- headings
  have hhead : ∀ j : ℕ,
      heading (fun _ : ZMod n => c) (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) j
        = (j + 1) * (2 * Real.pi / n) := by
    intro j
    unfold heading
    simp only [hturn]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  refine ⟨hMA, hturn, hsum, ?_⟩
  -- closure gap: finite geometric sum of the n-th roots of unity
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: lem:sin_sq_add_identity
entries.title: sine addition square identity
entries.chapter: Turning-angle bounds
entries.body:
For all $a, b \in \mathbb{R}$:
  \[
    \sin^2(a+b) \;=\; \sin^2 a + \sin^2 b + 2 \sin a \sin b \cos(a+b).
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sin_sq_add_identity
lean.code:
theorem sin_sq_add_identity (a b : ℝ) :
    sin (a + b) ^ 2 =
      sin a ^ 2 + sin b ^ 2 + 2 * sin a * sin b * cos (a + b) := by
  have ha := sin_sq_add_cos_sq a
  have hb := sin_sq_add_cos_sq b
  rw [sin_add, cos_add]
  nlinarith [ha, hb]

entries.label: lem:menger_arith_helpers
entries.title: arcsin-sum arithmetic for the chord identity
entries.chapter: Turning-angle bounds
entries.body:
For $|x|,|y|\le 1$, with $a=\arcsin x$, $b=\arcsin y$:
  $\sin(a+b) = x\sqrt{1-y^2} + y\sqrt{1-x^2}$, and
  $\sin^2(a+b) = x^2 + y^2 + 2xy\cos(a+b)$. Consequently, writing
  $x = \kappa\ell_0/2$, $y = \kappa\ell_1/2$ under the wall bounds,
  $\kappa\sqrt{\ell_0^2+\ell_1^2+2\ell_0\ell_1\cos(a+b)} = 2\sin(a+b)$ once
  signs are matched.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sin_arcsin_add_arcsin
lean.code:
theorem sin_arcsin_add_arcsin {x y : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (hy : |y| ≤ 1) :
    sin (arcsin x + arcsin y) = x * sqrt (1 - y ^ 2) + y * sqrt (1 - x ^ 2) := by
  rw [sin_add, sin_arcsin (abs_le.mp hx).1 (abs_le.mp hx).2,
    sin_arcsin (abs_le.mp hy).1 (abs_le.mp hy).2, cos_arcsin, cos_arcsin]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.mul_sqrt_chord_eq_two_sin
lean.code:
theorem mul_sqrt_chord_eq_two_sin {κ l₀ l₁ : ℝ}
    (h₀ : 0 < l₀) (h₁ : 0 < l₁)
    (w₀ : |κ| * (l₀ / 2) < 1) (w₁ : |κ| * (l₁ / 2) < 1) :
    κ * sqrt (l₀ ^ 2 + l₁ ^ 2 + 2 * l₀ * l₁ *
        cos (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2)))) =
      2 * sin (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2))) := by
  rcases eq_or_ne κ 0 with hκ | hκ
  · simp [hκ]
  · have hx1 : |κ * (l₀ / 2)| < 1 := by
      rwa [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < l₀ / 2)]
    have hy1 : |κ * (l₁ / 2)| < 1 := by
      rwa [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < l₁ / 2)]
    have hsq := sin_sq_arcsin_add_arcsin hx1.le hy1.le
    have hsin := sin_arcsin_add_arcsin hx1.le hy1.le
    have hsign : 0 ≤ 2 * sin (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2))) / κ := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hκ with hneg | hpos
      · have hx0 : κ * (l₀ / 2) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
        have hy0 : κ * (l₁ / 2) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
        have hs : sin (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2))) ≤ 0 := by
          rw [hsin]
          have h1 := sqrt_nonneg (1 - (κ * (l₁ / 2)) ^ 2)
          have h2 := sqrt_nonneg (1 - (κ * (l₀ / 2)) ^ 2)
          nlinarith
        exact div_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) hneg.le
      · have hx0 : 0 ≤ κ * (l₀ / 2) := by positivity
        have hy0 : 0 ≤ κ * (l₁ / 2) := by positivity
        have hs : 0 ≤ sin (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2))) := by
          rw [hsin]
          have h1 := sqrt_nonneg (1 - (κ * (l₁ / 2)) ^ 2)
          have h2 := sqrt_nonneg (1 - (κ * (l₀ / 2)) ^ 2)
          positivity
        positivity
    have key : κ ^ 2 * (l₀ ^ 2 + l₁ ^ 2 + 2 * l₀ * l₁ *
        cos (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2)))) =
        (2 * sin (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2)))) ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination (-4 : ℝ) * hsq
    have hrw : (2 * sin (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2))) / κ) ^ 2 =
        l₀ ^ 2 + l₁ ^ 2 + 2 * l₀ * l₁ *
          cos (arcsin (κ * (l₀ / 2)) + arcsin (κ * (l₁ / 2))) := by
      rw [div_pow, ← key, mul_div_cancel_left₀]
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 hκ
    rw [← hrw, sqrt_sq hsign]
    field_simp

/-! ## Counting core for N1 -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sin_sq_arcsin_add_arcsin
lean.code:
theorem sin_sq_arcsin_add_arcsin {x y : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (hy : |y| ≤ 1) :
    sin (arcsin x + arcsin y) ^ 2 =
      x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + 2 * x * y * cos (arcsin x + arcsin y) := by
  have h := sin_sq_add_identity (arcsin x) (arcsin y)
  rwa [sin_arcsin (abs_le.mp hx).1 (abs_le.mp hx).2,
    sin_arcsin (abs_le.mp hy).1 (abs_le.mp hy).2] at h

entries.label: def:vertex_chord
entries.title: vertex chord
entries.chapter: Turning-angle bounds
entries.body:
For data $(\kappa, \ell)$ at $K=0$, the \emph{vertex chord} at $i$ is
  \[
    m_i \;=\; \sqrt{\ell_{i-1}^2 + \ell_i^2 +
      2\,\ell_{i-1}\ell_i\cos\theta_i}\;\ge 0 .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexChord
lean.code:
noncomputable def vertexChord (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  sqrt (ℓ (i - 1) ^ 2 + ℓ i ^ 2 + 2 * ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i * cos (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i))

entries.label: lem:menger_chord_identity
entries.title: Menger chord identity
entries.chapter: Turning-angle bounds
entries.body:
Under $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$, for every $i$:
  \[
    \kappa_i \, m_i \;=\; 2\,\sin\theta_i .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.menger_chord_identity
lean.code:
theorem menger_chord_identity {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (i : ZMod n) :
    κ i * vertexChord κ ℓ i = 2 * sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
  have w₀ := h.wall_left i
  have w₁ := h.wall_right i
  rw [tK_zero] at w₀ w₁
  have key := mul_sqrt_chord_eq_two_sin (κ := κ i)
    (h.length_pos (i - 1)) (h.length_pos i) w₀ w₁
  simpa only [vertexChord, turningAngle, tK_zero] using key

deps.title: arcsin-sum arithmetic for the chord identity
deps.label: lem:menger_arith_helpers

entries.label: lem:triangle_angles_interior
entries.title: all three angles are interior
entries.chapter: Turning-angle bounds
entries.body: Each $\theta_i \in (0, \pi)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.triangle_turning_mem_Ioo
lean.code:
theorem triangle_turning_mem_Ioo {κ ℓ : ZMod 3 → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * π) (i : ZMod 3) :
    turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i ∈ Set.Ioo 0 π := by
  have hsum : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 0 + turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 1 + turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 2 =
      2 * π := by
    rw [← sum_zmod3 (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ)]
    exact hT
  have h0 := abs_lt.mp (abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h 0)
  have h1 := abs_lt.mp (abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h 1)
  have h2 := abs_lt.mp (abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h 2)
  rcases zmod3_cases i with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

entries.label: lem:triangle_law_of_sines
entries.title: discrete law of sines at $n=3$
entries.chapter: Turning-angle bounds
entries.body:
$\ell_0 \sin\theta_0 = \ell_1 \sin\theta_2$,
  $\ell_1 \sin\theta_1 = \ell_2 \sin\theta_0$, and
  $\ell_2 \sin\theta_2 = \ell_0 \sin\theta_1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.triangle_law_of_sines
lean.code:
theorem triangle_law_of_sines {κ ℓ : ZMod 3 → ℝ} (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * π) :
    ℓ 0 * sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 0) = ℓ 1 * sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 2) ∧
      ℓ 1 * sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 1) = ℓ 2 * sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 0) ∧
      ℓ 2 * sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 2) = ℓ 0 * sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 1) := by
  set θ0 := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 0 with hθ0
  set θ1 := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 1 with hθ1
  set θ2 := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 2 with hθ2
  have hsum : θ0 + θ1 + θ2 = 2 * π := by
    rw [hθ0, hθ1, hθ2, ← sum_zmod3 (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ)]
    exact hT
  have hcl := triangle_closure hE
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- rotate by ψ₂ = θ0+θ1+θ2 = 2π
    have hs := sum_sin_of_closure hcl (θ0 + θ1 + θ2)
    rw [show θ0 - (θ0 + θ1 + θ2) = θ0 - 2 * π from by rw [hsum],
      show θ0 + θ1 - (θ0 + θ1 + θ2) = (θ0 + θ1 + θ2) - θ2 - (θ0 + θ1 + θ2) from by ring,
      show (θ0 + θ1 + θ2) - θ2 - (θ0 + θ1 + θ2) = -θ2 from by ring,
      show θ0 + θ1 + θ2 - (θ0 + θ1 + θ2) = 0 from by ring,
      Real.sin_sub_two_pi, Real.sin_neg, Real.sin_zero] at hs
    linarith
  · -- rotate by ψ₀ = θ0
    have hs := sum_sin_of_closure hcl θ0
    rw [show θ0 - θ0 = 0 from by ring,
      show θ0 + θ1 - θ0 = θ1 from by ring,
      show θ0 + θ1 + θ2 - θ0 = 2 * π - θ0 from by linarith,
      Real.sin_zero, Real.sin_two_pi_sub] at hs
    linarith
  · -- rotate by ψ₁ = θ0 + θ1
    have hs := sum_sin_of_closure hcl (θ0 + θ1)
    rw [show θ0 - (θ0 + θ1) = -θ1 from by ring,
      show θ0 + θ1 - (θ0 + θ1) = 0 from by ring,
      show θ0 + θ1 + θ2 - (θ0 + θ1) = θ2 from by ring,
      Real.sin_neg, Real.sin_zero] at hs
    linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sum_sin_of_closure
lean.code:
theorem sum_sin_of_closure {l₀ l₁ l₂ ψ₀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : ℝ}
    (h : (l₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (ψ₀ * Complex.I) + l₁ * Complex.exp (ψ₁ * Complex.I) +
      l₂ * Complex.exp (ψ₂ * Complex.I) = 0) (φ : ℝ) :
    l₀ * sin (ψ₀ - φ) + l₁ * sin (ψ₁ - φ) + l₂ * sin (ψ₂ - φ) = 0 := by
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-(φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im) h
  simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add, zero_mul, Complex.zero_im] at h2
  have e : ∀ ψ : ℝ, (ψ : ℂ) * Complex.I + -(φ : ℂ) * Complex.I =
      ((ψ - φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    intro ψ; push_cast; ring
  rw [e ψ₀, e ψ₁, e ψ₂] at h2
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul,
    add_zero, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im] at h2
  exact h2

entries.label: lem:chord_eq_dist
entries.title: the vertex chord is the opposite edge
entries.chapter: Turning-angle bounds
entries.body: At $n = 3$: $m_i = \ell_{i+1}$ for every $i \in \mathbb{Z}/3$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sq_eq_of_closure
lean.code:
theorem sq_eq_of_closure {l₀ l₁ l₂ ψ₀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : ℝ}
    (h : (l₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (ψ₀ * Complex.I) + l₁ * Complex.exp (ψ₁ * Complex.I) +
      l₂ * Complex.exp (ψ₂ * Complex.I) = 0) :
    l₁ ^ 2 = l₀ ^ 2 + l₂ ^ 2 + 2 * l₀ * l₂ * cos (ψ₀ - ψ₂) := by
  have h1 : (l₁ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (ψ₁ * Complex.I) =
      -((l₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (ψ₀ * Complex.I) + l₂ * Complex.exp (ψ₂ * Complex.I)) := by
    linear_combination h
  have h2 := congrArg Complex.normSq h1
  rw [Complex.normSq_neg, Complex.normSq_add, Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_mul,
    Complex.normSq_mul] at h2
  simp only [Complex.normSq_ofReal] at h2
  have habs : ∀ ψ : ℝ, Complex.normSq (Complex.exp (ψ * Complex.I)) = 1 := by
    intro ψ
    rw [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
    linear_combination cos_sq_add_sin_sq ψ
  rw [habs, habs, habs] at h2
  have harg : ((ψ₀ : ℂ)) * Complex.I + ((-ψ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I =
      ((ψ₀ - ψ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    push_cast; ring
  have hre : ((l₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (ψ₀ * Complex.I) *
      (starRingEnd ℂ) ((l₂ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (ψ₂ * Complex.I))).re =
      l₀ * l₂ * cos (ψ₀ - ψ₂) := by
    rw [map_mul, ← Complex.exp_conj]
    have hconj : (starRingEnd ℂ) ((ψ₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) = ((-ψ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      simp [Complex.conj_ofReal]
    rw [hconj, Complex.conj_ofReal]
    have hprod : (l₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ψ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        ((l₂ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((-ψ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
        ((l₀ * l₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((ψ₀ - ψ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [← harg, Complex.exp_add]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hprod, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
    ring
  rw [hre] at h2
  nlinarith [h2]

/-! ## The killer profile -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.triangle_chord_eq_opposite
lean.code:
theorem triangle_chord_eq_opposite {κ ℓ : ZMod 3 → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * π) (i : ZMod 3) :
    vertexChord κ ℓ i = ℓ (i + 1) := by
  set θ0 := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 0 with hθ0
  set θ1 := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 1 with hθ1
  set θ2 := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ 2 with hθ2
  have hsum : θ0 + θ1 + θ2 = 2 * π := by
    rw [hθ0, hθ1, hθ2, ← sum_zmod3 (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ)]
    exact hT
  have hcl := triangle_closure hE
  have key : ∀ j : ZMod 3,
      ℓ (j - 1) ^ 2 + ℓ j ^ 2 + 2 * ℓ (j - 1) * ℓ j * cos (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ j) =
        ℓ (j + 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro j
    rcases zmod3_cases j with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · -- vertex 0: chord ℓ₂,ℓ₀ ↦ opposite ℓ₁
      have hsq := sq_eq_of_closure hcl
      rw [show θ0 - (θ0 + θ1 + θ2) = θ0 - 2 * π from by rw [hsum],
        Real.cos_sub_two_pi] at hsq
      rw [show (0 : ZMod 3) - 1 = 2 from by decide,
        show (0 : ZMod 3) + 1 = 1 from by decide, ← hθ0]
      linarith [hsq]
    · -- vertex 1: chord ℓ₀,ℓ₁ ↦ opposite ℓ₂
      have hcl' : (ℓ 1 : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp ((θ0 + θ1 : ℝ) * Complex.I) +
          (ℓ 2 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ0 + θ1 + θ2 : ℝ) * Complex.I) +
          (ℓ 0 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ0 : ℝ) * Complex.I) = 0 := by
        linear_combination hcl
      have hsq := sq_eq_of_closure hcl'
      rw [show θ0 + θ1 - θ0 = θ1 from by ring] at hsq
      rw [show (1 : ZMod 3) - 1 = 0 from by decide,
        show (1 : ZMod 3) + 1 = 2 from by decide, ← hθ1]
      linarith [hsq]
    · -- vertex 2: chord ℓ₁,ℓ₂ ↦ opposite ℓ₀
      have hcl' : (ℓ 2 : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp ((θ0 + θ1 + θ2 : ℝ) * Complex.I) +
          (ℓ 0 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ0 : ℝ) * Complex.I) +
          (ℓ 1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ0 + θ1 : ℝ) * Complex.I) = 0 := by
        linear_combination hcl
      have hsq := sq_eq_of_closure hcl'
      rw [show θ0 + θ1 + θ2 - (θ0 + θ1) = θ2 from by ring] at hsq
      rw [show (2 : ZMod 3) - 1 = 1 from by decide,
        show (2 : ZMod 3) + 1 = 0 from by decide, ← hθ2]
      linarith [hsq]
  rw [vertexChord, key i, sqrt_sq (h.length_pos (i + 1)).le]

entries.label: def:cross_r2
entries.title: signed twice-area
entries.chapter: The tangent--chord bridge (Euclidean)
entries.body:
For $A, B, C \in \mathbb{C}$ set
  \[
    \Delta(A,B,C) \;=\; \operatorname{Im}\bigl(\overline{(B-A)}\,(C-A)\bigr)
      \;=\; (B-A) \times (C-A),
  \]
  the $z$-component of the cross product; $\Delta = 2\cdot(\text{signed area
  of the oriented triangle } ABC)$, positive when $A,B,C$ turn left.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2
lean.code:
def crossR2 (A B C : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (B - A).re * (C - A).im - (B - A).im * (C - A).re

entries.label: def:signed_menger_r2
entries.title: signed Menger curvature
entries.chapter: The tangent--chord bridge (Euclidean)
entries.body:
For $A,B,C \in \mathbb{C}$ with pairwise distinct entries, the
  \emph{signed Menger curvature} of the ordered triple is
  \[
    \operatorname{sMenger}(A,B,C)
      \;=\; \frac{2\,\Delta(A,B,C)}
                 {|B-A|\,|C-B|\,|A-C|}.
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2
lean.code:
noncomputable def signedMengerR2 (A B C : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  2 * crossR2 A B C / (dist A B * dist B C * dist C A)

entries.label: lem:smenger_invariant
entries.title: isometry invariance
entries.chapter: The tangent--chord bridge (Euclidean)
entries.body:
$\operatorname{sMenger}$ is invariant under translation
  ($\operatorname{sMenger}(A+w, B+w, C+w) = \operatorname{sMenger}(A,B,C)$) and
  under rotation by any unit complex number $u$
  ($\operatorname{sMenger}(uA, uB, uC) = \operatorname{sMenger}(A,B,C)$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_add_left
lean.code:
lemma signedMengerR2_add_left (A B C w : ℂ) :
    signedMengerR2 (A + w) (B + w) (C + w) = signedMengerR2 A B C := by
  simp only [signedMengerR2, crossR2_add_left, dist_add_right]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.dist_mul_left_unit
lean.code:
lemma dist_mul_left_unit {u : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (A B : ℂ) :
    dist (u * A) (u * B) = dist A B := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← mul_sub, norm_mul, hu, one_mul]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_rotate
lean.code:
lemma crossR2_rotate {u : ℂ} (hu : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1) (A B C : ℂ) :
    crossR2 (u * A) (u * B) (u * C) = crossR2 A B C := by
  have h1 : u * B - u * A = u * (B - A) := by ring
  have h2 : u * C - u * A = u * (C - A) := by ring
  simp only [crossR2, h1, h2, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  linear_combination ((B - A).re * (C - A).im - (B - A).im * (C - A).re) * hu

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_add_left
lean.code:
lemma crossR2_add_left (A B C w : ℂ) :
    crossR2 (A + w) (B + w) (C + w) = crossR2 A B C := by
  have h1 : B + w - (A + w) = B - A := by ring
  have h2 : C + w - (A + w) = C - A := by ring
  simp only [crossR2, h1, h2]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_rotate
lean.code:
lemma signedMengerR2_rotate {u : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (A B C : ℂ) :
    signedMengerR2 (u * A) (u * B) (u * C) = signedMengerR2 A B C := by
  have hu2 : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq u
    rw [hu] at h
    have h2 := congrArg (· ^ 2) h.symm
    rwa [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), one_pow] at h2
  simp only [signedMengerR2, crossR2_rotate hu2, dist_mul_left_unit hu]

/-! ## Tangent–chord identity -/

variable {n : ℕ}

entries.label: thm:smenger_development
entries.title: Euclidean Menger bridge, D2
entries.chapter: The tangent--chord bridge (Euclidean)
entries.body:
Let $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$. For every $k \in \mathbb{N}$, the
  signed Menger curvature of the three consecutive developed vertices equals the
  target curvature at the middle vertex:
  \[
    \operatorname{sMenger}\bigl(v_k,\; v_{k+1},\; v_{k+2}\bigr)
      \;=\; \kappa_{(k+1 \bmod n)} .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_development
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerR2_development {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (k : ℕ) :
    signedMengerR2 (vertexR2 κ ℓ k) (vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1))
        (vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1)) = κ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
  -- the two edge vectors of the middle triple
  have hu : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ k
      = (ℓ (k : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  have hw : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1)
      = (ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  set i : ZMod n := ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) with hi
  set a : ℝ := ℓ (k : ZMod n) with ha
  set b : ℝ := ℓ i with hb
  set α : ℝ := heading κ ℓ k with hαd
  set β : ℝ := heading κ ℓ (k + 1) with hβd
  set θ : ℝ := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i with hθd
  rw [signedMengerR2_of_diffs hu hw]
  -- turning-angle relation β - α = θ
  have hθ : β - α = θ := by
    rw [hβd, heading_succ, ← hi, ← hθd, ← hαd]; ring
  -- edge components and norms
  rw [edge_re, edge_im, edge_re, edge_im]
  have hapos : 0 < a := h.length_pos (k : ZMod n)
  have hbpos : 0 < b := h.length_pos i
  -- the third side is the vertex chord
  have hnorm : ‖(a : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      + (b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((β : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = vertexChord κ ℓ i := by
    rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq, vertexChord]
    congr 1
    have hi1 : i - 1 = (k : ZMod n) := by rw [hi]; push_cast; ring
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, edge_re, edge_im]
    rw [hi1, ← ha, ← hb, ← hθd, ← hθ, Real.cos_sub]
    linear_combination a ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq α
      + b ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq β
  rw [edge_norm, edge_norm, abs_of_pos hapos, abs_of_pos hbpos, hnorm]
  -- final algebra through the Menger chord identity
  have hmenger : κ i * vertexChord κ ℓ i = 2 * Real.sin θ := by
    have := menger_chord_identity h i
    rwa [← hθd] at this
  have hvc := vertexChord_pos h i
  have hnum : a * Real.cos α * (b * Real.sin β) - a * Real.sin α * (b * Real.cos β)
      = a * b * Real.sin θ := by
    rw [← hθ, Real.sin_sub]; ring
  rw [hnum, show 2 * (a * b * Real.sin θ) = a * b * (2 * Real.sin θ) from by ring,
    ← hmenger]
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hapos
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hbpos
  have hvc0 : vertexChord κ ℓ i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hvc
  field_simp

/-! ## Menger realizability and the forward bridge -/

entries.label: def:realizes_menger
entries.title: signed-Menger realizability
entries.chapter: The tangent--chord bridge (Euclidean)
entries.body:
For $\kappa\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to\mathbb{R}$ (with $3 \le n$),
  $\mathrm{RealizesMenger}\,\kappa$ holds when there is a simple closed polygon
  $v\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to\mathbb{C}$ with
  $\operatorname{sMenger}(v_{i-1}, v_i, v_{i+1}) = \kappa_i$ for every
  $i\in\mathbb{Z}/n$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RealizesMenger

entries.label: lem:vertex_eq_polygon
entries.title: the development read at any natural index
entries.chapter: The tangent--chord bridge (Euclidean)
entries.body:
If $E(\kappa,\ell) = 0$ and $T(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$, then for every
  $j \in \mathbb{N}$ the developed vertex $v_j$ agrees with the cyclic polygon
  at the reduced index: $v_j = P(\kappa,\ell)(\overline{j})
  = v_{(\overline{j}).\mathrm{val}}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexR2_eq_polygon
lean.code:
lemma vertexR2_eq_polygon [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (m : ℕ) :
    vertexR2 κ ℓ m = polygonR2 κ ℓ (m : ZMod n) := by
  rw [polygonR2, ZMod.val_natCast]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div m n]
  exact vertexR2_add_mul_n hE hT (m % n) (m / n)

entries.label: lem:heading_strict_mono
entries.title: single-step heading increase
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
If $\kappa_i > 0$ for all $i$ and $(\kappa,\ell)$ is moderate-arc, then
  $\psi_j < \psi_{j+1}$ for every $j$, since
  $\psi_{j+1} - \psi_j = \theta_{(j+1 \bmod n)} > 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading_lt_succ
lean.code:
lemma heading_lt_succ {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (j : ℕ) :
    heading κ ℓ j < heading κ ℓ (j + 1) := by
  rw [heading_succ']
  have := turningAngle_pos h (hκ ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n))
  linarith

entries.label: lem:heading_strict_mono_global
entries.title: strict monotonicity of headings
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
Under the same hypotheses, $\mathrm{heading}\,\kappa\,\ell$ is strictly
  increasing on $\mathbb{N}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading_strictMono
lean.code:
lemma heading_strictMono {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) : StrictMono (heading κ ℓ) :=
  strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ (heading_lt_succ h hκ)

entries.label: lem:heading_window
entries.title: heading window bounds
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
Under the hypotheses of \cref{lem:heading_strict_mono} together with
  $\mathrm{turningSum}(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$: for all $j$,
  $\psi_{j+n} = \psi_j + 2\pi$, and for $j < k < j+n$ one has the strict window
  bound
  \[
    \psi_j \;<\; \psi_k \;<\; \psi_j + 2\pi .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading_sub_lt_two_pi
lean.code:
lemma heading_sub_lt_two_pi [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi)
    {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) (hkn : k < j + n) :
    heading κ ℓ j < heading κ ℓ k ∧ heading κ ℓ k < heading κ ℓ j + 2 * Real.pi := by
  refine ⟨heading_strictMono h hκ hjk, ?_⟩
  have := heading_strictMono h hκ hkn
  rwa [heading_add_n hT] at this

/-! ## The support half-plane -/

entries.label: lem:left_distance_formula
entries.title: left-distance telescoping
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
For $k \le j$,
  \[
    \mathrm{Im}\!\left(e^{-i\psi_k}(P_j - P_k)\right)
      \;=\; \sum_{m=k}^{j-1} \ell_m \,\sin(\psi_m - \psi_k).
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.im_rot_vertex_sub
lean.code:
lemma im_rot_vertex_sub (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hkj : k ≤ j) :
    (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        * (vertexR2 κ ℓ j - vertexR2 κ ℓ k)).im
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j,
          ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) := by
  have hdiff : vertexR2 κ ℓ j - vertexR2 κ ℓ k
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j,
          (ℓ (m : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ m : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2, vertexR2, ← Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hkj]
  rw [hdiff, Finset.mul_sum, Complex.im_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  have hexp : Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        * ((ℓ (m : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ m : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      = (ℓ (m : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp (((heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  rw [hexp, Complex.mul_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

entries.label: lem:support_halfplane
entries.title: support half-plane
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
Assume all $\kappa_i > 0$, $(\kappa,\ell)$ moderate-arc, $\mathrm{closureGap} =
  0$, $\mathrm{turningSum} = 2\pi$. Fix an edge index $k$ and let
  $S(j) := \mathrm{Im}\!\left(e^{-i\psi_k}(P_j - P_k)\right)$ for
  $k \le j \le k+n$. Then $S(j) \ge 0$ for all such $j$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.support_left_nonneg
lean.code:
lemma support_left_nonneg [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ}
    (hkj : k ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ k + n) :
    0 ≤ (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          * (vertexR2 κ ℓ j - vertexR2 κ ℓ k)).im := by
  rw [im_rot_vertex_sub κ ℓ hkj]
  have hmono := heading_strictMono h hκ
  -- backward representation via closure: ∑_{[k,j)} = −∑_{[j,k+n)}
  have hzero : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k (k + n),
      ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) = 0 := by
    have H := im_rot_vertex_sub κ ℓ (Nat.le_add_right k n)
    rw [vertexR2_add_n hE hT k, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im] at H
    exact H.symm
  have hsplit : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j,
        ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k)
      = -∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico j (k + n),
          ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) := by
    have hc := Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive
      (fun m => ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k)) hkj hjn
    rw [hzero] at hc
    linarith
  by_cases hcross : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j, heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k ≤ Real.pi
  · -- forward: every increment is nonnegative
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm
    have hαnn : 0 ≤ heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k :=
      sub_nonneg.2 (hmono.monotone hm.1)
    exact mul_nonneg (h.length_pos _).le
      (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hαnn (hcross m (Finset.mem_Ico.2 hm)))
  · -- backward: past the π-crossing every increment is nonpositive
    push Not at hcross
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀mem, hm₀⟩ := hcross
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm₀mem
    rw [hsplit, neg_nonneg]
    apply Finset.sum_nonpos
    intro m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm
    have hm₀m : m₀ < m := lt_of_lt_of_le hm₀mem.2 hm.1
    have hαgt : Real.pi < heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k := by
      have := hmono hm₀m; linarith
    have hkm : k < m := lt_of_le_of_lt hm₀mem.1 hm₀m
    have hwin := heading_sub_lt_two_pi h hκ hT hkm hm.2
    have : Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) < 0 :=
      sin_neg_of_pi_lt hαgt (by linarith [hwin.2])
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (h.length_pos _).le this.le

entries.label: lem:support_halfplane_strict
entries.title: strict support half-plane
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
In the setting of \cref{lem:support_halfplane}, moreover $S(j) > 0$ whenever
  $k+1 < j < k+n$ (strictly, except at $j \in \{k, k+1, k+n\}$, i.e.\ at $P_k$
  and $P_{k+1}$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.support_left_pos
lean.code:
lemma support_left_pos [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ}
    (hkj : k + 1 < j) (hjn : j < k + n) :
    0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          * (vertexR2 κ ℓ j - vertexR2 κ ℓ k)).im := by
  rw [im_rot_vertex_sub κ ℓ (by omega : k ≤ j)]
  have hmono := heading_strictMono h hκ
  have hzero : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k (k + n),
      ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) = 0 := by
    have H := im_rot_vertex_sub κ ℓ (Nat.le_add_right k n)
    rw [vertexR2_add_n hE hT k, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im] at H
    exact H.symm
  have hsplit : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j,
        ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k)
      = -∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico j (k + n),
          ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) := by
    have hc := Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive
      (fun m => ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k))
      (by omega : k ≤ j) (by omega : j ≤ k + n)
    rw [hzero] at hc
    linarith
  by_cases hcross : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j, heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k ≤ Real.pi
  · -- forward: the (k+1) increment is strictly positive, the rest nonnegative
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro m hm
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm
      have hαnn : 0 ≤ heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k :=
        sub_nonneg.2 (hmono.monotone hm.1)
      exact mul_nonneg (h.length_pos _).le
        (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hαnn (hcross m (Finset.mem_Ico.2 hm)))
    · refine ⟨k + 1, Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨Nat.le_add_right k 1, hkj⟩, ?_⟩
      have hstep : heading κ ℓ (k + 1) - heading κ ℓ k
          = turningAngle 0 κ ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
        rw [heading_succ']; ring
      have hpos : 0 < turningAngle 0 κ ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) :=
        turningAngle_pos h (hκ _)
      have hlt : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) < Real.pi :=
        lt_of_abs_lt (abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h _)
      rw [hstep]
      exact mul_pos (h.length_pos _)
        (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hpos hlt)
  · -- backward: past the π-crossing every increment is strictly negative
    push Not at hcross
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀mem, hm₀⟩ := hcross
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm₀mem
    rw [hsplit, neg_pos]
    apply Finset.sum_neg
    · intro m hm
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm
      have hm₀m : m₀ < m := lt_of_lt_of_le hm₀mem.2 hm.1
      have hαgt : Real.pi < heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k := by
        have := hmono hm₀m; linarith
      have hkm : k < m := lt_of_le_of_lt hm₀mem.1 hm₀m
      have hwin := heading_sub_lt_two_pi h hκ hT hkm hm.2
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (h.length_pos _)
        (sin_neg_of_pi_lt hαgt (by linarith [hwin.2]))
    · exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨le_rfl, hjn⟩⟩

/-! ## Simplicity from support -/

entries.label: lem:edges_nondegenerate
entries.title: nondegenerate edges
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
Each edge is nondegenerate: $P_i \ne P_{i+1}$ for every $i \in \ZMod n$, since
  $P_{i+1} - P_i = \ell_i e^{i\psi_i}$ has modulus $\ell_i > 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.polygonR2_edge_ne
lean.code:
lemma polygonR2_edge_ne [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (i : ZMod n) :
    polygonR2 κ ℓ i ≠ polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) := by
  have e1 : polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) = vertexR2 κ ℓ (i.val + 1) := by
    have := polygonR2_add_nat hE hT i 1
    simpa using this
  have hd : vertexR2 κ ℓ (i.val + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ i.val
      = (ℓ ((i.val : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ i.val : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  have hne : (ℓ ((i.val : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
      * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ i.val : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero _ (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
    exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt (h.length_pos _)
  rw [show polygonR2 κ ℓ i = vertexR2 κ ℓ i.val from rfl, e1]
  intro heq
  apply hne
  rw [← hd, heq, sub_self]

entries.label: lem:nonadjacent_disjoint
entries.title: non-adjacent edges are disjoint
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
If $i, j \in \ZMod n$ satisfy $i \ne j$, $i+1 \ne j$, $j + 1 \ne i$, then
  \[
    \mathrm{segment}\,\mathbb{R}\,(P_i)(P_{i+1}) \cap
    \mathrm{segment}\,\mathbb{R}\,(P_j)(P_{j+1}) = \varnothing .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.polygonR2_nonadjacent_disjoint
lean.code:
lemma polygonR2_nonadjacent_disjoint [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (i j : ZMod n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hij1 : i + 1 ≠ j) (hji1 : j + 1 ≠ i) :
    segment ℝ (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1))
        ∩ segment ℝ (polygonR2 κ ℓ j) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (j + 1)) = ∅ := by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
  obtain ⟨r, r', hr, hr', hrr, hz1eq⟩ := hz1
  obtain ⟨s, s', hs, hs', hss, hz2eq⟩ := hz2
  -- L(z) computed from the near edge: on the edge line, hence 0
  have hLnear : (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (z - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im = 0 := by
    rw [← hz1eq, im_rot_affine _ _ _ _ hrr, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im,
      mul_zero, zero_add, im_rot_edge_end_zero hE hT i, mul_zero]
  -- L(z) computed from the far edge: strictly positive
  have hLj : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (polygonR2 κ ℓ j - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im :=
    support_pos_cyclic h hκ hE hT i j (Ne.symm hij) (Ne.symm hij1)
  have hLj1 : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (j + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im :=
    support_pos_cyclic h hκ hE hT i (j + 1) hji1
      (by intro hcontra; exact hij (by linear_combination -hcontra))
  have hLfar : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (z - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im := by
    rw [← hz2eq, im_rot_affine _ _ _ _ hss]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs with hs0 | hspos
    · have hs'1 : s' = 1 := by linarith
      rw [← hs0, zero_mul, zero_add, hs'1, one_mul]; exact hLj1
    · nlinarith [mul_pos hspos hLj, mul_nonneg hs' hLj1.le]
  linarith

entries.label: lem:consecutive_meet_shared
entries.title: consecutive edges meet only at the shared vertex
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
For every $i$,
  \[
    \mathrm{segment}\,\mathbb{R}\,(P_i)(P_{i+1}) \cap
    \mathrm{segment}\,\mathbb{R}\,(P_{i+1})(P_{i+2}) = \{P_{i+1}\}.
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.polygonR2_consecutive_inter
lean.code:
lemma polygonR2_consecutive_inter [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : ZMod n) :
    segment ℝ (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1))
        ∩ segment ℝ (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1))
      = {polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)} := by
  have hLj2 : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im := by
    have e2 : polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1) = vertexR2 κ ℓ (i.val + 2) := by
      have h2 := polygonR2_add_nat hE hT i 2
      rw [show i + ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i + 1 + 1 from by push_cast; ring] at h2
      exact h2
    rw [e2, show polygonR2 κ ℓ i = vertexR2 κ ℓ i.val from rfl]
    exact support_left_pos h hκ hE hT i.val (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem]
  refine ⟨⟨right_mem_segment ℝ _ _, left_mem_segment ℝ _ _⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
  obtain ⟨r, r', hr, hr', hrr, hz1eq⟩ := hz1
  obtain ⟨s, s', hs, hs', hss, hz2eq⟩ := hz2
  have hLnear : (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (z - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im = 0 := by
    rw [← hz1eq, im_rot_affine _ _ _ _ hrr, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im,
      mul_zero, zero_add, im_rot_edge_end_zero hE hT i, mul_zero]
  have hLfar : (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (z - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im
      = s' * (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im := by
    rw [← hz2eq, im_rot_affine _ _ _ _ hss, im_rot_edge_end_zero hE hT i, mul_zero,
      zero_add]
  have hs'0 : s' = 0 := by
    have hz : s' * (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im = 0 := by
      rw [← hLfar, hLnear]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 hz).resolve_right (ne_of_gt hLj2)
  rw [← hz2eq, hs'0, zero_smul, add_zero, show s = 1 from by linarith, one_smul]

entries.label: thm:convex_simple
entries.title: L1: positive turning $\Rightarrow$ simple
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
Let $n \ge 3$, $[\mathrm{NeZero}\,n]$, $(\kappa,\ell)$ moderate-arc with
  $\kappa_i > 0$ for all $i$, $\mathrm{closureGap}(\kappa,\ell) = 0$, and
  $\mathrm{turningSum}(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$. Then
  $\mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}(\mathrm{polygonR2}\,\kappa\,\ell)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive
lean.code:
theorem isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) :
    IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ ℓ) :=
  ⟨fun i => polygonR2_edge_ne h hE hT i,
   fun i => polygonR2_consecutive_inter h hκ hE hT hn i,
   fun i j hij hij1 hji1 => polygonR2_nonadjacent_disjoint h hκ hE hT i j hij hij1 hji1⟩
