entries.label: st:tangent-intersection
entries.title: Tangent normals and intersections
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Put $u(\theta)=\cos\theta+i\sin\theta$ and, for unit vectors $u,v$ with
$1+\langle u,v\rangle\ne0$, put
\[
 T(u,v)=\frac{u+v}{1+\langle u,v\rangle}.
\]
Thus $|u(\theta)|=1$, $\langle u(\alpha),u(\beta)\rangle=\cos(\beta-\alpha)$,
and $[u(\alpha),u(\beta)]=\sin(\beta-\alpha)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal
lean.code: noncomputable abbrev normal (θ : ℝ) : ℂ := circlePoint 0 1 θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_normal
lean.code:
lemma cross_normal (α β : ℝ) :
    crossR2 0 (normal α) (normal β) = Real.sin (β - α) := by
  simp [crossR2, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_im
lean.code: @[simp] lemma normal_im (θ : ℝ) : (normal θ).im = Real.sin θ := by simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_re
lean.code: @[simp] lemma normal_re (θ : ℝ) : (normal θ).re = Real.cos θ := by simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.norm_normal
lean.code:
@[simp] lemma norm_normal (θ : ℝ) : ‖normal θ‖ = 1 := by
  simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_normal
lean.code:
lemma inner_normal (α β : ℝ) : ⟪normal α, normal β⟫_ℝ = Real.cos (β - α) := by
  simp [Complex.inner, Real.cos_sub]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection
lean.code:
noncomputable def tangentIntersection (u v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)⁻¹ • (u + v)

entries.label: st:tangent-equations
entries.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
The intersection is symmetric and satisfies
$\langle u,T(u,v)\rangle=\langle v,T(u,v)\rangle=1$.
For $0\le\beta-\alpha<\pi$ its denominator is positive.
The normal map is continuous, and $T$ is jointly continuous wherever its
denominator is nonzero, including $T(u,u)=u$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_tangentIntersection_right
lean.code:
lemma inner_tangentIntersection_right {u v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) : ⟪v, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [tangentIntersection_comm]
  exact inner_tangentIntersection_left hv (by rwa [real_inner_comm])

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_tangentIntersection_left
lean.code:
lemma inner_tangentIntersection_left {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) : ⟪u, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, one_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma normal_denominator_pos {α β : ℝ} (h₀ : α ≤ β) (hπ : β - α < Real.pi) :
    0 < 1 + ⟪normal α, normal β⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [inner_normal]
  have h := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (sub_nonneg.mpr h₀) le_rfl hπ
  rw [Real.cos_pi] at h
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuousAt_tangentIntersection
lean.code:
lemma continuousAt_tangentIntersection {u v : ℂ} (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ tangentIntersection p.1 p.2) (u, v) := by
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ 1 + ⟪p.1, p.2⟫_ℝ) (u, v) :=
    continuousAt_const.add (continuous_fst.inner continuous_snd).continuousAt
  exact (hc.inv₀ hd).smul (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd).continuousAt

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuous_normal
lean.code:
lemma continuous_normal : Continuous normal := by
  change Continuous (circleMap 0 1)
  fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_comm
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_comm (u v : ℂ) :
    tangentIntersection u v = tangentIntersection v u := by
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_comm u v, add_comm u v]

entries.label: st:fan-support
entries.title: Ordered circle points and strict tangent support
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For unit $u,v$ and nonzero tangent denominator,
\[
 [u,v,w]=[u,v]\bigl(1-\langle w,T(u,v)\rangle\bigr).
\]
For $\alpha<\beta<\gamma<\alpha+2\pi$ and $\beta-\alpha<\pi$,
$\langle u(\gamma),T(u(\alpha),u(\beta))\rangle<1$.
The same holds when $\gamma<\alpha<\beta<\gamma+2\pi$.
More generally, for $z(\theta)=c+Re^{i\theta}$,
\[
 [z(\alpha),z(\beta),z(\gamma)]
 =4R^2\sin\frac{\beta-\alpha}{2}\sin\frac{\gamma-\beta}{2}
       \sin\frac{\gamma-\alpha}{2}>0
\]
when $R\ne0$ and the three angles have the first cyclic ordering.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint
lean.code: noncomputable abbrev circlePoint (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) : ℂ := circleMap O R θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered
    (O : ℂ) {R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (h₀₁ : θ₀ < θ₁) (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (hspan : θ₂ < θ₀ + 2 * Real.pi) :
    0 < crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁)
      (circlePoint O R θ₂) := by
  have hsin₀₁ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin₁₂ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin₀₂ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half]
  positivity

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) (circlePoint O R θ₂) =
      R ^ 2 * (Real.sin (θ₁ - θ₀) + Real.sin (θ₂ - θ₁) -
        Real.sin (θ₂ - θ₀)) := by
  change crossR2 (circleMap O R θ₀) (circleMap O R θ₁) (circleMap O R θ₂) = _
  unfold crossR2
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, circlePoint_re, circlePoint_im]
  rw [Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_eq_tangent_support
lean.code:
lemma cross_eq_tangent_support {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) :
    crossR2 u v w = crossR2 0 u v * (1 - ⟪w, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hu' : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm u
    rw [hu, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hv' : v.re ^ 2 + v.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm v
    rw [hv, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right]
  field_simp
  simp [crossR2, Complex.inner]
  linear_combination (u.re * w.im - u.im * w.re) * hv' -
    (v.re * w.im - v.im * w.re) * hu'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_im
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_im (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    (circlePoint O R θ).im = O.im + R * Real.sin θ := by
  change (circleMap O R θ).im = _
  simp [circleMap]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) (circlePoint O R θ₂) =
      4 * R ^ 2 * Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) *
        Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) * Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) := by
  rw [crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub]
  have hsum : θ₂ - θ₀ = (θ₁ - θ₀) + (θ₂ - θ₁) := by ring
  rw [hsum, sin_add_sin_sub_sin_add]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_add_two_pi
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_add_two_pi (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    circlePoint O R (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = circlePoint O R θ := by
  change circleMap O R (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = circleMap O R θ
  exact periodic_circleMap O R θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_re
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_re (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    (circlePoint O R θ).re = O.re + R * Real.cos θ := by
  change (circleMap O R θ).re = _
  simp [circleMap]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_lt_of_wrapped
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_lt_of_wrapped {α β γ : ℝ} (hγα : γ < α)
    (hαβ : α < β) (hgap : β - α < Real.pi) (hspan : β < γ + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ⟪normal γ, tangentIntersection (normal α) (normal β)⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have h := normal_support_lt_of_ordered hαβ hgap hspan
    (by linarith : γ + 2 * Real.pi < α + 2 * Real.pi)
  simpa only [normal, circlePoint_add_two_pi] using h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_lt_of_ordered
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_lt_of_ordered {α β γ : ℝ} (hαβ : α < β)
    (hgap : β - α < Real.pi) (hβγ : β < γ) (hspan : γ < α + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ⟪normal γ, tangentIntersection (normal α) (normal β)⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have h := crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered 0 (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
    hαβ hβγ hspan
  rw [cross_eq_tangent_support (norm_normal α) (norm_normal β)
    (normal_denominator_pos hαβ.le hgap).ne', cross_normal] at h
  have hs := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (sub_pos.mpr hαβ) hgap
  nlinarith

entries.label: st:interior-contact
entries.title: Interior contacts and positive tangent edges
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For unit $u,v,w$ with $[u,v]>0$ and $[v,w]>0$, define
$\alpha=[u,v]/(1+\langle u,v\rangle)>0$ and
$\beta=[v,w]/(1+\langle v,w\rangle)>0$. Then
\[
 T(u,v)=v-\alpha iv,\qquad T(v,w)=v+\beta iv,
 \qquad T(v,w)-T(u,v)=(\alpha+\beta)iv.
\]
In particular $v$ lies in the open segment joining the two tangent vertices,
and that segment is nonzero and positively directed along $iv$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_eq_add
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_eq_add {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    tangentIntersection u v = u + (crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)) • (Complex.I * u) := by
  have hu' : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm u
    rw [hu, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [tangentIntersection, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, zero_add,
      smul_eq_mul]
  all_goals field_simp
  all_goals simp [crossR2, Complex.inner]
  · linear_combination -v.re * hu'
  · linear_combination -v.im * hu'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_eq_sub
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_eq_sub {u v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    tangentIntersection u v = v - (crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)) • (Complex.I * v) := by
  rw [tangentIntersection_comm, tangentIntersection_eq_add hv (by rwa [real_inner_comm])]
  simp only [crossR2_swap 0 u v, real_inner_comm v u, neg_div, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul
lean.code:
lemma tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul {u v w : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (h₁ : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) (h₂ : 0 < crossR2 0 v w) :
    ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ tangentIntersection v w - tangentIntersection u v =
      ℓ • (Complex.I * v) := by
  have hd₁ := normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv h₁
  have hd₂ := normal_pair_denominator_pos hv hw h₂
  refine ⟨crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ) +
    crossR2 0 v w / (1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ), add_pos (div_pos h₁ hd₁) (div_pos h₂ hd₂), ?_⟩
  rw [tangentIntersection_eq_sub hv hd₁.ne', tangentIntersection_eq_add hv hd₂.ne', add_smul]
  abel

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_pair_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma normal_pair_denominator_pos {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) : 0 < 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ := by
  have huv : u + v ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hvu : v = -u := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right he
    rw [hvu] at hc
    simp [crossR2, mul_comm] at hc
  have h := norm_add_sq_real u v
  rw [hu, hv] at h
  have hp := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr huv)
  nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.contact_mem_openSegment
lean.code:
theorem contact_mem_openSegment {u v w : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd₁ : 0 < 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ) (hd₂ : 0 < 1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ)
    (h₁ : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) (h₂ : 0 < crossR2 0 v w) :
    v ∈ openSegment ℝ (tangentIntersection u v) (tangentIntersection v w) := by
  let α := crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)
  let β := crossR2 0 v w / (1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ)
  have hα : 0 < α := div_pos h₁ hd₁
  have hβ : 0 < β := div_pos h₂ hd₂
  have hab : 0 < α + β := add_pos hα hβ
  refine ⟨β / (α + β), α / (α + β), div_pos hβ hab, div_pos hα hab, ?_, ?_⟩
  · field_simp
    ring
  · rw [tangentIntersection_eq_sub hv hd₁.ne', tangentIntersection_eq_add hv hd₂.ne']
    change (β / (α + β)) • (v - α • (Complex.I * v)) +
      (α / (α + β)) • (v + β • (Complex.I * v)) = v
    match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring

entries.label: st:projective-map
entries.title: Projective ball normalization
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For $a\in\mathbb C$ and $\sigma>0$ with $\sigma^2+|a|^2=1$, set
\[
 D_a(x)=1-\langle a,x\rangle,\quad
 A_a(x)=\sigma x+\left(\frac{\langle a,x\rangle}{1+\sigma}-1\right)a,
 \qquad B_a(x)=\frac{A_a(x)}{D_a(x)}.
\]
All geometric applications use the positive chart $D_a(x)>0$.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.denominator
lean.code: def denominator (a x : E) : ℝ := 1 - ⟪a, x⟫_ℝ

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.transform
lean.code:
noncomputable def transform (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (x : E) : E :=
  (denominator a x)⁻¹ • numerator a σ x

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.numerator
lean.code:
noncomputable def numerator (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (x : E) : E :=
  σ • x + (⟪a, x⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - 1) • a

entries.label: st:projective-support
entries.title: The bilinear identity and tangent half-planes
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
The numerator satisfies
$\langle A_a(x),A_a(y)\rangle-D_a(x)D_a(y)
=\sigma^2(\langle x,y\rangle-1)$. Hence, wherever both denominators are nonzero,
\[
 1-\langle B_a(x),B_a(y)\rangle
 =\frac{\sigma^2(1-\langle x,y\rangle)}{D_a(x)D_a(y)}.
\]
Unit normals remain unit, and tangent equations remain tangent equations.
With positive denominators, a strict inequality $\langle x,y\rangle<1$
is equivalent to the same inequality for their images.
If $|a|<1$ and $|x|\le1$, then $D_a(x)>0$.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one
lean.code:
theorem denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one {a x : E} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    0 < denominator a x := by
  have h := real_inner_le_norm a x
  dsimp [denominator]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg x]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.one_sub_inner_transform
lean.code:
theorem one_sub_inner_transform (a x y : E) {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hx : denominator a x ≠ 0) (hy : denominator a y ≠ 0) :
    1 - ⟪transform a σ x, transform a σ y⟫_ℝ =
      σ ^ 2 * (1 - ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ) / (denominator a x * denominator a y) := by
  have h := numerator_inner_sub a x y hσ hsq
  simp only [transform, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  field_simp
  nlinarith only [h]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one
lean.code:
theorem inner_transform_eq_one {a u x : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : denominator a u ≠ 0) (hx : denominator a x ≠ 0)
    (htangent : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) :
    ⟪transform a σ u, transform a σ x⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  have h := one_sub_inner_transform a u x hσ hsq hu hx
  rw [htangent, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_div] at h
  linarith

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.numerator_inner_sub
lean.code:
theorem numerator_inner_sub (a x y : E) {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    ⟪numerator a σ x, numerator a σ y⟫_ℝ - denominator a x * denominator a y =
      σ ^ 2 * (⟪x, y⟫_ℝ - 1) := by
  have ha : ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ = 1 - σ ^ 2 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    linarith
  simp only [numerator, denominator, inner_add_left, inner_add_right,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm a x, ha]
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one
lean.code:
theorem norm_transform_eq_one {a u : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hden : denominator a u ≠ 0) :
    ‖transform a σ u‖ = 1 := by
  have h := one_sub_inner_transform a u u hσ hsq hden hden
  simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, one_pow, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_div] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (transform a σ u)]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_lt_one_iff
lean.code:
theorem inner_transform_lt_one_iff {a u x : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : 0 < denominator a u) (hx : 0 < denominator a x) :
    ⟪transform a σ u, transform a σ x⟫_ℝ < 1 ↔ ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  rw [← sub_pos, one_sub_inner_transform a u x hσ hsq hu.ne' hx.ne',
    div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (mul_pos hu hx),
    mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (sq_pos_of_pos hσ), sub_pos]

entries.label: st:projective-orientation
entries.title: Orientation in the positive chart
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For any $x,y$,
\[
 [B_a(x),B_a(y)]
 =\frac{\sigma\bigl([x,y]+[a,x-y]\bigr)}{D_a(x)D_a(y)}.
\]
In particular, for adjacent unit normals with $[u,v]>0$,
\[
 [B_a(u),B_a(v)]
 =\frac{\sigma[u,v]D_a(T(u,v))}{D_a(u)D_a(v)}>0
\]
provided $|a|<1$ and $D_a(T(u,v))>0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_transform_normals
lean.code:
lemma cross_transform_normals {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    crossR2 0 (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) =
      σ * crossR2 0 u v * ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v) /
        (ProjectiveBall.denominator a u * ProjectiveBall.denominator a v) := by
  have he : ProjectiveBall.area u v + ProjectiveBall.area a (u - v) =
      crossR2 u v a := by
    simp only [ProjectiveBall.area, crossR2, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
    ring
  have h := ProjectiveBall.area_transform a u v hσ hsq
  rw [he, cross_eq_tangent_support hu hv hd a] at h
  simpa only [crossR2, Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, sub_zero,
    ProjectiveBall.area, ProjectiveBall.denominator, mul_assoc] using h

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area_numerator
lean.code:
lemma area_numerator (a u v : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    area (numerator a σ u) (numerator a σ v) =
      σ * (area u v + area a (u - v)) := by
  have ha : σ ^ 2 + (a.re ^ 2 + a.im ^ 2) = 1 := by
    simpa only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, ← pow_two] using hsq
  simp only [area, numerator, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re,
    Complex.smul_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  linear_combination σ * (1 + σ) * (u.re * v.im - u.im * v.re) * ha

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area_transform
lean.code:
theorem area_transform (a u v : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    area (transform a σ u) (transform a σ v) =
      σ * (area u v + area a (u - v)) / (denominator a u * denominator a v) := by
  have h := area_numerator a u v hσ hsq
  simp only [transform, area, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  simp only [area, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at h
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  linear_combination (denominator a u)⁻¹ * (denominator a v)⁻¹ * h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_transform_normals_pos
lean.code:
lemma cross_transform_normals_pos {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v)
    (hx : 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v)) :
    0 < crossR2 0 (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) := by
  rw [cross_transform_normals hσ hsq hu hv (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv hc).ne']
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hσ hc) hx)
    (mul_pos (ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hu.le)
      (ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hv.le))

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area
lean.code: def area (u v : ℂ) : ℝ := u.re * v.im - u.im * v.re

entries.label: st:projective-intersection
entries.title: Projective transport of tangent intersections
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Under the hypotheses of the preceding orientation lemma,
\[
 B_a(T(u,v))=T(B_a(u),B_a(v)).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.transform_tangentIntersection
lean.code:
lemma transform_tangentIntersection {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v)
    (hx : 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v)) :
    ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (tangentIntersection u v) =
      tangentIntersection (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) := by
  have hdu := ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hu.le
  have hdv := ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hv.le
  have hu' := ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hu hdu.ne'
  have hv' := ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hv hdv.ne'
  have hc' := cross_transform_normals_pos ha hσ hsq hu hv hc hx
  have hd := (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv hc).ne'
  have hd' := (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu' hv' hc').ne'
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero hc'.ne'
  · rw [inner_sub_right, ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hdu.ne' hx.ne'
      (inner_tangentIntersection_left hu hd), inner_tangentIntersection_left hu' hd']
    exact sub_self 1
  · rw [inner_sub_right, ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hdv.ne' hx.ne'
      (inner_tangentIntersection_right hv hd), inner_tangentIntersection_right hv' hd']
    exact sub_self 1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero
lean.code:
lemma eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero {u v z : ℂ} (hcross : crossR2 0 u v ≠ 0)
    (hu : ⟪u, z⟫_ℝ = 0) (hv : ⟪v, z⟫_ℝ = 0) : z = 0 := by
  have hre : crossR2 0 u v * z.re = 0 := by
    simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hu hv
    simp only [crossR2, sub_zero]
    linear_combination v.im * hu - u.im * hv
  have him : crossR2 0 u v * z.im = 0 := by
    simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hu hv
    simp only [crossR2, sub_zero]
    linear_combination u.re * hv - v.re * hu
  exact Complex.ext ((mul_eq_zero.mp hre).resolve_left hcross)
    ((mul_eq_zero.mp him).resolve_left hcross)

entries.label: st:projective-field
entries.title: The labelled balancing field
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For a finite labelled configuration $x_i$ and fixed real coefficients $c_i$, set
\[
 F_x(a)=\sum_i\frac{c_i x_i}{D_a(x_i)}.
\]
The coefficients, including zero coefficients, remain attached to their original labels.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.field
lean.code:
noncomputable def field (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E) : E :=
  ∑ i, (c i / denominator a (x i)) • x i

entries.label: st:projective-balance
entries.title: A field zero gives exact projective balance
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
If all denominators are nonzero, $\sum_i c_i=0$ and $F_x(a)=0$, then
$\sum_i c_i B_a(x_i)=0$. More explicitly,
\[
 \sum_i\frac{c_i}{D_a(x_i)}=\sum_i c_i+\langle a,F_x(a)\rangle.
\]
For arbitrary weights $w_i$ the numerator sum is
\[
 \sum_iw_iA_a(x_i)=\sigma\sum_iw_ix_i+
 \left(\frac{\langle a,\sum_iw_ix_i\rangle}{1+\sigma}-\sum_iw_i\right)a.
\]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_smul_transform_eq_zero_of_field_eq_zero
lean.code:
theorem sum_smul_transform_eq_zero_of_field_eq_zero (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E)
    (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (hden : ∀ i, denominator a (x i) ≠ 0)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0) (hfield : field c x a = 0) :
    ∑ i, c i • transform a σ (x i) = 0 := by
  have hw : ∑ i, c i / denominator a (x i) = 0 := by
    rw [sum_div_denominator c x a hden, hsum, hfield, inner_zero_right, add_zero]
  have he : ∑ i, c i • transform a σ (x i) =
      ∑ i, (c i / denominator a (x i)) • numerator a σ (x i) := by
    simp only [transform, smul_smul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [he, sum_smul_numerator]
  change σ • field c x a + (⟪a, field c x a⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - _) • a = 0
  simp only [hfield, inner_zero_right, zero_div, hw, sub_self, smul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_div_denominator
lean.code:
lemma sum_div_denominator (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E)
    (hden : ∀ i, denominator a (x i) ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i, c i / denominator a (x i) = (∑ i, c i) + ⟪a, field c x a⟫_ℝ := by
  have hi : ∀ i, c i / denominator a (x i) =
      c i + (c i / denominator a (x i)) * ⟪a, x i⟫_ℝ := by
    intro i
    have hn := hden i
    unfold denominator at hn ⊢
    field_simp
    ring
  simpa only [field, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_right, Finset.sum_add_distrib] using
    Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun i _ ↦ hi i)

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_smul_numerator
lean.code:
lemma sum_smul_numerator (w : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E) (σ : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, w i • numerator a σ (x i) =
      σ • (∑ i, w i • x i) +
        (⟪a, ∑ i, w i • x i⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - ∑ i, w i) • a := by
  simp only [numerator, smul_add, smul_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    inner_sum, real_inner_smul_right]
  simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, mul_sub, mul_one, sub_smul, ← mul_div_assoc,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.sum_div, mul_comm]

entries.label: st:strict-fan
entries.title: Strict tangential fan
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
A strict tangential fan is a cyclic family of unit normals $U_i$ and vertices
$Y_i=T(U_i,U_{i+1})$ with $[U_i,U_{i+1}]>0$ and
$\langle U_j,Y_i\rangle<1$ for $j\ne i,i+1$.
The geometric record also includes $U_{i+1}\in(Y_i,Y_{i+1})$,
$Y_{i+1}-Y_i=\ell_i iU_{i+1}$ with $\ell_i>0$, nonzero edges, and
$[Y_i,Y_{i+1},Y_j]>0$ for every nonincident vertex $j$.
Either finite representatives or $\mathbb Z/n$ may index the same cyclic data.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
structure IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan [NeZero n] (U Y : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop where
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1
  normal_cross_pos : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1))
  vertex_eq : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1))
  strict_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1
  contact_interior : ∀ i, U (i + 1) ∈ openSegment ℝ (Y i) (Y (i + 1))
  edge_pos : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1))
  edge_ne : ∀ i, Y (i + 1) ≠ Y i
  cross_support : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
structure IsStrictTangentialFan {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (U Y : Fin n → ℂ) : Prop where
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1
  normal_cross_pos : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1))
  vertex_eq : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1))
  strict_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1
  contact_interior : ∀ i, U (i + 1) ∈ openSegment ℝ (Y i) (Y (i + 1))
  edge_pos : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1))
  edge_ne : ∀ i, Y (i + 1) ≠ Y i
  cross_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → 0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + 1)) (Y j)

entries.label: st:strict-fan-geometry
entries.title: The elementary data imply all strict-fan properties
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Unit normals, positive successive determinants, tangent intersection identities
and strict nonincident support imply the full strict-fan record.
For an edge $y-x=\ell iu$ with $\langle u,x\rangle=1$,
\[
 [x,y,z]=\ell(1-\langle u,z\rangle).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry
lean.code:
theorem isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {U Y : Fin n → ℂ}
    (hu : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1) (hc : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1)))
    (hy : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1)))
    (hs : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1) :
    IsStrictTangentialFan U Y := by
  have he : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1)) := by
    intro i
    rw [hy i, hy (i + 1)]
    exact tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hu (i + 1 + 1)) (hc i) (hc (i + 1))
  refine ⟨hu, hc, hy, hs, ?_, he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hy i, hy (i + 1)]
    exact contact_mem_openSegment (hu (i + 1))
      (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hc i))
      (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu (i + 1)) (hu (i + 1 + 1)) (hc (i + 1)))
      (hc i) (hc (i + 1))
  · intro i hzero
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := he i
    have hu₀ : U (i + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      simpa [h] using hu (i + 1)
    have hn := smul_ne_zero hℓ.ne' (mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero hu₀)
    apply hn
    rw [← heq, hzero, sub_self]
  · intro i j hji hjnext
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := he i
    have hi : ⟪U (i + 1), Y i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
      rw [hy i]
      exact inner_tangentIntersection_right (hu (i + 1))
        (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hc i)).ne'
    rw [cross_of_tangent_edge heq hi]
    exact mul_pos hℓ (sub_pos.mpr (hs j (i + 1) hjnext.symm
      (fun h ↦ hji (add_right_cancel h).symm)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_of_tangent_edge
lean.code:
lemma cross_of_tangent_edge {u x y z : ℂ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hedge : y - x = ℓ • (Complex.I * u)) (hux : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) :
    crossR2 x y z = ℓ * (1 - ⟪u, z⟫_ℝ) := by
  change (y - x).re * (z - x).im - (y - x).im * (z - x).re = _
  rw [hedge]
  simp only [Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, zero_add,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, smul_eq_mul, Complex.inner,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hux
  linear_combination ℓ * hux

entries.label: st:projective-fan
entries.title: The finite square perturbation has strict geometry
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Take the square-perturbation angles with $0<\eta\le1$ from the balancing
construction. Apply $B_a$ to their normals and tangent vertices, with
$|a|<1$, $\sigma>0$, $\sigma^2+|a|^2=1$, and positive vertex denominators.
The result is a strict tangential fan. The last angular successor $2\pi$
represents the first normal, so this assertion includes the cyclic seam.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
theorem projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) {a : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hd : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (fanVertex n p q r η i)) :
    IsStrictTangentialFan
      (fun i : Fin n ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)))
      (fun i : Fin n ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i)) := by
  have hnorm : ∀ i : Fin n, ‖normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)‖ = 1 := fun i ↦ norm_normal _
  have hdn : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)) :=
    fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha (hnorm i).le
  have hc := fan_normal_cross_pos hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁
  have hy := fanVertex_eq_cyclic hn hpq hqr hr η
  apply isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry
  · intro i
    exact ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hdn i).ne'
  · intro i
    exact cross_transform_normals_pos ha hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hnorm (i + 1)) (hc i)
      (by rw [← hy i]; exact hd i)
  · intro i
    rw [hy i]
    exact transform_tangentIntersection ha hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hnorm (i + 1)) (hc i)
      (by rw [← hy i]; exact hd i)
  · intro i j hji hjnext
    exact (ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_lt_one_iff hσ hsq (hdn j) (hd i)).mpr
      (fanVertex_strict_support hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁ i j hji hjnext)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex_eq_cyclic
lean.code:
lemma fanVertex_eq_cyclic {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    fanVertex n p q r η i = tangentIntersection (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i))
      (normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n))) := by
  rw [normal_fanAngle_succ hn hpq hqr hr]
  rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fan_normal_cross_pos
lean.code:
lemma fan_normal_cross_pos {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < crossR2 0 (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i))
      (normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n))) := by
  rw [normal_fanAngle_succ hn hpq hqr hr, cross_normal]
  exact Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
    (sub_pos.mpr (fanAngle_strictMono (by omega) hη hη₁ (Nat.lt_succ_self _)))
    (fanAngle_step_lt_pi hn hp hpq hqr hη.le hη₁ i)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_fanAngle_succ
lean.code:
lemma normal_fanAngle_succ {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n)) =
      normal (fanAngle n p q r η ((i : ℕ) + 1)) := by
  have h_one : (1 : Fin n).val = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < n)]
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n
  · rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi]
  · have he : (i : ℕ) + 1 = n := by omega
    rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, he, Nat.mod_self, fanAngle_zero,
      fanAngle_end (by omega) hr hpq hqr]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp

entries.label: st:balanced-fan
entries.title: A balanced strict tangential fan
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$, $0<p<q<r<n$, and $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}c_i=0$, with
$c_0>0$, $c_p<0$, $c_q>0$, $c_r<0$.
There is a strict tangential fan $(U,Y)$ with
$\sum_i c_iY_i=0$, preserving all $n$ original labels and coefficients.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_balanced_strictTangentialFan
lean.code:
theorem exists_balanced_strictTangentialFan {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n)
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < c ⟨0, by omega⟩) (h₁ : c ⟨p, by omega⟩ < 0)
    (h₂ : 0 < c ⟨q, by omega⟩) (h₃ : c ⟨r, hr⟩ < 0) :
    ∃ U Y : Fin n → ℂ, IsStrictTangentialFan U Y ∧ ∑ i, c i • Y i = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hη₁, a, σ, ha, hσ, hsq, hd, hb⟩ :=
    exists_balanced_squareFan hn hp hpq hqr hr c hsum h₀ h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact ⟨fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)),
    fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i),
    projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁.le ha hσ hsq hd, hb⟩

entries.label: st:field-halfplanes
entries.title: Winding comparison in open half-planes
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Let $\gamma,\eta:[0,1]\to\mathbb C\setminus\{0\}$ be continuous closed loops.
Suppose that for every $t$ there is a real linear functional $L_t$ with
$L_t(\gamma(t))>0$ and $L_t(\eta(t))>0$. Then their winding numbers about zero
are equal. No continuity of the choice $L_t$ is required. For a continuous
real phase $\phi$, the nonvanishing path $e^{i\phi(t)}$ has winding
$(\phi(1)-\phi(0))/(2\pi)$.

lean.name: Complex.phaseCurve_ne_zero
lean.code:
theorem phaseCurve_ne_zero (φ : C(I, ℝ)) (t : I) : phaseCurve φ t ≠ 0 :=
  exp_ne_zero _

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_phaseCurve
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_phaseCurve (φ : C(I, ℝ)) :
    windingNumberAt 0 (phaseCurve φ) (phaseCurve_ne_zero φ) =
      (φ 1 - φ 0) / (2 * Real.pi) := by
  apply windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift _ φ
  simp [phaseCurve, norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane (γ η : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) (hη : ∀ t, η t ≠ 0)
    (hγloop : γ 0 = γ 1) (hηloop : η 0 = η 1)
    (hcone : ∀ t, ∃ L : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, 0 < L (γ t) ∧ 0 < L (η t)) :
    windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ = windingNumberAt 0 η hη := by
  let H : C(I × I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ (1 - (st.1 : ℝ)) • γ st.2 + (st.1 : ℝ) • η st.2, by fun_prop⟩
  refine windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy 0 γ η hγ hη H ?_
    (by simp [H]) (by simp [H]) (by simp [H, hγloop, hηloop])
  intro st hzero
  obtain ⟨L, hLγ, hLη⟩ := hcone st.2
  have hpos : 0 < L (H st) :=
    (convex_halfSpace_gt L.isLinear 0) hLγ hLη
      (sub_nonneg.mpr st.1.property.2) st.1.property.1 (sub_add_cancel _ _)
  simp [hzero] at hpos

lean.name: Complex.phaseCurve
lean.code:
noncomputable def phaseCurve (φ : C(I, ℝ)) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ exp ((φ t : ℂ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩

entries.label: st:field-convex-zero
entries.title: A winding obstruction on a convex set
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Let $S\subseteq\mathbb C$ be convex and contain a point $a$. Let $F$ be
continuous on $S$, and let $\gamma$ be a continuous closed loop in $S$ such
that $F\circ\gamma$ never vanishes and has nonzero winding about zero.
Then $F$ vanishes at some point of $S$. The loop need not be a circular
parametrization of the boundary of $S$.

lean.name: Complex.exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex
lean.code:
theorem exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex
    {S : Set ℂ} (hS : Convex ℝ S) (a : ℂ) (ha : a ∈ S)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (hF : ContinuousOn F S) (γ : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ S) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1) (havoid : ∀ t, F (γ t) ≠ 0)
    (hw : windingNumberAt 0 ⟨F ∘ γ, hF.comp_continuous γ.continuous hγ⟩ havoid ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ S, F x = 0 := by
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  let A : C(I × I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ (1 - (st.1 : ℝ)) • γ st.2 + (st.1 : ℝ) • a, by fun_prop⟩
  have hA : ∀ st, A st ∈ S := fun st ↦
    hS (hγ st.2) ha (sub_nonneg.mpr st.1.property.2) st.1.property.1
      (sub_add_cancel _ _)
  let H : C(I × I, ℂ) := ⟨F ∘ A, hF.comp_continuous A.continuous hA⟩
  have heq := windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy 0
    ⟨F ∘ γ, hF.comp_continuous γ.continuous hγ⟩ (ContinuousMap.const I (F a))
    havoid (fun _ ↦ hnone a ha) H (fun st ↦ hnone _ (hA st))
    (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def]) (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def])
    (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def, hloop])
  exact hw (heq.trans (windingNumberAt_const 0 (F a) (fun _ ↦ hnone a ha)))

entries.label: st:field-diamond
entries.title: The diamond and its boundary loop
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For $r\in\mathbb R$, set
\[
 D_r=\{x+iy:|x|+|y|\le r\}.
\]
This set is convex and compact. For $r\ge0$ a closed continuous boundary
loop is
\[
 b_r(t)=\frac{r\,e^{2\pi it}}
 {|\cos(2\pi t)|+|\sin(2\pi t)|},\qquad 0\le t\le1.
\]
It satisfies $|\operatorname{Re}b_r(t)|+|\operatorname{Im}b_r(t)|=r$.

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary_mem
lean.code:
theorem diamondBoundary_mem {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (t : I) :
    |(diamondBoundary r t).re| + |(diamondBoundary r t).im| = r := by
  simp only [diamondBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, smul_re, smul_im, smul_eq_mul,
    abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hr (l1_unitLoop_pos t).le)]
  rw [← mul_add, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (l1_unitLoop_pos t).ne']

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary_closed
lean.code:
theorem diamondBoundary_closed (r : ℝ) : diamondBoundary r 0 = diamondBoundary r 1 := by
  simp only [diamondBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, unitLoop_closed]

lean.name: Complex.isCompact_diamond
lean.code:
theorem isCompact_diamond (r : ℝ) : IsCompact (diamond r) := by
  apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r).of_isClosed_subset
    (isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  intro z hz
  simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
    (norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im z).trans hz

lean.name: Complex.convex_diamond
lean.code:
theorem convex_diamond (r : ℝ) : Convex ℝ (diamond r) := by
  have hre : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℂ ↦ |z.re|) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (convexOn_norm (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ))).comp_linearMap Complex.reLm
  have him : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℂ ↦ |z.im|) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (convexOn_norm (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ))).comp_linearMap Complex.imLm
  simpa [diamond] using (hre.add him).convex_le r

lean.name: Complex.diamond
lean.code: def diamond (r : ℝ) : Set ℂ := {z | |z.re| + |z.im| ≤ r}

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary
lean.code:
noncomputable def diamondBoundary (r : ℝ) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ (r / (|(unitLoop t).re| + |(unitLoop t).im|)) • unitLoop t, by
    exact (continuous_const.div ((Complex.continuous_re.comp unitLoop.continuous).abs.add
      (Complex.continuous_im.comp unitLoop.continuous).abs)
      (fun t ↦ (l1_unitLoop_pos t).ne')).smul unitLoop.continuous⟩

entries.label: st:field-diamond-zero
entries.title: Four signs force a zero in the diamond
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Let $r>0$ and $F$ be continuous on $D_r$. On $|x|+|y|=r$, assume
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
 y\ge|x| & \operatorname{Re}F(x+iy)>0\\
 -x\ge|y| & \operatorname{Im}F(x+iy)<0\\
 -y\ge|x| & \operatorname{Re}F(x+iy)<0\\
 x\ge|y| & \operatorname{Im}F(x+iy)>0.
\end{array}
\]
Then $F$ has a zero in $D_r$.

lean.name: Complex.DiamondSigns
lean.code:
structure DiamondSigns (F : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) : Prop where
  top : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.re| ≤ z.im → 0 < (F z).re
  left : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.im| ≤ -z.re → (F z).im < 0
  bottom : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.re| ≤ -z.im → (F z).re < 0
  right : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.im| ≤ z.re → 0 < (F z).im

lean.name: Complex.exists_zero_of_diamondSigns
lean.code:
theorem exists_zero_of_diamondSigns {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (diamond r)) (hsigns : DiamondSigns F r) :
    ∃ z ∈ diamond r, F z = 0 := by
  have hmem : ∀ t, diamondBoundary r t ∈ diamond r :=
    fun t ↦ (diamondBoundary_mem hr.le t).le
  let γ : C(I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨F ∘ diamondBoundary r, hF.comp_continuous (diamondBoundary r).continuous hmem⟩
  have hcone : ∀ t, ∃ L : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, 0 < L (γ t) ∧
      0 < L (phaseCurve reversedPhase t) := diamondSigns_boundaryCone hr hsigns
  have hne : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨L, hL, -⟩ := hcone t
    simp [ht] at hL
  have hmodel : phaseCurve reversedPhase 0 = phaseCurve reversedPhase 1 := by
    rw [reversedPhase_eq_swap, reversedPhase_eq_swap, unitLoop_closed]
  have hw := windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane γ (phaseCurve reversedPhase)
    hne (phaseCurve_ne_zero reversedPhase) (congrArg F (diamondBoundary_closed r))
    hmodel hcone
  refine exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex (convex_diamond r) 0
    (by simpa [diamond] using hr.le) F hF (diamondBoundary r) hmem
    (diamondBoundary_closed r) hne ?_
  exact (hw.trans reversedPhase_winding).trans_ne (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)

entries.label: st:field-sign-stability
entries.title: Uniform persistence of the four signs
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Let $F(a,z)$ be jointly continuous at every $(a_0,z)$ with $z\in D_r$.
If $F(a_0,\cdot)$ has the four strict signs above, then all sufficiently
nearby parameters $a$ have these same signs on the entire boundary.
More generally, if $g$ is continuous, the boundary slice
\[
 \{z:|\operatorname{Re}z|+|\operatorname{Im}z|=r,\ g(z)\ge0\}
\]
is compact, and strict positivity of a continuous linear functional of
$F(a_0,z)$ on this slice persists uniformly for nearby $a$.

lean.name: Complex.isCompact_diamondFace
lean.code:
lemma isCompact_diamondFace (r : ℝ) {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) :
    IsCompact (diamondFace r g) := by
  exact (isCompact_diamond r).of_isClosed_subset
    ((isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter
      (isClosed_le continuous_const hg)) (fun _ hz ↦ hz.1.le)

lean.name: Complex.diamondFace
lean.code:
def diamondFace (r : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  {z | |z.re| + |z.im| = r ∧ 0 ≤ g z}

lean.name: Complex.eventually_diamondSigns
lean.code:
theorem eventually_diamondSigns {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    {F : A → ℂ → ℂ} {a : A} {r : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ z ∈ diamond r, ContinuousAt (fun p : A × ℂ ↦ F p.1 p.2) (a, z))
    (hs : DiamondSigns (F a) r) :
    ∀ᶠ b in 𝓝 a, DiamondSigns (F b) r := by
  have ht := eventually_pos_on_diamondFace hF reCLM
    (g := fun z ↦ z.im - |z.re|) (by fun_prop)
    (fun z hz ↦ hs.top z hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mp hz.2))
  have hl := eventually_pos_on_diamondFace hF (-imCLM)
    (g := fun z ↦ -z.re - |z.im|) (by fun_prop)
    (fun z hz ↦ neg_pos.mpr (hs.left z hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mp hz.2)))
  have hb := eventually_pos_on_diamondFace hF (-reCLM)
    (g := fun z ↦ -z.im - |z.re|) (by fun_prop)
    (fun z hz ↦ neg_pos.mpr (hs.bottom z hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mp hz.2)))
  have hr := eventually_pos_on_diamondFace hF imCLM
    (g := fun z ↦ z.re - |z.im|) (by fun_prop)
    (fun z hz ↦ hs.right z hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mp hz.2))
  filter_upwards [ht, hl, hb, hr] with b ht hl hb hr
  exact ⟨fun z he hz ↦ ht z ⟨he, sub_nonneg.mpr hz⟩,
    fun z he hz ↦ neg_pos.mp (hl z ⟨he, sub_nonneg.mpr hz⟩),
    fun z he hz ↦ neg_pos.mp (hb z ⟨he, sub_nonneg.mpr hz⟩),
    fun z he hz ↦ hr z ⟨he, sub_nonneg.mpr hz⟩⟩

lean.name: Complex.eventually_pos_on_diamondFace
lean.code:
lemma eventually_pos_on_diamondFace {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    {F : A → ℂ → ℂ} {a : A} {r : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ z ∈ diamond r, ContinuousAt (fun p : A × ℂ ↦ F p.1 p.2) (a, z))
    (L : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g)
    (hsign : ∀ z ∈ diamondFace r g, 0 < L (F a z)) :
    ∀ᶠ b in 𝓝 a, ∀ z ∈ diamondFace r g, 0 < L (F b z) := by
  apply (isCompact_diamondFace r hg).eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro z hz
  exact (L.continuous.continuousAt.comp (hF z hz.1.le))
    (Ioi_mem_nhds (hsign z hz))

entries.label: st:field-square
entries.title: The square limiting field
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Put coefficients $A,-B,C,-D$, with $A,B,C,D>0$, at the counterclockwise
square corners $(1,1),(-1,1),(-1,-1),(1,-1)$. Put arbitrary real coefficients
$T,L,H,R$ at the top, left, bottom, and right side contacts. The finite
rational field $G(z)=\sum_j c_jX_j/(1-\langle z,X_j\rangle)$ has horizontal
component
\[
 U(x,y)=\frac{A}{1-x-y}+\frac{B}{1+x-y}
 -\frac{C}{1+x+y}-\frac{D}{1-x+y}
 -\frac{L}{1+x}+\frac{R}{1-x}.
\]
Its vertical component is the same expression with
$(A,B,C,D,L,R,x,y)$ replaced by $(A,D,C,B,H,T,y,x)$.
The top and bottom side contacts have zero horizontal contribution,
regardless of the size of their coefficients.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights
lean.code:
structure SquareWeights where
  a : ℝ
  b : ℝ
  c : ℝ
  d : ℝ
  top : ℝ
  left : ℝ
  bottom : ℝ
  right : ℝ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.upperProjection
lean.code:
noncomputable def upperProjection (a b c d left right x y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  a / (1 - x - y) + b / (1 + x - y) - c / (1 + x + y) - d / (1 - x + y) -
    left / (1 + x) + right / (1 - x)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.Positive
lean.code:
def SquareWeights.Positive (w : SquareWeights) : Prop :=
  0 < w.a ∧ 0 < w.b ∧ 0 < w.c ∧ 0 < w.d

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.field
lean.code:
noncomputable def SquareWeights.field (w : SquareWeights) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ⟨upperProjection w.a w.b w.c w.d w.left w.right z.re z.im,
    upperProjection w.a w.d w.c w.b w.bottom w.top z.im z.re⟩

entries.label: st:field-upper-estimate
entries.title: Uniform upper-arc estimate
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Suppose $\epsilon>0$, $|x|+y=1-\epsilon$, and $|x|\le y$.
Then $1-x-y$ and $1+x-y$ are at least $\epsilon$, with one equal to
$\epsilon$; $1+x+y$ and $1-x+y$ are at least $1$; and $1\pm x\ge1/2$.
For nonnegative $A,B,C,D$ this gives
\[
 U(x,y)\ge\frac{\min(A,B)}{\epsilon}-C-D-2|L|-2|R|.
\]
In particular this component is positive when the right-hand side is positive.
Opposite arcs obey the exact identity
\[
 U_{C,D,A,B,R,L}(-x,-y)=-U_{A,B,C,D,L,R}(x,y).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.abs_div_le_two_mul
lean.code:
theorem abs_div_le_two_mul {u δ : ℝ} (hδ : 1 / 2 ≤ δ) : |u / δ| ≤ 2 * |u| := by
  rw [abs_div]
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg u)
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num) (hδ.trans (le_abs_self δ))
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.upper_denominators
lean.code:
theorem upper_denominators {ε x y : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbd : |x| + y = 1 - ε) (htop : |x| ≤ y) :
    ε ≤ 1 - x - y ∧ ε ≤ 1 + x - y ∧
      1 ≤ 1 + x + y ∧ 1 ≤ 1 - x + y ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ 1 + x ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ 1 - x ∧
      (1 - x - y = ε ∨ 1 + x - y = ε) := by
  rcases le_total 0 x with hx | hx
  all_goals grind [abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.upperProjection_opposite
lean.code:
theorem upperProjection_opposite (a b c d left right x y : ℝ) :
    upperProjection c d a b right left (-x) (-y) =
      -upperProjection a b c d left right x y := by
  unfold upperProjection
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.upperProjection_pos
lean.code:
theorem upperProjection_pos {ε a b c d left right x y : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hbd : |x| + y = 1 - ε) (htop : |x| ≤ y)
    (hmargin : c + d + 2 * |left| + 2 * |right| < min a b / ε) :
    0 < upperProjection a b c d left right x y := by
  have h := upperProjection_lower_bound (left := left) (right := right)
    hε ha hb hc hd hbd htop
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.upperProjection_lower_bound
lean.code:
theorem upperProjection_lower_bound {ε a b c d left right x y : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hbd : |x| + y = 1 - ε) (htop : |x| ≤ y) :
    min a b / ε - c - d - 2 * |left| - 2 * |right| ≤
      upperProjection a b c d left right x y := by
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, hleft, hright, hactive⟩ := upper_denominators hε hbd htop
  have hlead : min a b / ε ≤ a / (1 - x - y) + b / (1 + x - y) := by
    rcases hactive with hactive | hactive
    all_goals rw [hactive]
    · exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left a b) hε.le).trans
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg hb (hε.le.trans h₁)))
    · exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right a b) hε.le).trans
        (le_add_of_nonneg_left (div_nonneg ha (hε.le.trans h₀)))
  unfold upperProjection
  linarith only [hlead, div_le_self hc h₂, div_le_self hd h₃,
    abs_div_le_two_mul (u := left) hleft, abs_div_le_two_mul (u := right) hright,
    le_abs_self (left / (1 + x)), neg_abs_le (right / (1 - x))]

entries.label: st:field-margins
entries.title: One inset satisfies all four margins
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For $A,B,C,D>0$ and arbitrary $T,L,H,R$, there exists $0<\epsilon<1$ such that
\[
\begin{aligned}
 C+D+2|L|+2|R|&<\min(A,B)/\epsilon,\\
 A+D+2|T|+2|H|&<\min(C,B)/\epsilon,\\
 A+B+2|R|+2|L|&<\min(C,D)/\epsilon,\\
 C+B+2|H|+2|T|&<\min(A,D)/\epsilon.
\end{aligned}
\]
These inequalities imply all four diamond signs for $G$ on $D_{1-\epsilon}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.exists_margins
lean.code:
theorem SquareWeights.exists_margins {w : SquareWeights} (hw : w.Positive) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧ w.Margins ε := by
  let m := min (min w.a w.b) (min w.c w.d)
  let M := w.a + w.b + w.c + w.d +
    2 * |w.top| + 2 * |w.left| + 2 * |w.bottom| + 2 * |w.right| + 1
  have hm : 0 < m := lt_min (lt_min hw.1 hw.2.1) (lt_min hw.2.2.1 hw.2.2.2)
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    dsimp [M]
    linarith [hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2.1, hw.2.2.2, abs_nonneg w.top,
      abs_nonneg w.left, abs_nonneg w.bottom, abs_nonneg w.right]
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsmall⟩ := exists_between (lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hm hM))
  have hbound : M < m / ε := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hε).mpr
    simpa [mul_comm] using (lt_div_iff₀ hM).mp (hsmall.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  refine ⟨ε, hε, hsmall.trans_le (min_le_left _ _), ?_⟩
  constructor <;> refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_
    (lt_of_lt_of_le hbound (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hε.le))
  all_goals grind [SquareWeights.Positive, abs_nonneg]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.Margins
lean.code:
structure SquareWeights.Margins (w : SquareWeights) (ε : ℝ) : Prop where
  top : w.c + w.d + 2 * |w.left| + 2 * |w.right| < min w.a w.b / ε
  left : w.a + w.d + 2 * |w.top| + 2 * |w.bottom| < min w.c w.b / ε
  bottom : w.a + w.b + 2 * |w.right| + 2 * |w.left| < min w.c w.d / ε
  right : w.c + w.b + 2 * |w.bottom| + 2 * |w.top| < min w.a w.d / ε

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.diamondSigns
lean.code:
theorem SquareWeights.diamondSigns {w : SquareWeights} {ε : ℝ}
    (hw : w.Positive) (hε : 0 < ε) (hm : w.Margins ε) :
    Complex.DiamondSigns w.field (1 - ε) := by
  rcases hw with ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩
  constructor
  all_goals intro z hbd hside
  · exact upperProjection_pos hε ha.le hb.le hc.le hd.le
      (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg ((abs_nonneg z.re).trans hside)] using hbd)
      hside hm.top
  · have hp := upperProjection_pos (left := w.top) (right := w.bottom)
      (x := -z.im) (y := -z.re) hε hc.le hb.le ha.le hd.le
      (by simpa [abs_of_nonpos (neg_nonneg.mp ((abs_nonneg z.im).trans hside)),
        add_comm] using hbd)
      (by simpa using hside) hm.left
    exact neg_pos.mp ((upperProjection_opposite
      w.a w.d w.c w.b w.bottom w.top z.im z.re) ▸ hp)
  · have hp := upperProjection_pos (left := w.right) (right := w.left)
      (x := -z.re) (y := -z.im) hε hc.le hd.le ha.le hb.le
      (by simpa [abs_of_nonpos (neg_nonneg.mp ((abs_nonneg z.re).trans hside))]
        using hbd)
      (by simpa using hside) hm.bottom
    exact neg_pos.mp ((upperProjection_opposite
      w.a w.b w.c w.d w.left w.right z.re z.im) ▸ hp)
  · exact upperProjection_pos hε ha.le hd.le hc.le hb.le
      (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg ((abs_nonneg z.im).trans hside), add_comm] using hbd)
      hside hm.right

entries.label: st:field-limit-zero
entries.title: A zero of the square limiting field
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
The square field with positive alternating corner magnitudes and arbitrary
signed side-contact coefficients has a zero $a$ satisfying
$|\operatorname{Re}a|+|\operatorname{Im}a|<1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.exists_zero
lean.code:
theorem SquareWeights.exists_zero {w : SquareWeights} (hw : w.Positive) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, |z.re| + |z.im| < 1 ∧ w.field z = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε₁, hm⟩ := exists_margins hw
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzero⟩ := Complex.exists_zero_of_diamondSigns (sub_pos.mpr hε₁)
    w.field (w.continuousOn_field hε) (diamondSigns hw hε hm)
  exact ⟨z, lt_of_le_of_lt hz (sub_lt_self 1 hε), hzero⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.continuousOn_field
lean.code:
theorem SquareWeights.continuousOn_field (w : SquareWeights) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ContinuousOn w.field (Complex.diamond (1 - ε)) := by
  apply continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇⟩ := diamond_denominators hε hz
  unfold SquareWeights.field upperProjection
  simp_rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
  fun_prop (disch := linarith)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.diamond_denominators
lean.code:
theorem diamond_denominators {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ Complex.diamond (1 - ε)) :
    0 < 1 - z.re - z.im ∧ 0 < 1 + z.re - z.im ∧
      0 < 1 + z.re + z.im ∧ 0 < 1 - z.re + z.im ∧
      0 < 1 + z.re ∧ 0 < 1 - z.re ∧ 0 < 1 + z.im ∧ 0 < 1 - z.im := by
  change |z.re| + |z.im| ≤ 1 - ε at hz
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    linarith [le_abs_self z.re, neg_abs_le z.re, le_abs_self z.im, neg_abs_le z.im,
      abs_nonneg z.re, abs_nonneg z.im]

entries.label: st:field-group-sites
entries.title: Grouping labelled square sites preserves the field
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Let $S_0,\ldots,S_7$ be the four square corners followed by the top, left,
bottom, and right contacts. For a finite label set $I$, a site assignment
$\tau:I\to\{0,\ldots,7\}$, and coefficients $c_i$, define
$g_j=\sum_{\tau(i)=j}c_i$. Then
\[
 \sum_{i\in I}\frac{c_i S_{\tau(i)}}{1-\langle a,S_{\tau(i)}\rangle}
 =\sum_{j=0}^7\frac{g_j S_j}{1-\langle a,S_j\rangle}.
\]
The right-hand side is the square field with magnitudes
$(g_0,-g_1,g_2,-g_3)$ and side coefficients $(g_4,g_5,g_6,g_7)$.
Every site denominator is positive on $D_{1-\epsilon}$ for $\epsilon>0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.weightsOfSites
lean.code:
def weightsOfSites (g : Fin 8 → ℝ) : SquareWeights :=
  ⟨g 0, -g 1, g 2, -g 3, g 4, g 5, g 6, g 7⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.field_squareSite
lean.code:
lemma field_squareSite (g : Fin 8 → ℝ) (a : ℂ) :
    ProjectiveBall.field g squareSite a = (weightsOfSites g).field a := by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [ProjectiveBall.field, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im]
  all_goals simp [squareSite, ProjectiveBall.denominator, Complex.inner,
    SquareWeights.field, upperProjection, weightsOfSites]
  all_goals ring

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareSite_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma squareSite_denominator_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {a : ℂ}
    (ha : a ∈ Complex.diamond (1 - ε)) (k : Fin 8) :
    0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (squareSite k) := by
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇⟩ := diamond_denominators hε ha
  fin_cases k <;> simp [squareSite, ProjectiveBall.denominator, Complex.inner]
  all_goals linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.siteCoefficient
lean.code:
noncomputable def siteCoefficient (c : ι → ℝ) (tag : ι → Fin 8) (k : Fin 8) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i with tag i = k, c i

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.field_group_sites
lean.code:
lemma field_group_sites (c : ι → ℝ) (tag : ι → Fin 8) (a : ℂ) :
    ProjectiveBall.field c (fun i ↦ squareSite (tag i)) a =
      ProjectiveBall.field (siteCoefficient c tag) squareSite a := by
  unfold ProjectiveBall.field siteCoefficient
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ tag]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2]

entries.label: st:field-vertex-zero
entries.title: Nearby vertex lists retain a zero
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Fix a finite coefficient list $c$ and a vertex list $X$. Suppose $r>0$,
$1-\langle a,X_i\rangle>0$ for every $a\in D_r$ and every $i$, and the field
\[
 G_X(a)=\sum_i\frac{c_iX_i}{1-\langle a,X_i\rangle}
\]
has the four diamond signs. Every sufficiently nearby labelled vertex list
$Y$ has positive denominators on the entire same diamond and admits
$a\in D_r$ with $G_Y(a)=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuousAt_projectiveField
lean.code:
lemma continuousAt_projectiveField (c : ι → ℝ) {x : ι → ℂ} {a : ℂ}
    (hden : ∀ i, ProjectiveBall.denominator a (x i) ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : (ι → ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ProjectiveBall.field c p.1 p.2) (x, a) := by
  unfold ProjectiveBall.field
  apply tendsto_finsetSum
  intro i _
  have hx : Continuous (fun p : (ι → ℂ) × ℂ ↦ p.1 i) :=
    (continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst
  have hd : Continuous (fun p : (ι → ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ProjectiveBall.denominator p.2 (p.1 i)) :=
    continuous_const.sub (continuous_snd.inner hx)
  exact (continuousAt_const.div hd.continuousAt (hden i)).smul hx.continuousAt

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eventually_exists_projectiveField_zero
lean.code:
theorem eventually_exists_projectiveField_zero (c : ι → ℝ) {x : ι → ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hden : ∀ a ∈ Complex.diamond r, ∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (x i))
    (hs : Complex.DiamondSigns (ProjectiveBall.field c x) r) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ a ∈ Complex.diamond r,
      (∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (y i)) ∧ ProjectiveBall.field c y a = 0 := by
  have hsigns := Complex.eventually_diamondSigns
    (fun a ha ↦ continuousAt_projectiveField c (fun i ↦ (hden a ha i).ne')) hs
  filter_upwards [hsigns, eventually_projective_denominators_pos hden] with y hsy hdy
  have hc : ContinuousOn (ProjectiveBall.field c y) (Complex.diamond r) := by
    apply continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt
    intro a ha
    exact (continuousAt_projectiveField c (fun i ↦ (hdy a ha i).ne')).comp
      (continuousAt_const.prodMk continuousAt_id)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hzero⟩ := Complex.exists_zero_of_diamondSigns hr
    (ProjectiveBall.field c y) hc hsy
  exact ⟨a, ha, hdy a ha, hzero⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eventually_projective_denominators_pos
lean.code:
lemma eventually_projective_denominators_pos {x : ι → ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hden : ∀ a ∈ Complex.diamond r, ∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (x i)) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ a ∈ Complex.diamond r, ∀ i,
      0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (y i) := by
  apply (Complex.isCompact_diamond r).eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro a ha
  apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
  intro i
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : (ι → ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ProjectiveBall.denominator p.2 (p.1 i)) :=
    continuous_const.sub (continuous_snd.inner ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst))
  exact hc.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds (hden a ha i))

entries.label: st:field-perturbation
entries.title: Projective balance persists under finite vertex perturbations
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Under the preceding hypotheses, also suppose $r<1$ and $\sum_i c_i=0$.
Every sufficiently nearby list $Y$ admits parameters $a,\sigma$ with
\[
 \|a\|<1,\quad \sigma>0,\quad \sigma^2+\|a\|^2=1,
 \quad 1-\langle a,Y_i\rangle>0\quad\hbox{for every }i,
\]
and exact balance $\sum_i c_i B_{a,\sigma}(Y_i)=0$ for the projective
map of \cref{st:projective-map}.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eventually_exists_projective_balance
lean.code:
theorem eventually_exists_projective_balance (c : ι → ℝ) {x : ι → ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hr₁ : r < 1) (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (hden : ∀ a ∈ Complex.diamond r, ∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (x i))
    (hs : Complex.DiamondSigns (ProjectiveBall.field c x) r) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ σ : ℝ, ‖a‖ < 1 ∧ 0 < σ ∧ σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (y i)) ∧
      ∑ i, c i • ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (y i) = 0 := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_exists_projectiveField_zero c hr hden hs] with y hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hda, hzero⟩ := hy
  have hanorm : ‖a‖ < 1 := ((Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im a).trans ha).trans_lt hr₁
  have hrad : 0 < 1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg a]
  refine ⟨a, Real.sqrt (1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2), hanorm, Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hrad,
    by rw [Real.sq_sqrt hrad.le]; ring, hda, ?_⟩
  exact ProjectiveBall.sum_smul_transform_eq_zero_of_field_eq_zero c y a _
    (fun i ↦ (hda i).ne') hsum hzero

entries.label: st:field-near-square
entries.title: Balance near the labelled square
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Suppose $\sum_i c_i=0$, and the four grouped corner coefficients satisfy
$g_0>0,g_1<0,g_2>0,g_3<0$. Every labelled vertex list sufficiently close
to $(S_{\tau(i)})_{i\in I}$ has a projective normalization with positive
denominators and exact balance of the unchanged coefficients.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eventually_balance_near_square
lean.code:
theorem eventually_balance_near_square (c : ι → ℝ) (tag : ι → Fin 8)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < siteCoefficient c tag 0) (h₁ : siteCoefficient c tag 1 < 0)
    (h₂ : 0 < siteCoefficient c tag 2) (h₃ : siteCoefficient c tag 3 < 0) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (fun i ↦ squareSite (tag i)),
      ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ σ : ℝ, ‖a‖ < 1 ∧ 0 < σ ∧ σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1 ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (y i)) ∧
        ∑ i, c i • ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (y i) = 0 := by
  have hw : (weightsOfSites (siteCoefficient c tag)).Positive :=
    ⟨h₀, neg_pos.mpr h₁, h₂, neg_pos.mpr h₃⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε₁, hm⟩ := SquareWeights.exists_margins hw
  apply eventually_exists_projective_balance c (sub_pos.mpr hε₁)
    (by linarith : 1 - ε < 1) hsum
  · exact fun a ha i ↦ squareSite_denominator_pos hε ha (tag i)
  · have he : ProjectiveBall.field c (fun i ↦ squareSite (tag i)) =
        (weightsOfSites (siteCoefficient c tag)).field := by
      funext a
      rw [field_group_sites, field_squareSite]
    rw [he]
    exact SquareWeights.diamondSigns hw hε hm

entries.label: st:field-fan-angles
entries.title: Opening the repeated square normals
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$ and $0<p<q<r<n$. Define the normal level $s_k$ to be $0$ at
$k=0$, $1$ for $1\le k\le p$, $2$ for $p<k\le q$, $3$ for $q<k\le r$,
and $4$ for $k>r$. Set
\[
 \theta_k(\eta)=(1-\eta)s_k\frac\pi2+
                    \eta\frac{2\pi k}{n}.
\]
For $0<\eta\le1$, these angles strictly increase, start at zero, and
satisfy $\theta_n(\eta)=2\pi$. Every successive gap is strictly less than
$\pi$ (indeed at most $\pi/2$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle_zero
lean.code:
lemma fanAngle_zero (n p q r : ℕ) (η : ℝ) : fanAngle n p q r η 0 = 0 := by
  simp [fanAngle, squareLevel]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle_strictMono
lean.code:
lemma fanAngle_strictMono {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) : StrictMono (fanAngle n p q r η) := by
  intro i j hij
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hij' : (i : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hij
  have hl : (squareLevel p q r i : ℝ) ≤ squareLevel p q r j := by
    exact_mod_cast squareLevel_monotone p q r hij.le
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (sub_nonneg.mpr hη₁)) (by positivity : 0 ≤ Real.pi / 2)
  have hg := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (div_lt_div_of_pos_right
    (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hij' (by positivity : 0 < 2 * Real.pi)) hn') hη
  exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hb hg

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle_end
lean.code:
lemma fanAngle_end {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hr : r < n) (hpq : p < q)
    (hqr : q < r) (η : ℝ) : fanAngle n p q r η n = 2 * Real.pi := by
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  simp [fanAngle, squareLevel, hn.ne', show ¬n ≤ p by omega,
    show ¬n ≤ q by omega, show ¬n ≤ r by omega, hn']
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle_step_lt_pi
lean.code:
lemma fanAngle_step_lt_pi {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1) - fanAngle n p q r η k < Real.pi := by
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by omega)
  have hn₄ : (4 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hl : (squareLevel p q r (k + 1) : ℝ) - squareLevel p q r k ≤ 1 := by
    have h := squareLevel_step_le hp hpq hqr k
    exact_mod_cast (show (squareLevel p q r (k + 1) : ℤ) - squareLevel p q r k ≤ 1 by omega)
  have hb : ((squareLevel p q r (k + 1) : ℝ) - squareLevel p q r k) *
      (Real.pi / 2) ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hg : 2 * Real.pi / n ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hn').mpr
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have he : fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1) - fanAngle n p q r η k =
      (1 - η) * (((squareLevel p q r (k + 1) : ℝ) - squareLevel p q r k) *
        (Real.pi / 2)) + η * (2 * Real.pi / n) := by
    simp only [fanAngle, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hbound := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hη₁))
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg hη)
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle
lean.code:
noncomputable def fanAngle (n p q r : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - η) * (squareLevel p q r k : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2) +
    η * (2 * Real.pi * k / n)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareLevel_monotone
lean.code:
lemma squareLevel_monotone (p q r : ℕ) : Monotone (squareLevel p q r) := by
  intro i j hij
  unfold squareLevel
  split_ifs <;> omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareLevel
lean.code:
def squareLevel (p q r k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if k = 0 then 0 else if k ≤ p then 1 else if k ≤ q then 2 else if k ≤ r then 3 else 4

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareLevel_step_le
lean.code:
lemma squareLevel_step_le {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r)
    (k : ℕ) : squareLevel p q r (k + 1) ≤ squareLevel p q r k + 1 := by
  unfold squareLevel
  split_ifs <;> omega

entries.label: st:field-fan-limit
entries.title: The finite fan retains every label in the square limit
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Write $u(\theta)=e^{i\theta}$ and form consecutive tangent intersections
\[
 X_k(\eta)=\frac{u(\theta_k(\eta))+u(\theta_{k+1}(\eta))}
 {1+\langle u(\theta_k(\eta)),u(\theta_{k+1}(\eta))\rangle}.
\]
As $\eta\to0$, the labels $0,p,q,r$ approach the four square corners,
respectively. The labels strictly between them approach the top, left,
bottom, and right contacts, respectively. Each corner fiber consists of
exactly its selected label, so its grouped coefficient is precisely that
original coefficient. Every coordinate $X_k(\eta)$ is continuous at zero.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex_zero
lean.code:
lemma fanVertex_zero {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r)
    (n k : ℕ) : fanVertex n p q r 0 k = squareSite (squareTag p q r k) := by
  have he := squareLevel_pair hp hpq hqr k
  have he₁ : squareLevel p q r k = ![0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 4] (squareTag p q r k) :=
    congrArg Prod.fst he
  have he₂ : squareLevel p q r (k + 1) = ![1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4] (squareTag p q r k) :=
    congrArg Prod.snd he
  simp only [fanVertex, fanAngle, sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, he₁, he₂]
  convert tangentIntersection_quarter_pair (squareTag p q r k) using 1
  generalize squareTag p q r k = t
  fin_cases t <;> norm_num

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareLevel_pair
lean.code:
lemma squareLevel_pair {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (squareLevel p q r k, squareLevel p q r (k + 1)) =
      (![0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 4] (squareTag p q r k),
        ![1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4] (squareTag p q r k)) := by
  unfold squareTag
  split_ifs <;> norm_num only [squareLevel, Matrix.cons_val, Prod.mk.injEq] <;>
    (try split_ifs) <;> norm_num <;> omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareTag_corners
lean.code:
lemma squareTag_corners {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (squareTag p q r k = 0 ↔ k = 0) ∧ (squareTag p q r k = 1 ↔ k = p) ∧
      (squareTag p q r k = 2 ↔ k = q) ∧ (squareTag p q r k = 3 ↔ k = r) := by
  unfold squareTag
  split_ifs <;> norm_num <;> omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex
lean.code:
noncomputable def fanVertex (n p q r : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  tangentIntersection (normal (fanAngle n p q r η k))
    (normal (fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_quarter_pair
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_quarter_pair (k : Fin 8) :
    tangentIntersection (normal ((![0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 4] k : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2)))
      (normal ((![1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4] k : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2))) = squareSite k := by
  fin_cases k <;> apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [tangentIntersection, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im]
  all_goals norm_num [squareSite, Complex.inner, show 3 * (Real.pi / 2) =
    Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 by ring, show 2 * (Real.pi / 2) = Real.pi by ring,
    show 4 * (Real.pi / 2) = 2 * Real.pi by ring, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
lean.code:
lemma siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℝ)
    (tag : ι → Fin 8) (k : Fin 8) (i : ι) (hi : ∀ j, tag j = k ↔ j = i) :
    siteCoefficient c tag k = c i := by
  classical
  simp only [siteCoefficient, hi, Finset.sum_filter]
  simp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareTag
Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuous_fanAngle
lean.code:
lemma continuous_fanAngle (n p q r k : ℕ) : Continuous (fun η ↦ fanAngle n p q r η k) := by
  unfold fanAngle
  fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuousAt_fanVertex_zero
lean.code:
lemma continuousAt_fanVertex_zero {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (k : ℕ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun η ↦ fanVertex n p q r η k) 0 := by
  have hg := fanAngle_step_lt_pi hn hp hpq hqr (η := 0) le_rfl zero_le_one k
  have ho : fanAngle n p q r 0 k ≤ fanAngle n p q r 0 (k + 1) := by
    simp only [fanAngle, sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
    have hl : (squareLevel p q r k : ℝ) ≤ squareLevel p q r (k + 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast squareLevel_monotone p q r (Nat.le_add_right k 1)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl (by positivity)
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun η : ℝ ↦
      (normal (fanAngle n p q r η k), normal (fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1)))) 0 :=
    ((continuous_normal.comp (continuous_fanAngle n p q r k)).prodMk
      (continuous_normal.comp (continuous_fanAngle n p q r (k + 1)))).continuousAt
  exact ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun η : ℝ ↦
    (normal (fanAngle n p q r η k), normal (fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1)))) (x := 0)
    (continuousAt_tangentIntersection (normal_denominator_pos ho hg).ne') hc

entries.label: st:field-fan-strict-support
entries.title: Strict support for a positive finite fan
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For $0<\eta\le1$, every $X_k(\eta)$ lies strictly in the inner half-plane
of each nonincident tangent line:
\[
 \langle u(\theta_j(\eta)),X_k(\eta)\rangle<1
 \qquad(j\ne k,\ j\ne k+1\pmod n).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex_strict_support
lean.code:
lemma fanVertex_strict_support {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1)
    (i j : Fin n) (hji : j ≠ i) (hnext : j ≠ i + 1) :
    ⟪normal (fanAngle n p q r η j), fanVertex n p q r η i⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have hn₀ : 0 < n := by omega
  have h_one : (1 : Fin n).val = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < n)]
  have hm := fanAngle_strictMono (p := p) (q := q) (r := r) hn₀ hη hη₁
  have hg := fanAngle_step_lt_pi hn hp hpq hqr hη.le hη₁ i
  have hend := fanAngle_end hn₀ hr hpq hqr η
  have hij : (j : ℕ) ≠ i := by exact fun he ↦ hji (Fin.ext he)
  have hijnext : (j : ℕ) ≠ (i : ℕ) + 1 := by
    intro he
    apply hnext
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n)]
    exact he
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · apply normal_support_lt_of_wrapped (hm hlt) (hm (Nat.lt_succ_self _)) hg
    have hib : fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      rw [← hend]
      exact hm.monotone (by omega)
    by_cases hj₀ : (j : ℕ) = 0
    · have hil : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n := by
        by_contra h
        apply hnext
        apply Fin.ext
        rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, show (i : ℕ) + 1 = n by omega, Nat.mod_self]
        exact hj₀
      have hiθ := hm hil
      simpa only [hj₀, fanAngle_zero, zero_add, hend] using hiθ
    · have hjθ := hm (show 0 < (j : ℕ) by omega)
      rw [fanAngle_zero] at hjθ
      linarith
  · apply normal_support_lt_of_ordered (hm (Nat.lt_succ_self _)) hg (hm (by omega))
    have hjθ := hm j.isLt
    have hiθ := hm.monotone (Nat.zero_le (i : ℕ))
    rw [hend] at hjθ
    rw [fanAngle_zero] at hiθ
    linarith

entries.label: st:field-balance
entries.title: A balanced finite tangential fan
entries.chapter: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$, $0<p<q<r<n$, and let $(c_k)_{k=0}^{n-1}$ satisfy
\[
 \sum_k c_k=0,\qquad c_0>0,\quad c_p<0,\quad c_q>0,\quad c_r<0.
\]
There exist $0<\eta<1$, $\|a\|<1$, and $\sigma>0$ with
$\sigma^2+\|a\|^2=1$, all denominators
$1-\langle a,X_k(\eta)\rangle$ positive, and
\[
 \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} c_k B_{a,\sigma}(X_k(\eta))=0.
\]
No condition is imposed on the signs or vanishing of unselected coefficients.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_balanced_squareFan
lean.code:
theorem exists_balanced_squareFan {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < c ⟨0, by omega⟩) (h₁ : c ⟨p, by omega⟩ < 0)
    (h₂ : 0 < c ⟨q, by omega⟩) (h₃ : c ⟨r, hr⟩ < 0) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ σ : ℝ,
      ‖a‖ < 1 ∧ 0 < σ ∧ σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1 ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (fanVertex n p q r η i)) ∧
        ∑ i : Fin n, c i • ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i) = 0 := by
  let tag : Fin n → Fin 8 := fun i ↦ squareTag p q r i
  have ht₀ : siteCoefficient c tag 0 = c ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
    apply siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
    intro i
    simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using (squareTag_corners hp hpq hqr i).1
  have ht₁ : siteCoefficient c tag 1 = c ⟨p, by omega⟩ := by
    apply siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
    intro i
    simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using (squareTag_corners hp hpq hqr i).2.1
  have ht₂ : siteCoefficient c tag 2 = c ⟨q, by omega⟩ := by
    apply siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
    intro i
    simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using (squareTag_corners hp hpq hqr i).2.2.1
  have ht₃ : siteCoefficient c tag 3 = c ⟨r, hr⟩ := by
    apply siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
    intro i
    simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using (squareTag_corners hp hpq hqr i).2.2.2
  have hb := eventually_balance_near_square c tag hsum
    (ht₀.symm ▸ h₀) (ht₁.symm ▸ h₁) (ht₂.symm ▸ h₂) (ht₃.symm ▸ h₃)
  have hc : Tendsto (fun η : ℝ ↦ fun i : Fin n ↦ fanVertex n p q r η i)
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (fun i ↦ squareSite (tag i))) := by
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro i
    have hi := continuousAt_fanVertex_zero hn hp hpq hqr i
    rw [ContinuousAt, fanVertex_zero hp hpq hqr] at hi
    exact hi
  have hbη := (hc.eventually hb).filter_mono
    (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
  have hη₀ : ∀ᶠ η : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, 0 < η := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  have hη₁ : ∀ᶠ η : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, η < 1 :=
    Filter.Eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      (Iio_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
  obtain ⟨η, hη₀, hη₁, hbalance⟩ := (hη₀.and (hη₁.and hbη)).exists
  exact ⟨η, hη₀, hη₁, hbalance⟩
